fields.requirements: Entry Requirements 1. Applicants must be non-Chinese citizens, have graduated from high school, and be over the age of 18. 2. Nationality Requirements Comply with the provisions of the Ministry of Education of the People's Republic of China (MOE) Document No. 12 [2020] (Jiaowaihan) For applicants who are former residents of Chinese Mainland (the Chinese mainland), Hong Kong, Macao, or Taiwan and have immigrated to a foreign country, and now apply as international students: They must obtain a valid foreign passport or nationality certification document by April 30, 2022, provide proof of cancellation of Chinese nationality, and have a record of actually residing abroad for more than 2 years from April 30, 2022 to April 30, 2026. (Acumulative actual residence of 9 months or more in a foreign country within one year shall be counted as one full year, subject to entry and exit stamps.) For applicants who were born with foreign nationality (where either or both parents are Chinese citizens and have settled abroad): They must have a record of actually residing abroad for more than 2 years from April 30, 2022 to April 30, 2026. (A cumulative actual residence of 9 months or more in a foreign country within one year shall be counted as one full year, subject to entry and exit stamps.) Note: If an applicant is confirmed by Chinese public security authorities to hold Chinese nationality during the application, admission, or after enrollment, their application qualification, admission qualification, enrollment qualification will be cancelled, or they will be dismissed from school. 3. Applicants for English-taught programs must provide the certificate of TOEFL (80 or above), IELTS(6.0 or above) or Duolingo (100 or above) (with the exception for the applicants from the countries or regions where English is the official language or mother language). 4. Transcript of the "China Scholastic Competency Assessment"(CSCA Test). The specific test subjects are as follows:

fields.description: Program Description 1. Program Introduction Editor Notes: Southeast University has been authorized as one of the qualified universities in China to enroll international students in the English-taught undergraduate program of medicine. The program pays much attention to training qualified international medical professionals, giving due consideration to the possible needs of them to serve in their motherland or other countries. Students who achieve the total required credits will be conferred diploma by Southeast University and qualified students will receive the Bachelor Degree of Medicine Science (M.B.B.S.). Graduates will be able to enroll for Physician Qualification Exam because of the relative regulations of the respective country. International students can also pursue the science and practice of medicine courses. According to “ Provisional Regulations on Quality Control Standards of English-Taught Medical Undergraduate Education for International Students in China ”，the Ministry of Education of China has approved Southeast University as one of the qualified universities in China to enroll international students in the English-taught undergraduate program of medicine. To accelerate its step of internationalization, Southeast University will continue to enroll international students in the English-taught undergraduate program of medicine in the fall-semester of 2010. The program aims to cultivate qualified international medical professionals, giving due consideration to the possible needs of them to serve in their motherland or other countries. After completing the total required credits, students will be conferred diploma by Southeast University and qualified students will receive the Bachelor Degree of Medicine Science (M.B.B.S.). Graduates will have the opportunity to enroll for Physician Qualification Exam according to the relative regulations of the respective country. Taught in English, the program is open to international students in pursuit of the science and practice of medicine, whose courses are offered by Medical College, SEU. 2. Program Structure Editor Notes: This program will provide different kinds of courses and internships for international students. 2.1 Chinese culture and natural science courses China's culture Chinese language Chinese medical terminology Mathematics Physics Chemistry Biology Physical education It is required to pass the examinations of these courses respectively. 2.2 Basic Courses Basic medical sciences behavioral science humanities Social science and medical ethics Preventive medicine Clinical medicine It is also required to pass the examinations of these courses respectively. 2.3 Internship The internship will be arranged by the institutions meticulously and the duration of the internship is one year (at least 48 weeks). The Chinese language course will be given during the whole undergraduate medical program in English to facilitate international students' learning and life in China and contact with patients in their medical practice. SEU is authorized by WHO and the graduates of MBBS program can apply to take the Medical Licensing Examinations held by the medical councils in different countries such as MCI, PMDC, USMLE, HPCSA, SCHS, etc. For more details, please visit the Medical Licensing Examination Guide. 2.4 Other Fees About 6000RMB-8000RMB/year for one occupancy in a room of two occupancies Insurance: 800 RMB/year 2.5 Enrollment Procedure We will check all the application documents and consider the qualification of each applicant. The best of the candidates will be enrolled. 3. Internship Editor Notes: Students can choose to do the internship/training in China, their home country or any other country. ​ Students who want to do an internship in China can choose a hospital from 20 hospitals in Nanjing. Students should first pass the HSK Level 5; otherwise, the university will arrange a Chinese student as a translator to assist during the process. Students who want to do the internship in another country need to do a qualification evaluation on the hospital which student chooses. In the internship year, the tuition fee is still RMB 30,600 per year and the accommodation of students who do an internship in China will be arranged by the relative hospitals. 4. Degree Conferring Editor Notes: I nternational medical undergraduates will be granted a MBBS degree certificate. MBBS Degree : Those who abide by Chinese laws and the regulations of SEU will be conferred bachelor’s degree of medical science by SEU after they have completed all required academic credits and obtain the graduation certificate. The English copy of the degree will state MBBS (Bachelor of Medicine and Bachelor of Surgery). Students have to pass the HSK 3 (New HSK 4) to get the diploma before graduation. 5. School Introduction Editor Notes: Southeast University has become a comprehensive university of high reputation. Southeast University (SEU) is one of the national key universities administered directly under the Ministry of Education of China. It is also one of the first universities accredited by the State Council to determine and approve the qualifications of professors, associate professors, and doctoral supervisors. It is also one of the universities of Project 211 and Program 985 that is financed by the central government to build as a world-class university , Learn More>> 6. Medical College Editor Notes: The College of Medicine has been an important base in the national medical education. Medical College wins a good reputation at home and abroad for its long history and high-quality education. More than 80 professors and 150 associate professors are in the faculty of the College of Medicine, including 30 doctoral supervisors and 200 master's supervisors, the majority of whom have the experience of studying infamous foreign medical schools and have obtained a Doctor's degree. There are 400,000 copies of books and 1500 kinds of foreign periodicals in the library. 19 hospitals are affiliated to the College of Medicine and more than 40 laboratory hospitals spread across the country. Overview of Medical College, SEU Medical College of Southeast University, originating from Nanjing Railway Medical College, whose origin can be traced back to the Medical College of the Central University founded in 1935, was merged to Southeast University in 2000. It enjoys its prestige home and abroad for its long history and high-quality education. College of Medicine, Southeast University (SEU), is located by the scenic Xuanwu Lake in Nanjing, a historic and cultural city of China, bordering Hunan Street, a national famous business street. The campus boasts beautiful sceneries all around the year. The College of Medicine has been an important base in the national medical education. In the past years, it has cultivated more than 20,000 graduates, including some academicians of the Chinese Academy of Engineering and other many noted medical experts home and abroad. College of Medicine, SEU is composed of School of Basic Medical Science, School of Clinical Medicine and School of Public Health. The College offers six Ph.D. programs, twenty-nine Master’s programs, one 7-year program for both Bachelor’s and Master’s degree and seven Bachelor’s programs. There are over 80 professors and 150 associate professors in the faculty of the College of Medicine, including 30 doctoral supervisors and 200 master’s supervisors, majority of whom have the experience of studying in famous foreign medical schools and have obtained Doctor’s degree. Additionally, there are 87 part-time professors and 226 associate professors in the attached hospitals and laboratory hospitals. With 193,000 sq. m. of modern teaching and laboratory buildings, gymnasiums and libraries, College of Medicine, SEU covers the total area of 263,000 sq. m. The libraries collect 400,000 copies of books and 1500 kinds of foreign periodicals. The Clinical Experimental Center, which is under construction, will facilitate the medical students with modern clinical techniques, by means of the simulative electronic patient system. There are 19 hospitals attached to College of Medicine, SEU, more than 40 laboratory hospitals spreading across the country. 7. Campus Life Editor Notes: International students enjoy a wonderful life on the campus. Ceremony Experience of Chinese Culture Note: Once admitted, students are required to pay a deposit in advance. Only after the payment can you get JW202 Form.

fields.requirements: Entry Requirements 1. General Requirements 1)Applicants must be non-Chinese citizens generally under the age of 45 (as of September 1, 2026), be mentally and physically healthy, and possess a valid regular passport. 2)Applicants should be a graduating student of an undergraduate’s program or hold a Bachelor Degree or above. 2. Requirements about Nationalities Foreign citizens of Chinese origin, including former Chinese citizens who have obtained foreign citizenship, as well as the non-Chinese descendants of present or former Chinese citizens, will have to follow the system instructions to fill in the basic information and upload the supporting documents based on the different citizenship status, and will be subject to a preliminary review of citizenship status by XMU during the admission stage and to verification of citizenship by the entry and exit administration department of China’s public security authorities. Applicants who fail to pass the preliminary review or verification of citizenship will be deemed to have forfeited their eligibility for admission, as well as the subsequent academic registration that they may obtain. 3. Language Proficiency Requirement 2)English proficiency requirements for English-medium programs TOEFL iBT Certificate: an overall minimum score of 80 (XMU's DI Code for TOEFL is C310) OR an IELTS Academic Certificate: an overall minimum score of 6.0 OR English-as-medium-of-instruction Certificate from previous university where English is the primary language of instruction. OR other equivalent English proficiency certificates recognized by XMU Applicants from countries where English is the official language are exempt from this requirement.
fields.materials: Application Materials " * " means necessary documents that you must provide in your application. If you want to book our translation service , please pay and book it at least 2 weeks before the application deadline for submission of all documents; If you want to book our guardian service , you need to pay and book it 2 months before the application deadline, just in case your application fails because of failed to submit application documents on time. * 1. Bachelor’s degree certificate or Certificate of Expected Graduation, bearing the stamp of the university. (1) Graduating students of bachelor’s degree programs should provide a Certificate of Expected Graduation. They should obtain their bachelor’s degree certificate before their entry to XMU in September of the academic year. (2) Degree certificates obtained outside the Chinese Mainland should be notarized by the local notary public office. (3) The originals of the degree certificates and notarized documents should be made available for verification upon enrolment at XMU. * 2. Academic transcripts for bachelor's degree studies, bearing the stamp of the University. (1) Graduating students of bachelor’s programs should provide academic transcripts for each year of bachelor’s degree studies to date. (2) Bachelor’s degree holders should submit a complete set of academic transcripts for their bachelor’s degree studies. (3) The results report of internationally accepted or standardized tests, e.g., GRE/GMAT/LSAT. XMU's DI Code for GRE is 4692. * 3. Personal Statement (minimum 1,000 words) which should include a self-introduction, educational experience, motivations, study plan and career aspirations. It needs to be written in Chinese for Chinese-medium programs, in English for English-medium programs. You can download a template or sample from here . * 4. Two Letters of Recommendation signed by professors or associate professors, written in Chinese or English. With information of the recommender’s names, employer and work position, either signed by the recommender or bearing the stamp of the recommending organization. * 5. A photocopy of English Proficiency Certificate A TOEFL certificate with 80 points or above, or an IELTS certificate with grade 6.0 or above, or other certificate of English proficiency from an accredited test. * 6. A scanned copy of the first page of the passport (regular passport, valid at least through October 31, 2026) * 7. CV, completed in Chinese or English. * 8. Physical Examination Record for Inbound Travellers Including chest X ray image, electrocardiogram, laboratory exam results and data sheets of some required items, completed in Chinese or English, with the lower part of the applicant’s photo stamped by the hospital. Physical examination results are valid for 6 months. You can download a template or sample from here . * 9. Financial Support Guarantee Statement and its supporting documents. You can download a template or sample from here . 10. Other materials Such as publications, competition awards, merit certificates, scientific research activities, academic conference attendance or special skills certificates, could be submitted in the “Other Supporting Materials” section in the application system as well. * 11. Certificate of No Criminal Record The applicants shall submit a valid Certificate of No Criminal Record issued by the local police, usually within 6 months before the date of submission of the application. 12. Personal portfolios such as videos and artworks, are REQUIRED for art applicants. * 13. Birth certificate * 14. Parents’ identity documents 15. Pre-Acceptance Letter (optional). Priority of admission will be given to applicants have acquired the pre-acceptance letter signed by the supervisor and stamped by the college. You can download a template or sample from here . Tips: For applicants who are in China: If you are an employee, you still need to provide employment separation certificate and your current residence permit. If you are a student, you need to provide transfer certificate, leaving certificate, certificate of attendance rate issued by previous school and your current residence permit.
fields.description: Program Description Core course descriptions * Marine Science and Ocean Uses Introduction to basic marine processes, selected ocean uses and their policy issues. The course focuses on the interplay of public policy and marine science with an emphasis on implications for policy, such as resources and energy extraction. Students will gain a basic understanding of the topics covered in the main sub-field of oceanography, an understanding of the scientific methodology and knowledge of how oceanographic information is applied in representative public debates. * Marine Resources Economics The principles and application of economics to the management of marine resources, and conflicts and problems which arise in the exploitation of marine environments. Particular attention is paid to marine and coastal resources valuation, bio-economic models, environmental issues, marine resource damage assessment, and the management of renewable and non-renewable resources. After completion of this course, students will understand the causes of the many problems associated with renewable resource exploitation and the multiple uses of the marine environment. They will appreciate the role of economic analysis in framing methods for resolving these problems, and be able to appraise critically practical policy experiences at national and global levels. * International Ocean Law This course will examine the principles of international law as they relate to ocean management problems: jurisdiction in zones, such as territorial seas, exclusion zones and the high seas, as well as the problems posed by zonal approaches to ocean-use management. The course will provide the student with a solid grounding in: 1) the manner in which international ocean law is formulated and developed, and how the international legal system functions. 2) the role of international law as a significant tool for ocean use management; 3) the characteristics and nature of different offshore legal zones as well as the rights and obligations of states in those zones. * Marine Affairs This course consists of an interdisciplinary seminar conducted by the Marine Affairs programme faculty supplemented by guest speakers from research institutions, industry and government. It focuses on problems of marine resources development and management at the local, regional, national and international policy level. The course will introduce many topics in ocean and coastal related fields and challenge students to consider techniques for systematic analysis and decision-making. Through this course, students will broaden their topical knowledge, and develop their understanding of analytical approaches.

description.text: Program Description Core course descriptions * Marine Science and Ocean Uses Introduction to basic marine processes, selected ocean uses and their policy issues. The course focuses on the interplay of public policy and marine science with an emphasis on implications for policy, such as resources and energy extraction. Students will gain a basic understanding of the topics covered in the main sub-field of oceanography, an understanding of the scientific methodology and knowledge of how oceanographic information is applied in representative public debates. * Marine Resources Economics The principles and application of economics to the management of marine resources, and conflicts and problems which arise in the exploitation of marine environments. Particular attention is paid to marine and coastal resources valuation, bio-economic models, environmental issues, marine resource damage assessment, and the management of renewable and non-renewable resources. After completion of this course, students will understand the causes of the many problems associated with renewable resource exploitation and the multiple uses of the marine environment. They will appreciate the role of economic analysis in framing methods for resolving these problems, and be able to appraise critically practical policy experiences at national and global levels. * International Ocean Law This course will examine the principles of international law as they relate to ocean management problems: jurisdiction in zones, such as territorial seas, exclusion zones and the high seas, as well as the problems posed by zonal approaches to ocean-use management. The course will provide the student with a solid grounding in: 1) the manner in which international ocean law is formulated and developed, and how the international legal system functions. 2) the role of international law as a significant tool for ocean use management; 3) the characteristics and nature of different offshore legal zones as well as the rights and obligations of states in those zones. * Marine Affairs This course consists of an interdisciplinary seminar conducted by the Marine Affairs programme faculty supplemented by guest speakers from research institutions, industry and government. It focuses on problems of marine resources development and management at the local, regional, national and international policy level. The course will introduce many topics in ocean and coastal related fields and challenge students to consider techniques for systematic analysis and decision-making. Through this course, students will broaden their topical knowledge, and develop their understanding of analytical approaches.

fields.description: Program Description 1. Introduction to Chinese Language Program Editor Notes: The Chinese language program is featured by Different Levels of Classes & Small Class Teaching. Different levels of teaching is our feature. We have nine different levels of classes for students to choose, ranging from beginners' to advanced, Students will take 20 hours Chinese class each week. Students are placed in appropriate class after a placement test upon registration. Small-class teaching is our tradition: 15-20 students class gives every student more opportunity to speak. We emphasize on students’ performance in the class and changing teacher-center class to students class thoroughly. 2. Study Duration and Study Mode Editor Notes: There are two phases for students to apply this program. Students can arrange their own timetables for their study. Duration of study is one semester or more. Different classes are arranged for beginners and students of advanced levels. Study in the College of Chinese Language and Culture. 3. Faculties and Curriculm Editor Notes: This program holds strong and committed teachers and full range of curriculum. Highly experienced and fully professional teachers make students improve their communicative ability by practicing in listening, speaking, reading and writing, and engage students in practical student-centered activity. Full range of courses are provided for students, such as Chinese history, Chinese literature, Chinese geography and so on. We also offer rich elective courses to students which can stimulate students’interests and make students have a better understanding of Chinese and Chinese culture, courses such as calligraphy, Kung-fu, Chinese ancient poetry and so on. 4. Study Atmosphere Editor Notes: BNU welcome foreign students from all over the world to study Chinese. BNU is the best place for international students to study Mandarin with a strong learning atmosphere. There are many international students come from different countries all over the world, and teachers as well as students here are also very friendly. 5. Entertainment & Extracurricular Activity Editor Notes: Various activities will be organized for international students during the program. We offer richly colorful extracurricular activities, such as Beijing Opera appreciation, Chinese language competition , culture tour and so on, which is an appropriate method for students to put their knowledge into practice. 6. School Introduction Editor Notes: The University’s history is an epitome of the development of modern teacher training and Chinese higher education. Beijing Normal University has a history of more than 100 years, which is almost as long as the history of Chinese modern education. The University is a national base for Teaching Chinese as Second Language; it makes great efforts to expand programs for international students. At present, the university has established cooperative ties with over 200 universities, international organizations and enterprises from more than 30 countries and regions. Established in 2004, the Beijing Normal University- Hong Kong Baptist University United International College is the first united college jointly established by a Chinese mainland university and a Hong Kong SAR university. Learn More about Beijing Normal University(BNU). 7. College of Chinese Language and Culture Editor Notes: The College of Chinese Language and Culture has now become a national center for the research and instruction of Chinese as a foreign language. The College has formed close academic relationships with a number of overseas universities such as Princeton University, Dartmouth College, University of California, Ohio State University, San Francisco State University, Iowa University, London University, Kanazawa University, Osaka University of Foreign Studies, Meikai University, Kanagawa University, Seoul National University, Sung Kyun Kwan University, etc. The College has established two collaborative Confucius Institutes with San Francisco State University (USA) and Manchester University (UK) respectively. In 2011, the Confucius Institute at San Francisco State University was named an Outstanding Confucius Institute. The Dean of the College, Professor Xu Jialu, is a famous linguist, social activist and scholar of Chinese culture. The faculty at the College consists of 58 permanent members, including 10 professors, 24 associate professors, 19 lecturers and 5 administrative staff members. According to the evaluation conducted by the Degree Education Development Center of the Ministry of Education, this degree program has always been one of the top universities among all the 70 relevant universities in China.

Study Place: OUC Fushan Campus, No.23 Eastern HongKong Road. 2. Main Courses Editor Notes: This program offers 8 main courses for international students. Intensive Reading Spoken Chinese Reading Listening Comprehension Chinese Culture Chinese Writing Reading of Chinese Newspaper Reading of Chinese Periodicals Contents for Chinese culture Week Topic Week Topic 1 Introduction: Dos and Don’ts 7 Great Thinkers and Philosophers 2 Chinese Cuisine 8 Chinese Education 3 Chinese Languages 9 Chinese Religion 4 New China and Influencing Figures 10 Chinese Literature and Art 5 Chinese Customs 11 Chinese Festivals 6 Chinese Dynasties and Historical Events 12 Chinese Medicine and Massage, Qigong 3. Sample Curriculum Editor Notes: This curriculum is for reference only. Class Time Monday Tuesday Wednesday Thursday Friday Class A 08:00 - 9:50 Spoken Chinese Chinese Character Spoken Chinese Intensive Reading Spoken Chinese 10:10 -12:00 Intensive Reading Listening Intensive Reading Listening Intensive Reading Class B 08:00 - 9:50 Spoken Chinese Intensive Reading Listening Spoken Chinese Intensive Reading 10:10 - 12:00 Listening Spoken Chinese Intensive Reading Intensive Reading Listening Class C 08:00 - 9:50 Intensive Reading Listening and Speaking Intensive Reading Intensive Reading Intensive Reading 10:10 - 12:00 Reading Writing Reading Listening and Speaking Listening and Speaking Class D 08:00 - 9:50 Listening and Speaking Listening and Speaking Writing Listening and Speaking Intensive Reading 10:10 -12:00 Intensive Reading Reading Reading Intensive Reading Writing Class E 08:00 - 9:50 Audio-Visual Chinese Business Chinese Chinese News Reading Business Chinese Chinese News Reading 10:10 - 12:00 Intensive Reading Intensive Reading Audio-Visual Chinese Audio-Visual Chinese Intensive Reading 4. Time and Duration Editor Notes: Here is the time arrangement and application time. 4.1 Time of Entrance Spring Semester: First Monday of March Fall Semester: First Monday of September 4.2 Duration of Study 1/2-2 years 4.3 Time of Application Spring Semester: The End of February Fall Semester: The End of August 5. School Introduction Editor Notes: Ocean University of China is a comprehensive university under the direct jurisdiction of the State Ministry of Education. There are over 20,000 registered students at Ocean University of China , including 4,500 Master's and Doctoral students and over 500 international students. Among the 2,300 faculty members there are many nationally and internationally recognized experts and scholars, 8 academicians of the Chinese Academy of Sciences and 5 academicians of Chinese Academy of Engineering. Ocean University of China (hereinafter referred to as OUC) is located in Qingdao, a renowned summer resort and an attractive historic tourist city of scenic beauty and temperate climate. Learn More about Ocean University of China. 6. International Education Center Editor Notes: OUC is now offering a large range of programs to international students, including some tailor-made programs. Each year more than 1300 international students from over 50 countries pursue their Certificate/Diploma/Bachelor's degree/Master's degree/Ph.D in our university. Our programs, especially known for their high standards of teaching and considerate services have been attractive to students from all over the world. Various cooperation has been set up with world-famous universities from different countries, such as Germany, USA, U.K. Russia, Japan, Malaysia, Thailand, Indonesia etc. 7. Campus Life Editor Notes: Various activities will be organized usually and students lead a rich and colorful life. (Tai Chi Show) ​ (Chinese Contest)

fields.materials: Application Materials " * " means necessary documents that you must provide in your application. If you want to book our translation service , please pay and book it at least 2 weeks before the application deadline for submission of all documents; If you want to book our guardian service , you need to pay and book it 2 months before the application deadline, just in case your application fails because of failed to submit application documents in time. * 1. 2-inch photo * 2. Scanned copy of the first page of passport With name, passport number & expiration date, and photo included(Photocopy of valid passport identification page. Passport must be an ordinary passport and be valid for at least six months. Applicants currently residing in China must include a copy of the page containing a valid visa or residence permit.) * 3. Certificate of Non-criminal Record It must be issued by your local police station with official stamp. If not in English or Chinese, it should be translated into English or Chinese. * 4. Certificate/diploma of highest education Graduation certificates should be notarized; If not in English, graduation certificates should be translated into English. * 5. Academic transcript of highest education Transcripts should be notarized; If not in English, transcripts should be translated into English. 6. Bank statement Bank statement of 20,000 RMB is required for applicants who apply for one academic year and above * 7. Resume 1. The Education Background must start from Senior High School until now. 2. If you have worked or once worked, please fill out the Work Experience, and provide the Job Letter (certificate of employment). 3. If you have not worked after graduating from school, fill in the duration and "no working" Note: If not in English or Chinese, it should be translated into English or Chinese. If you can not find a translation organization, please contact CUCAS. You can download a template or sample from here . * 8. Physical examination record for foreigner(only valid for 6 months) Please take it to hospital to have a checkup with all items, including personal information, photo, checking date, doctors' suggestion and signature. 9. Work certificate (for those with work experience) 10. Supporting Documents: Certificate of Good Conduct Provided by your current/previous school/company in Chinese/English to improve your success rate. You can download a template or sample from here . Tips: For applicants who are in China: If you are an employee, you still need to provide employment separation certificate and your current residence permit. If you are a student, you need to provide transfer certificate, leaving certificate, certificate of attendance rate issued by previous school and your current residence permit.

fields.requirements: Entry Requirements 1. Non-Chinese citizen who can study and live in school in good health and with a sound mind. 2. Age below 35 years 3. Bachelor's degree holder 4. Language Requirements: English-taught programs: Applicants should be native English speakers or come from countries with English as the official language; otherwise, they should provide a valid English test certificate such as IELTS≥6.5, TOEFL≥80, or TOEFL Essentials≥9 (DI Code: 806). 5. Applicants should be friendly to China, law-abiding, without any criminal records.

If you want to book our translation service , please pay and book it at least 2 weeks before the application deadline for submission of all documents; If you want to book our guardian service , you need to pay and book it 2 months before the application deadline, just in case your application fails because of failed to submit application documents on time. * 1. Study and Research Plan * 2. Physical Examination Form (With all lab and X-ray test reports) * 3. Two recommendation letters Written in English or Chinese from two respectable professors. including professors' contact no, email address and handwritten signature * 4. fields.description: Program Description 1. Program Introduction Editor Notes: This program includes three parts, which are Chinese culture and natural science courses, other 6 courses, and internship. The basic courses in 5-level are prone to strengthening the students’ abilities of listening, speaking, reading, writing. As students' Chinese levels are different, translation will be offered accordingly. There are some relevant culture courses like calligraphy, Chinese painting, Taiji Boxing (the Chinese shadow boxing), Chinese gardens, etc. This program includes 6 levels and every level is for one semester. Students who pass final exam will study the high grade of Chinese Course in the next semester. 2. Program Structure Editor Notes: This progam can be divided into 6 levels. 2.1 Level A 1）Teaching Objectives Suits the beginners of Chinese language, which focuses on training the students to use the simple Chinese in daily communication. When finishing this course, students are required to master 50 basic Chinese grammatical points, 900 words, basic simple sentence patters and some basic conversation modes and language functions, having the ability of making simple conversation on the most common topics in daily life. 2) Courses Listening,Conversation,Reading & writing 2.2 Level B 1）Teaching Objectives Suits the students who have mastered more than 800 Chinese vocabularies. After about four months study, the students basically shall be able to understand familiar and short sentences in daily social life, and can introduce themselves or other people simply, can communicate with others on familiar topics. the course especially pays attention to the training of the students’ knowledge and ability of HSK. 2) Main Courses Listening and speaking Reading & writing Extensive reading ​2.3 Level C 1）Teaching Objectives Aims to develop the students' ability of oral communication, and students’ reading and writing ability with the proficient use of new words, to comprehensively improve the communicative competence of listening, speaking, reading and writing for Intermediate level learners. The students are required to master about 800 multiplex words and about 120 ways of expression. 2) Main Courses Reading & writing Listening &speaking Newspaper Reading Chinese Writing 2.4 Level D 1）Teaching Objectives Aims to develop students' ability in Chinese through relatively separate and mutually complementary listening and speaking exercises, and acquire 200 Chinese idioms and traditional sayings. Students are also encouraged to contribute with texts and problems from their ongoing course or project work. 2) Main Courses Reading and Writing Listening &speaking Newspaper Reading Chinese Writing 2.5 Level E 1）Teaching Objectives Emphasis on outlining the overall features of the Chinese culture and describing dynamically its heritage. The students are required to take an active part in analysis, comparison, exchange and discussion in class to enrich their relevant knowledge. The materials are mainly selected from Chinese and foreign movies and programs on TV according to students’ interests and language proficiency. 2) Main Courses Advanced Chinese Reading &Writing Chinese Culture Chinese Writing Advanced AVO Chinese Timetable Sample 2.6 Class Size The minimum size of each class is 15 and the average is about 20. 2.7 Completion certificate Completion certificate will be awarded to students who passed the final exam. ​3. School Introduction Editor Notes: Shanghai University is well-known for its vigorous international exchanges and cooperation. ​ Shanghai University is one of the key universities in the "Project 211". The current president of the university is Professor CHIEN Weichang, a famous educator, scientist, social activist and member of Chinese Academy of Sciences. The Party Secretary of Shanghai University is Professor YU Xinhui and the Executive Vice President is Professor ZHOU Zhewei , Learn More>> 4. College of International Exchange Editor Notes: The School has built up academic links and cooperated with lots of foreign universities. The School provides short- or long-term courses of Chinese language, culture, and economics. There are also lots of optional courses and special lectures. The School will offer services of visas, accommodation and emergency aids for international students. 5. What Students Say Editor Notes: The School has lots of international students. ​ Name: Ou Chen From:​ Kenya Program: International Trade Subject: Why does he choose SHU? "The large population, long history and rapid development in the economy make China wonderland for me. Meanwhile Shanghai, as the economic center of China means more opportunity for learning and self-development. After checking the website, I found that I could not only find majors I liked here, but also many fun loving companions. These are the reasons I chose Shanghai University." ​ Name: Victoria From: Russia Program: Chinese Language and Literature Subject: How to get into the campus "Getting used to life here is easy. You can try to find your compatriots, but if you can't, don't worry, go to the ISU (International Students Union) in the dormitory hall, and you will get help. But, I think the best way to get yourself inside is to find a Chinese peer. After that I believe you will soon have a group of Chinese friends. Of course, if you still have any problem, go to the CIE office for help." Name: Yang Ling From: Thailand Program: Sociology Subject: One sentence to freshman "Welcome to Shanghai University! Here we have beautiful environment as well as many athletic facilities. In turn, you should work really hard, and you will find studying here is a real strain. After all, I believe studying abroad in Shanghai University will be your most cherished experience and you will also have deep love for this city." 6. Campus Life Editor Notes: International students enjoy the wonderful life in the campus.

fields.requirements: Entry Requirements 1. Applicants must be non-Chinese citizens with a valid passport. For applicants who used to be Chinese citizens but later immigrated to other countries, the conditions set by the Document No. 12 (2020) of Ministry of Education of the Peoples Republic of China should be met. 2. Applicants must have a bachelors degree and be under the age of 35. Applicants should be in good health and of good character, be well-behaved and be willing to abide by China's laws and regulations, as well as the university rules. 3. Language proficiency requirements For Chinese-instructed program applicants: Students are required to submit HSK-5 certificates with a minimum score of 180. Native Chinese speakers and applicants who complete their undergraduate study in Chinese are allowed to be exempted from providing HSK Certificates.
fields.materials: Application Materials " * " means necessary documents that you must provide in your application. If you want to book our translation service , please pay and book it at least 2 weeks before the application deadline for submission of all documents; If you want to book our guardian service , you need to pay and book it 2 months before the application deadline, just in case your application fails because of failed to submit application documents on time. * 1. Study or Research Plan 1000 words at least, in Chinese or English You can download a template or sample from here . * 2. Study Experience Resume The start and end time of each education experience must be uninterrupted, and education level should start from senior high school. You can download a template or sample from here . * 3. Physical Examination Record for Foreigners The medical examinations must cover all the items listed and should be conducted after October, 2025. You can download a template or sample from here . 4. Applicants of School of Architecture are requested to submit E-work Collection and Video Presentation * 5. Acceptance Letter from TJU Supervisor Remember to upload it to the application system if you get the Acceptance Letter. You can download a template or sample from here . 6. Contacts of professors You can download a template or sample from here . * 7. Certificate of HSK * 8. Photocopy of passport (Ordinary passport expires after September 2026). * 9. Passport photo A recent passport-sized photo of the applicant * 10. Scan of notarized copy of the high school academic transcripts or scan of international standardization test results Applicants who will not graduate before the application deadline must provide their current academic transcript. In this case, the completed academic transcripts must be submitted before registration. * 11. Scanned Copy of Highest Diploma Scan copy of Pre-graduation Certificate is required if the applicant has not gained degree certificate before the application deadline. Once admitted, students are required to present their original Bachelor Degree Certificate with the Degree Authentication Document upon registration for enrollment qualification review. Students who fail the enrollment qualification review will be disqualified from enrollment. * 12. Two Recommendation Letters in English or Chinese from two professors or associate professors. You can download a template or sample from here . * 13. Applicants must submit scan of Certificate of Non-Criminal Records It should be valid within six months prior to the application date. (Fresh graduates are required to submit a certificate that shows the applicant's good record of conduct and performance in their university). 14. Published papers * 15. Digital Signature Please sign your name on a white paper, and send us a scan copy of it; We will only use it to help you digitally sign some related documents during the application process. Tips: For applicants who are in China: If you are an employee, you still need to provide employment separation certificate and your current residence permit. If you are a student, you need to provide transfer certificate, leaving certificate, certificate of attendance rate issued by previous school and your current residence permit.

requirements.text: Entry Requirements 1. Applicants must be non-Chinese citizens with a valid passport. For applicants who used to be Chinese citizens but later immigrated to other countries, the conditions set by the Document No. 12 (2020) of Ministry of Education of the Peoples Republic of China should be met. 2. Applicants must have a bachelors degree and be under the age of 35. Applicants should be in good health and of good character, be well-behaved and be willing to abide by China's laws and regulations, as well as the university rules. 3. Language proficiency requirements For Chinese-instructed program applicants: Students are required to submit HSK-5 certificates with a minimum score of 180. Native Chinese speakers and applicants who complete their undergraduate study in Chinese are allowed to be exempted from providing HSK Certificates.

materials.text: Application Materials " * " means necessary documents that you must provide in your application. If you want to book our translation service , please pay and book it at least 2 weeks before the application deadline for submission of all documents; If you want to book our guardian service , you need to pay and book it 2 months before the application deadline, just in case your application fails because of failed to submit application documents on time. * 1. Study or Research Plan 1000 words at least, in Chinese or English You can download a template or sample from here . * 2. Study Experience Resume The start and end time of each education experience must be uninterrupted, and education level should start from senior high school. You can download a template or sample from here . * 3. Physical Examination Record for Foreigners The medical examinations must cover all the items listed and should be conducted after October, 2025. You can download a template or sample from here . 4. Applicants of School of Architecture are requested to submit E-work Collection and Video Presentation * 5. Acceptance Letter from TJU Supervisor Remember to upload it to the application system if you get the Acceptance Letter. You can download a template or sample from here . 6. Contacts of professors You can download a template or sample from here . * 7. Certificate of HSK * 8. Photocopy of passport (Ordinary passport expires after September 2026). * 9. Passport photo A recent passport-sized photo of the applicant * 10. Scan of notarized copy of the high school academic transcripts or scan of international standardization test results Applicants who will not graduate before the application deadline must provide their current academic transcript. In this case, the completed academic transcripts must be submitted before registration. * 11. Scanned Copy of Highest Diploma Scan copy of Pre-graduation Certificate is required if the applicant has not gained degree certificate before the application deadline. Once admitted, students are required to present their original Bachelor Degree Certificate with the Degree Authentication Document upon registration for enrollment qualification review. Students who fail the enrollment qualification review will be disqualified from enrollment. * 12. Two Recommendation Letters in English or Chinese from two professors or associate professors. You can download a template or sample from here . * 13. Applicants must submit scan of Certificate of Non-Criminal Records It should be valid within six months prior to the application date. (Fresh graduates are required to submit a certificate that shows the applicant's good record of conduct and performance in their university). 14. Published papers * 15. Digital Signature Please sign your name on a white paper, and send us a scan copy of it; We will only use it to help you digitally sign some related documents during the application process. Tips: For applicants who are in China: If you are an employee, you still need to provide employment separation certificate and your current residence permit. If you are a student, you need to provide transfer certificate, leaving certificate, certificate of attendance rate issued by previous school and your current residence permit.

fields.requirements: Entry Requirements A Non-Chinese citizen, of the age between 18 and 24, with an educational background equal to high school graduation (or equivalent) or with the Bachelor of Science Degree, be healthy, with non-criminal record, from the English-spoken countries or IELTS score reaches 6.0, or TOEFL score reaches 82 (Other training certificate is not acceptable ), with each required subject of CSCA test should score over 50. Applicants who can not satisfy with these requirements, should choose our foundation programs. Medical foundation program(for MBBS, BDS, Pharmacy) is one-year program starts in September. The Science & Engineering foundation and Business & Management foundation program are one-semester program, which start in March. Note: Applicants score must reach 70% or more of subjects such as Mathematics, Physics, Chemistry and Biology (or Zoology and botany).

fields.description: Program Description ​ 1. Program Introduction Editor Notes: The clinical medicine program in ZZU ranks top of universities in China and holds many advantages. Students are to be taught with clinical and clinical interpersonal skills and get in contact with patients at an early stage. The theoretical teaching of clinical medicine combines well with students' clinical experiences arranged by ZZU. ZZU specially set up a Clinical Skills Training Centre for international students to master clinical skills so that they can receive timely and effective training. ZZU employs both domestic and international experts and professors to give lectures and students would have access to global patients to acquire practical and various experiences from different emergency cases. 2. Main Courses Editor Notes: The clinical medicine program offers about 14 courses for students during their study in ZZU. Anthroponomy Histo-embryology Physiology Biochemistry Pharmacology Pathology Preventive Medicine Microbiology Immunology Diagnostics Internal Medicine Surgery Obstetrics-gynecology Pediatrics 3. The MBBS Curriculum Editor Notes: During the 6 years' study, there are 12 semesters for the MBBS program. 4 key themes shall be emphasized and integrated: Human Biology in Health and Disease; Professional Skills: Diagnostic, Problem Solving, Effective Communication and Clinical Management; Population Health, Health Services, Economics, and Policy; Medical Ethics, Professional Attitudes, and Behaviour. Year I Semesters 1 and 2 Introduction to the Art and Science of Medicine (around 28 weeks) The Block aims to provide an introductory overview of the structure and function of the human body. This also aims to strengthen students’ foundation in basic and health sciences, give an overview of the processes of diseases and introduce the therapeutic strategies for modulating disease processes. From the beginning, students are encouraged to develop an understanding of the ethical and economic implications of modern medical care, medical humanities, as well as the importance of an approach to patient care that is based on sound scientific evidence. Year II Semesters 3 and 4 Respiratory System, Cardiovascular System, Urogenital System, Gastrointestinal System, Musculoskeletal System In the entire second year, the first semester and the first half of the second semester of Year 3, the curriculum is based on a ‘human systems’ approach. Through these nine interdisciplinary modules, each of around 4-5 weeks, students learn the structure and functions of the body systems through these modules as they relate to the patient both as an individual and as a member of a wider population group. Year III Semester 5 Central Nervous System, Head and Neck Block, Haematology and Immunology System Year III Semester 6 Endocrine System Integrated Block (A) (4 Weeks) Elective (around 12 weeks) Students are given the opportunities to take a "core-plus-option" approach to learning during the duration of at least 12 weeks. During the period, they are required to prepare for the undertaking of a health research project and are exposed to the clinical setting through various clinical visits and attachments. In addition, they are encouraged to follow voluntary and community services, participate in overseas exchanges and/ or initiate their own learning activities, which are subject to formal approval by the Elective Sub-Committee. Year IV Semesters 7 and 8 Integrated Block (B) (around 8 weeks) The Block adopts a 'life-cycle approach' to studying multi-system problems is introduced. The aim is to help students integrate the knowledge they have acquired during the earlier parts of the curriculum and prepare them for the subsequent clerkships. Junior Clerkship, Medicine Block, Surgery Block, Multidisciplinary Block, (around 8 weeks each) The emphasis shifts to the clinical management of patients. During the clerkship phases, students are directly involved in the day-to-day care of patients. They are expected to understand the basic concepts that underlie their patients’ problems and apply the knowledge they have gained in earlier parts of the course. Much emphasis is put on the clinical aspects of care in diagnosis, treatment and patient management. Students learn to apply their clinical and clinical interpersonal skills in an increasingly sophisticated fashion. During the period of the Specialty Clerkship, students are required to reside in the Madam S.H. Ho Residence for Medical Students or in an approved teaching hospital for specified periods. Year V Semester 9 Senior Clerkship, Medicine Block, Surgery Block, Multidisciplinary Block, (around 8 weeks each) Year V/VI Semesters 10 and 11 Specialty Clerkship, Medicine Block, Surgery Block, O&G Block, O&T/Emergency Medicine Block, Psychiatry/Family Medicine, and Primary Care Block, Paediatrics & Adolescent Medicine Block, (around 8 weeks each) Year VI Semester 12 Revision Block Final Examination Elective The tenth semester comprises a revision block preceding the Final Examination, which is followed by a 4-week elective. During the elective period, students can explore areas of individual interest by means of either clinical attachment or laboratory/clinical research. Students then proceed to a 4-week pre-internship program comprising practical tips workshops, hospital attachments, and orientations organized by the Hospital Authority and the hospitals. 4. Internship Editor Notes: Students can do their internships ZZU's 9 affiliated hospitals, which are all top hospitals in China. In the 6th year, students shall do their internship in China or outside China. Students could do their internships in the 9 affiliated hospitals. Although there is no limit to students' Chinese level when conducting an internship in China, students shall be able to communicate with patients simply. Students can do an internship with famous domestic hospitals in Beijing, Tianjin, Shanghai, Chongqing, Guangzhou, Xi'an, etc. since ZZU has cooperation and exchange agreement with them. Also, students could conduct an internship in medical institutes in the U.S., Germany, Japan, Canada, U.K., Swede, Norwegian, Denmark, Austria, Holland, etc. 5. Job Availability Editor Notes: After graduation, students could work in public or private hospitals or open their own clinic or go on further study. To get registered and practice medicine, the graduates can apply to take the medical licensing examination in the medical council. (The MBBS graduates of ZZU who have taken the medical licensing examinations have a high passing rate). According to the regulations in different countries, the students may need to do the degree accreditation first. An MBBS degree holder can find jobs in government and private hospitals, nursing homes or other health facilities. Also, one can start his own clinic or go on to further study for a master's degree. 6. Degree Awarded Editor Notes: If everything goes smooth, students will get their MBBS degree diploma. If meeting the degree regulations of the host institution, international medical undergraduates will be granted a graduation certificate and conferred a medical degree by the host institution upon completing the requirements of the teaching program and passing the graduation examinations successfully. The English copy of the degree will state MBBS (Bachelor of Medicine and Bachelor of Surgery). Students have to take the final examination on Theory Test and Clinical Evaluation in ZZU before graduation. After attending the graduation ceremony, students can get a diploma. 7. Affiliated hospitals of ZZU Editor Notes: The comprehensive strength of ZZU's 9 affiliated hospitals ranks top in China. The 9 affiliated hospitals of ZZU include 8 Grade III Class A hospital and 1 Grade II-Class A hospital. As for the 9 hospitals, there are more than 15,000 beds, reaching 400,0000 out-patients per year. With strong and proud technical capability and advanced equipment, the hospitals could have 300 international students of undergraduate clinical medical majors do their internships at the same time. 8. Faculty Editor Notes: The Clinical Medicine Department of ZZU has strong teaching resources. The school owns 2 academicians, 19 special professors at the provincial level, 48 guest professors,44 Ph.D.supervisors, 269 MA student supervisors, 150 doctor teachers, and 397 master teachers. With over 30% of the teachers who have studied or worked overseas, full English-medium classed can be conducted absolutely. ZZU invites outstanding graduates to be back to school as the tutor of some crucial and key courses. 9. Experimental facilities Editor Notes: ZZU provides a great platform for students' clinical-stage skills training with its complete and advanced laboratories and experimental centers. ZZU has invested to build up specified clinical skills experimental centers for international students, including Clinical anatomy laboratory, Surgical skill laboratory, internal medicine skills laboratory, etc. These laboratories are set up with Simulated Operation Room, Animal Laboratory, Electronic patient training room, Simulated ward, ICU ward, Clinical Specimen Exhibition Hall, etc. These advanced teaching instruments and equipment cover various experimental teaching functions in internal medicine, chirurgery, Obstetrics and Gynecology as well as Pediatrics, etc. 10. Introduction to ZZU Editor Notes: ZZU is supported by “The Midwest Universities Comprehensive Strength Promotion Project” and Co-sponsored by the Henan Provincial Government and the Ministry of Education. At present, the enrolled number of full-time students in Zhengzhou University is over 36,000, with 6,639 graduate students and 342 international students. The University Library contains about 4.2 million volumes and 1.05 million volumes of electrical books. It has altogether four campuses, i.e. the New Campus, the South Campus, the Institute of Technology and the Medical School. Learn More about Zhengzhou University. 11. The Medical School Editor Notes: The Medical School of ZZU is one of the three earliest universities that conduct full English-medium undergraduate clinical medicine in China. One of the earliest Chinese medical higher education institutions recognized by WHO (World Health Organization) and approved to offer master and doctor degree programs in China. One of the earliest universities offering EMI (English Mediated Instruction) medical programs in China. More than 1000 undergraduate students have completed their medical studies with degrees since 2000. For Now, about 940 undergraduate students are studying medicine in Zhengzhou Universities who are from Nepal, India, Pakistan, Bangladesh, Saudi Arabia, Syria, Eritrea, Botswana, Myanmar, Peru, Maldives, Zimbabwe, the U.S.A., Canada, Austria, the UK, etc. 12. Extracurricular Activity Editor Notes: Zhengzhou University has many interesting Extracurricular Activities for international students. International Student Football Team Students Learning Calligraphy

fields.description: Program Description 1. Course Introduction Editor Notes: This program fosters engineering and technical talents suiting the world aviation industry development needs. Students gain the following knowledge and ability: Comprehensive professional education of aircraft design and maintenance; Master the technologies and theory of related fields, including mechanics, materials science, electronics, measurement and control, market economy and other basic knowledge; Professional knowledge of broad aircraft design and maintenance and have comprehensive ability and engineering innovation capabilities. 2. Main Subjects and Courses Editor Notes: There are two main subjects -- basic medicine and clinical medicine as well as 16 main courses for the program: Semester 1: Engineering Graphics 1, Linear Algebra 1, Algebra & Trigonometry 1, Programming in C Language 1, Orientation Program 1, Basic Chinese Speaking 1, Comprehensive Chinese(1) 1, An Introduction to China 1, Physical Education 1-7 Semester 2: An Introduction to Aeronautics, Calculus for Engineering Sciences (1), Physics (1), Physics Experiments (1), Basic Chinese Listening, Comprehensive Chinese (2), Chinese Culture 2, Calculus for Engineering Sciences (2), Essential English Writing Semester 3: Physics Experiments (2) 3, Physics (2), Comprehensive Chinese (3), Academic English Writing, Engineering Training, Engineering Economics, Reading in Chinese, Communication in Chinese, Information Retrieval & Utilization Semester 4: Numerical Analysis, Mathematics Foundation for Information System, Electronic Circuit, Engineering Electromagnetic Field, Digital Circuit, Course Project: Electrical & Electronic Technique, Electronic Circuit Experiment, Principles of Communication, FPGA and its Applications, Probability & Statistics, Matlab Applications, Intermediate Chinese Semester 5: Control System Engineering, Electric Machinery, Analogue Electronics, Microwave Technique and Antenna, Signals and Systems, An Introduction to Industrial Engineering , Project Management, Chinese-to-English Translation, Software Engineering, Random Signal Analysis Semester 6: Power Electronics Technology, Electric Power Engineering, Principles of Micro-computer, Linear Control Systems, Positioning and Navigation System, Principles and Applications of DSP, Digital Image Processing, Speech Signal Processing, Basic Writing in Chinese 6 Semester 7: Modern Testing Technology, Digital Signal Processing, Modern Control Theory, Flight Control System, Digital Control System: Theory and Design, Aerospace Power Supply System, Digital Control in Power Electronics, Spread Spectrum Communication, Professional Ethics, Multi-media Technology & Applications Semester 8: Graduation Project 3. Future Career Fields After Graduation​ Editor Notes: The prospect of employment looks very promising. Aircraft Production and Design Industries Robotics and Mechanical Engineering Industries Unmanned Aerial Vehicle (UAV), Drones Air and Space-based telecommunication industries Aircraft Maintainance Industries Further Research Military Service and other related technology-intensive fields 4. Accreditation Editor Notes: Accredited by the Ministry of Education, China. NUAA's degree is accepted worldwide. NUAA's International Link: NUAA's degree allows you to take your project in China, your home country or a third country. NUAA has partnered with top universities in the USA, Australia, and EU where some students take their third or fourth year of study. Career Prospects: NUAA recent graduates have been employed by organizations such as: 5. Brief Introduction to Nanjing University of Aeronautics and Astronautics Editor Notes: NUAA is now a comprehensive university especially featured with Aerospace Engineering. Nanjing University of Aeronautics and Astronautics(NUAA), established in 1952, enjoys a well-balanced development of multiple disciplines in natural sciences, humanities, social sciences, management, etc. with the characteristics of aeronautics, astronautics and civil aviation. NUAA is among the first batch of national key universities entitled to award doctoral degree, master's degree and bachelor's degree. It is one of the 52 universities with graduate school in China, and it has also been listed in the "National Project 211" as one of the 100 key universities for the 21st century. Presently, NUAA has established international cooperation and exchange with more than 60 universities and institutions all over the world. Learn More about Nanjing University of Aeronautics and Astronautics 6. About IEC Editor Notes: IEC has carried out a wide range of multi-level and diversified international cooperation education. The earliest institution in Jiangsu Province to set up Sino-foreign cooperatively-run schools. The aim is to cultivate an international higher vocational college with international vision and complementary advanced cultures between the East and the West. Carried out exchange student programs with high-level universities in the United States, Britain, France, Australia, Sweden and Ukraine. Joint training programs have been carried out with universities in Britain and Australia, and recruited students from nearly 20 countries. Rapid development of school-running scale and the continuous improvement of school-running quality is distinctive international education characteristics.

fields.requirements: Entry Requirements 1. Age requirements: 16 to 30 years old. If the applicant is under 18 years old (born after October 30, 2007) at the time of application, they must provide information of their legal guardian and a guardianship authorization signed by all three parties. 2. Nationality requirements: Non-Chinese citizens holding foreign passports. The nationality requirement must comply with the Nationality Law of the People's Republic of China and relevant regulations of the Ministry of Education of China. 3. Basical requirements: good health, friendly towards China, and non-criminal record. 4. CSCA subjects requirements: (1) The compulsory subjects for GXMU are mathematics and chemistry. (2) Applicants for the undergraduate clinical medicine program (taught in English) (MBBS) must choose the English test paper and do not need to provide Chinese subject scores; 5. Applicants for the clinical medicine program (taught in English) must provide an IELTS (total score > 5.5, item score > 5), or a TOEFL iBT (total score ≥ 70), or a TOEFL iTP (total score ≥ 450), or a Duolingo score > 90) transcript; or other English scores recognized by our university.

If you want to book our translation service , please pay and book it at least 2 weeks before the application deadline for submission of all documents; If you want to book our guardian service , you need to pay and book it 2 months before the application deadline, just in case your application fails because of failed to submit application documents on time. * 1. Passport Photo Page Copy -A clear, full-color scan of your passport information page, showing your name, passport number, expiration date, and photo. -Some universities may also require blank visa pages, so you are advised to upload a few blank pages as well. -The passport must be valid for 2 months beyond the enrollment date. * 2. Photo -A recent passport-sized ID photo (2 x 2 inches) with a plain white background. -Full face visible, no headwear (except for religious reasons). -Taken within the last 6 months. * 3. Highest Degree Graduation Certificate -A formal graduation certificate of your highest completed education level (e.g., Senior High School, Bachelor’s, or Master’s degree). -If the document is not in Chinese or English, it must be translated into Chinese or English and notarized by an authorized translation agency or relevant authority. Self-translations are not accepted. * 4. Highest Degree Academic Transcripts -Formal academic transcripts of your highest completed education level (e.g., Senior High School, Bachelor’s, or Master’s degree), covering ALL academic years, NOT just the final year. -If the document is not in Chinese or English, it must be translated into Chinese or English and notarized by an authorized translation agency or relevant authority. Self-translations are not accepted. * 5. English proficiency test certificate * 6. Study plan A study plan of more than 500 words, focusing on the study plan of the applied major. Applicants must write in the language of the applied major. * 7. 3-minute video Record in the language of the applied major. * 8. Physical Examination Form -Download the form template, print it, and bring it to a a Chinese Embassy's designated hospital for the required medical tests. The hospital will complete the form with your results. -The medical examination must cover all items listed on the form. -Ensure your photo is attached and the form is stamped and signed by the hospital after the examination. -The medical results are valid for 6 months only. -Forms that are incomplete, lack a final physician’s suggestion, missing the attending physician’s signature, official hospital stamp, or applicant’s sealed photo or contain abnormal examination results will be considered invalid. -The document must be in English or Chinese. You can download a template or sample from here . * 9. Non-criminal Record Certificate -Please note that this document is generally valid for only 6 months. For instance, if you submit your application in March, your non-criminal record must have been issued no earlier than September of the previous year. -Obtain this certificate from the local police station of your current residence, confirming that you have had no criminal record during the 6 months prior to the date of issuance. -If you are currently in China, the certificate must be issued by the local Chinese police. -If the document is not in Chinese or English, it must be translated and notarized by an authorized agency or relevant authority. Self-translations are not accepted. * 10. Financial Proof Bank statement showing at least 1 year of study and living expenses. * 11. Personal CV/Resume -Submit a resume or CV to help the university better understand your background. -Written in Chinese or in English. Your resume must include a complete and continuous list of your education and work experience, covering all periods up to the time you apply to university, without missing a single year or month. -Some universities may require you to use their designated CV templates, which must be downloaded and completed accordingly. * 12. Once the updates are ready, you can check the attachment and information here for this university for the latest information. If no attachment is available yet, it usually means the university has not announced further details. -The compulsory subjects for GXMU are mathematics and chemistry. Applicants for the undergraduate clinical medicine program (taught in English) (MBBS) must choose the English test paper and do not need to provide Chinese subject scores; Applicants for other programs must choose the Chinese test paper and must provide STEM Chinese; Tips: For applicants who are in China: If you are an employee, you still need to provide employment separation certificate and your current residence permit. fields.description: Program Description 1. Program Description Editor Notes: This program aims to train international medical health care service talents. This program will refer to international standards for medical education, mainly aiming at cultivating internationally universal medical practitioner with substantial medical preclinical knowledge, normative clinical skills & favorable professional quality, taking international requests of source countries of international students the requests of the students to return to their motherland to serve other country into appropriate accounts, allowing the graduates to become practitioner to offer service of medical treatment, education research in medical health care service sectors. Lectures of this major will be given in English all the way to top students of all countries in the world who aspire to study research medical science. Graduates may participate in the Examination of Doctors Qualifications as per the relevant rules of the countries after graduation. 2. Major courses Editor Notes: This program will provide different kinds of courses for international students. Systematic Anatomy, Biochemistry, Physiology, Pathology, Pharmacology, Microbiology, Preventive medicine, Evidence-based Medicine, Diagnostics, Introduction to Surgery, Internal Medicine, Surgery, Obstetrics & Gynecology, Pediatrics, Infectious Diseases, Neurology, Psychiatry, Medical Ethics, Chinese, etc. 3. University Size Editor Notes: Now GXMU has 5 affiliated hospitals and 11 11 Non-directly Administrated Affiliated Hospitals. Currently,GXMU has five affiliated hospitals under its direct administration. Among them, the first Affiliated Hospital, the Affiliated Tumor Hospital and the Hospital of Stomatology are the largest"Grade 3 Class A" hospital in Guangxi.They play a leading rolein higher medical education,medical scientific research and health services in Guangxi Zhuang Autonomous Region. GXMU has 11 Non-directly Administrated Affiliated Hospitals in 7 major cities of Guangxi.These hospitals are the largest hospitals in these cities and they are also teaching hospitals of GXMU. 4. Scientific Research Innovation Editor Notes: GXMU has advantages in scientific research and has won fund project and grants. GXMU has advantages in the researches on common diseases and frequently-occuring diseases in Guangxi and reached the international advanced level, such as prevention and treatment of regional high-incidence tumor, prevention and treatment of thalassernia,hemoglobin research,snake venom research,prevention and treatment of cardiovascular disease,drug research,liver transplantation,finger repantation,perlpheral blood stem cell transplantation,etc. Since the 11th Five-Year Plan,GXMU has won one National Key R&D project,one National Social Science Fund project, and has won grants from the National Science Foundation of China for 808 research projects,ranking in the forefront of universities in Guangxi. Researchers of GXMU have published 3079 SCI papers in top internatiinal journals such as New England Journal of Medicine, Nature Biotechnology and Nature Genetics as the first author or correspondent.More than 270 projects have won National Science and Technology Award,Ministry of Education Science and Technology Award,Guangxi Science and Technology Progress Award and Guangxi Science Award. 5. Joint Degree Program Editor Notes: GXMU will provide more and more joint degree program in the near future. In 2013, the joint bachelor's degree program in Information Management and Information Systemin collaboration with Western Oregon University,USA was approved by the Education Department of Guangxi Zhuang Autonomous Region. In 2014, the joint bachelor's degree program in Public Service Administration in collaboration with Western Oregon University,USA was approvedby the Ministry of Education. 6. University Brief Introduction Editor Notes: Guangxi Medical University is recognized by the WHO. Guangxi Medical University (GXMU), founded in 1934, is one of the 22 oldest medical institutes in China and one of the first 8 qualified to enroll international students. It is located in a border city-Nanning, capital of Guangxi Zhuang Autonomous Region. The school covers an area of 98.8 acres and enrolls 8,800 students. Beginning in 1978, international education in GXMU has become rather mature and complete. Currently, more than 300 foreign students from Vietnam, Indonesia, Nepal, India, Africa, Oceania, Europe, and the United States are studying here. The Clinical Medicine in Chinese was set up in 1978, and the English-medium program started in 2001. GXMU has rich experiences in medical education. And, there were graduates for years; the average rate of acquiring Medical License is 90%. In 2008, the English-medium MBBS program is recognized by MOE as the first batch of qualified universities. Now it recruits about 700 international students from India, Nepal, Vietnam, Indonesia, Mauritius, and Sri Lanka, etc. GXMU is recognized by WHO and the graduates of MBBS program are eligible to take the Medical Licensing Examinations held by the medical councils in different countries such as MCI, PMDC, USMLE, HPCSA, SCHS, etc. Learn More>> 7.Campus Life Editor Notes: Students will have a wonderful campus life in GXMU. Campus Gate Xinghu Lake SIE Building
