fields.description: Program Description 1. Introduction to Chinese Language Program Editor Notes: The course is taught in Chinese and provides different levels of study. The program is divided into Elementary Level (A, B), Intermediate Level (C, D), and Advanced Level (E). In total, there are 18-week courses a term. Study Place: OUC Fushan Campus, No.23 Eastern HongKong Road. 2. Main Courses Editor Notes: This program offers 8 main courses for international students. Intensive Reading Spoken Chinese Reading Listening Comprehension Chinese Culture Chinese Writing Reading of Chinese Newspaper Reading of Chinese Periodicals Contents for Chinese culture Week Topic Week Topic 1 Introduction: Dos and Don’ts 7 Great Thinkers and Philosophers 2 Chinese Cuisine 8 Chinese Education 3 Chinese Languages 9 Chinese Religion 4 New China and Influencing Figures 10 Chinese Literature and Art 5 Chinese Customs 11 Chinese Festivals 6 Chinese Dynasties and Historical Events 12 Chinese Medicine and Massage, Qigong 3. Sample Curriculum Editor Notes: This curriculum is for reference only. Class Time Monday Tuesday Wednesday Thursday Friday Class A 08:00 - 9:50 Spoken Chinese Chinese Character Spoken Chinese Intensive Reading Spoken Chinese 10:10 -12:00 Intensive Reading Listening Intensive Reading Listening Intensive Reading Class B 08:00 - 9:50 Spoken Chinese Intensive Reading Listening Spoken Chinese Intensive Reading 10:10 - 12:00 Listening Spoken Chinese Intensive Reading Intensive Reading Listening Class C 08:00 - 9:50 Intensive Reading Listening and Speaking Intensive Reading Intensive Reading Intensive Reading 10:10 - 12:00 Reading Writing Reading Listening and Speaking Listening and Speaking Class D 08:00 - 9:50 Listening and Speaking Listening and Speaking Writing Listening and Speaking Intensive Reading 10:10 -12:00 Intensive Reading Reading Reading Intensive Reading Writing Class E 08:00 - 9:50 Audio-Visual Chinese Business Chinese Chinese News Reading Business Chinese Chinese News Reading 10:10 - 12:00 Intensive Reading Intensive Reading Audio-Visual Chinese Audio-Visual Chinese Intensive Reading 4. Time and Duration Editor Notes: Here is the time arrangement and application time. 4.1 Time of Entrance Spring Semester: First Monday of March Fall Semester: First Monday of September 4.2 Duration of Study 1/2-2 years 4.3 Time of Application Spring Semester: The End of February Fall Semester: The End of August 5. School Introduction Editor Notes: Ocean University of China is a comprehensive university under the direct jurisdiction of the State Ministry of Education. There are over 20,000 registered students at Ocean University of China , including 4,500 Master's and Doctoral students and over 500 international students. Among the 2,300 faculty members there are many nationally and internationally recognized experts and scholars, 8 academicians of the Chinese Academy of Sciences and 5 academicians of Chinese Academy of Engineering. Ocean University of China (hereinafter referred to as OUC) is located in Qingdao, a renowned summer resort and an attractive historic tourist city of scenic beauty and temperate climate. Learn More about Ocean University of China. 6. International Education Center Editor Notes: OUC is now offering a large range of programs to international students, including some tailor-made programs. Each year more than 1300 international students from over 50 countries pursue their Certificate/Diploma/Bachelor's degree/Master's degree/Ph.D in our university. Our programs, especially known for their high standards of teaching and considerate services have been attractive to students from all over the world. Various cooperation has been set up with world-famous universities from different countries, such as Germany, USA, U.K. Russia, Japan, Malaysia, Thailand, Indonesia etc. 7. Campus Life Editor Notes: Various activities will be organized usually and students lead a rich and colorful life. (Tai Chi Show) ​ (Chinese Contest)

fields.description: Program Description This program is ideal for anyone wishing to advance their knowledge, skills, ability and career prospects in business. Business Management is a broad subject incorporating the business, economics, finance, and marketing among other relevant disciplines. Traning Target During the three years, you will study a broad range of subjects, explore several career paths as it develops your knowledge in a diverse range of sectors in the 21st century. Curriculum Economics Mathematics for Business English for Academic Purposes (EAP) Business Studies Business Economics Business Skills Organisational Behaviour Business Statistics Management Themes Marketing Strategic Planning: Shaping the Future Financial Fluency for Management Decision Making Academic and Professional Development Integrated Marketing Communications Managing an International Business Responsible and Ethical Business Practice Implementing Strategy and Change International Business Consultancy Project Financial Performance Management Managing the Digital Enterprise Marketing in a Global Context Leadership in Contemporary Organisations Career Plan Some students proceed to Master studies while others gain employment in all types of sectors and organizations. After graduation, students are extremely well-positioned in the job market given that they hold a highly-regarded and internationally recognized degree from a respected U.K. university, but they also have international experience and language skills that enable them to stand out amongst peers. After graduation, you will have the experience and skills to analyze a commercial opportunity, manage a project, solve problems, be able to operate in different cultures, communicate with other people and ultimately lead them. Internship&Job Sino-British College, USST offers lots of internships opportunities for students. Their career services department will deliver the newest information about the internship both on-campus and off-campus. Just contact them directly for application after school begins. Extracurricular Activities In Sino-British College, USST, you can engage in whatever activities you want. There are various student societies range from business practice societies and arts & culture societies to learning society and technology innovation society.

fields.description: Program Description Program Overview Training objective This program is aimed at training the cross-century talents that could adapt to the development trend of economic globalization and China's "going out" development goals. It requires students to master solid basic theory about economics with global view and advanced concept in such open economy. And the students should have good command of English, understand the leading commerce pattern, be capable of adapting to the ceaseless changes of both international and domestic economic development, and master the basic ability to participate in international competition and engage in the management of the international market. Program Description This program requires students to systemically master the basic theory and rich knowledge of world economics and international trade, to know modern management methods and skills, and have strong problem analyzing and solving abilities. Main courses: Political Economics, Microeconomics, Macroeconomics, World Economics, International Trade, International Business, International Investment Theory and Practice, International Trade Practice, etc. International students are exempt from the Political Theory, Physical Education, Military Theory, Ideological and Moral Education and Foreign Language. Main practical training: Students are trained to participate in the practical work in governmental executive departments or commercial enterprises and write internship report. Internship A scattered practice methodology is adopted for internship. And it is normally arranged at the end of the first semester in the senior year. Considering the discipline knowledge and unique major characteristics, inpidual students can seek internship opportunities in their home countries or in Chinese enterprises and institutions according to their own situation. Through practical training, the internship will prepare students with basic skills to work on practical cases and management. Moreover, the students could test their theoretical knowledge in practice, possess relative working experience and improve their comprehensive abilities through practice. It requires students to master solid basic theory about economics with global view and advanced concept in such open economy. Main courses: Political Economics, Microeconomics, Macroeconomics, World Economics, International Trade, International Business, International Investment Theory and Practice, International Trade Practice, etc. International students are exempt from the Political Theory, Physical Education, Military Theory, Ideological and Moral Education and Foreign Language. Internship A scattered practice methodology is adopted for internship. And it is normally arranged at the end of the first semester in the senior year. Considering the discipline knowledge and unique major characteristics, inpidual students can seek internship opportunities in their home countries or in Chinese enterprises and institutions according to their own situation. Through practical training, the internship will prepare students with basic skills to work on practical cases and management. Moreover, the students could test their theoretical knowledge in practice, possess relative working experience and improve their comprehensive abilities through practice. fields.description: Program Description 1. Program Overview Editor Notes: Students can not only have a depth knowledge in Integrative Biomedical Sciences, but also have developed a breadth of skills and experience in interpersonal skills, critical judgement and computer literacy. Integrative Biomedical Sciences is a multidisciplinary degree programme that provides opportunities to investigate the biomedical sciences in the 21st century. The core structure of the programme provides the knowledge, skills and personal and professional development appropriate to meet the needs of a future career as a leader in biomedical science. The programme provides opportunities to develop skills and knowledge in the biomedical, physcio-chemical and clinical sciences. In addition, in later years focused optional courses provide opportunities to explore the biomedical disciplines of physiology, pharmacology, neuroscience, immunology, reproductive biology, medical microbiology and developmental biology. Integrative Biomedical Sciences is founded on developing skills in academic research and scientific enquiry thereby encouraging awareness and understanding of the research that is needed to continue to advance clinical practice. Alongside a depth of knowledge in Integrative Biomedical Sciences, graduates will have developed a breadth of skills and experience, including interpersonal skills, critical judgement and computer literacy. 2. Programme Outcomes Editor Notes: The aim of this programme is to produce future leaders in the world of biomedical sciences. Over fours years, you will develop the knowledge and skills that will allow you to: Research the importance of research to the development of medicine and good health Understand how advances in knowledge result from scientific investigation Evaluate and discuss contemporary issues in the field of biomedical sciences Understand and apply research methodologies to the field of biomedical sciences Be able to independently research and analyse contemporary questions in the field of biomedical sciences 3. Program Structure Editor Notes: Students can reference to the courses outline information of four years' study from the following description. Year One: Biomedical Sciences in Context Year Two: Understanding Biomedical Sciences Year Three: Developing Knowledge Through Experiment Year Four: Research in Practice 4. Careers Editor Notes: Most graduates will engage in aboratory research, disease diagnosis, and scientific publishing. Graduates enter employment that requires an understanding of biomedical processes and the ability to research using scientific literature and other data sources. These careers include laboratory research, disease diagnosis, and scientific publishing. 5. Dual Degree Editor Notes: Students admitted to this international degree program are enrolled in both Zhejiang University and the University of Edinburgh. Students who successfully complete the program and meet the requirements of both universities will receive two bachelor's degrees in their respective major fields and a graduation certificate of ZJU: • Bachelor of Science (Honours) from the University of Edinburgh • Bachelor of Science from Zhejiang University • Graduation Certificate from Zhejiang University 6. About ZJU-UoE Institute(ZJE) Editor Notes: The Zhejiang University-University of Edinburgh Institute (ZJE) is a collaboration in the field of Biomedical Sciences between Zhejiang University of China and The University of Edinburgh, United Kingdom. The Zhejiang University-University of Edinburgh Institute (ZJE Institute) is a collaboration in the field of Biomedical Sciences between Zhejiang University of China and The University of Edinburgh, United Kingdom. The two universities established an international research institute at the International Campus of Zhejiang University in Haining, Zhejiang, that builds on the existing strengths of both, and aims to foster collaborations in teaching and research. The Institute provides undergraduate education programmes that produce students with academic excellence, leadership skills, innovative capacity and global vision. Top-tier Universities in the world Zhejiang University (ZJU) is one of China's oldest and most prestigious higher education institutions. It is ranked 53rd in the 2020/21 QS world University Rankings. Founded in 1583, The University of Edinburgh (UoE) has been providing students with world-class teaching for more than 400 years. It is one of the world's top universities, consistently ranked in the world top 50, and placed 20th in the 2020/21 QS World University Rankings. The University of Edinburgh is also ranked 4th in the UK for research power, based on the breadth and quality of its research. 7. School Introduction Editor Notes: Zhejiang University is a Public, 985 Project Comprehensive university. Zhejiang University is a national comprehensive university. Founded in 1897, it was initially known as "Qiushi Shuyuan" (Qiushi Academy), one of the earliest modern academies of higher learning established in China. Zhejiang University's fields of study cover philosophy, literature, history, education, science, economics, law, management, engineering, agriculture, medicine and etc. The university, now has 113 specialties for undergraduate studies, and it is entitled to confer master's degrees in 324 programs and primary (secondary) discipline doctoral degrees in 41 (252) programs, Learn More>> 8. Campus Life Editor Notes: International students enjoy a wonderful life on campus. Basketball Tournament ​ Mid-Autumn Festival Tea Party

fields.materials: Application Materials " * " means necessary documents that you must provide in your application. If you want to book our translation service , please pay and book it at least 2 weeks before the application deadline for submission of all documents; If you want to book our guardian service , you need to pay and book it 2 months before the application deadline, just in case your application fails because of failed to submit application documents on time. * 1. Study and Research Plan * 2. Physical Examination Form (With all lab and X-ray test reports) * 3. Two recommendation letters Written in English or Chinese from two respectable professors. including professors' contact no, email address and handwritten signature * 4. Bank Reference Letter The fund requirement shall be calculated according to the basic expenses (tuition, accommodation, living expenses, insurance, etc.) of the program that the applicant applied for. It is required that the corresponding amount be deposited in the applicant’s account for at least one month. If another person’s account is used, a certificate proving the relationship between the applicant and the account owner should be provided. The certificate should be notarized by the local government and verified by the local Chinese Embassy or consulate abroad. If the application materials are translated, they must be submitted after notarization. Master's applicants should have at least: Chinese-taught programs: 53000 RMB, English-taught programs: 55000 RMB. 5. Supervisor Acceptance Letter (Advisable) * 6. Non-Criminal Record Certificate * 7. English proficiency certificate Note: If you do not have IELTS or TOEFL, please provide an official certificate issued by your high school which should certify that the medium of instruction in your high school study is English. * 8. Photocopy of your Passport home page With name, passport number & expiration date, and photo included * 9. Passport photo Soft copy of your passport photo with blue background, photo size 480*720, JPG format * 10. Official transcripts of your grades in bachelor’s and translated copies in Chinese or English version The average score is more than 70% and GPA 3.0/5.0 above. * 11. Bachelor’s Graduation Certificate and translated copy in Chinese If you have not graduated yet, please get in touch with your current school to provide you with a “certificate of expected graduation”. 12. Supporting Documents: Certificate of Good Conduct Provided by your current/previous school/company in Chinese/English to improve your success rate. You can download a template or sample from here . Tips: For applicants who are in China: If you are an employee, you still need to provide employment separation certificate and your current residence permit. If you are a student, you need to provide transfer certificate, leaving certificate, certificate of attendance rate issued by previous school and your current residence permit.
fields.description: Program Description Program Introduction Geology is a program that studies material compositions, internal structure, and external features of the earth, mutual interactions between earths and the history of the evolution of earth. China University of Petroleum (Beijing) has undertaken several high-level scientific research programs and has sufficient funds to enable students of this major conduct excellent research under the guidance of renowned academicians and professors. Courses you'll take Sedimentology Sequence Stratigraphy Petroleum Reservoir Geology Research Areas Sedimentology and Palaeogeography Petrology and Reservoir Geology Sequence Stratigraphy and Logging Geology Organic Geochemistry Regional Structure and Basin Analysis Oil Region Structural Analysis Fossil Energy Formation and Enrichment Mechanism Palaeontology and Stratigraphy

fields.description: Program Description Name of the program : International Economics and Trade Duration : Four years Degree awarded: Bachelor of Economics Objectives The program is designed to educate advanced specialized personnel for doing business and management in international companies and conducting teaching and research on international trade. Requirements The students should master the basic theories in economics and management, the basic knowledge and skills of international trade, command a foreign language, and acquire the ability of analyzing and solving practical problems. After graduation, students can work in foreign economics and trade sectors, government agencies, and foreign enterprises. Learning goals Student should acquire the following knowledge and abilities: 1. Master the theories and methods of western economics and international economics; 2. Master the theories of international trade, China's foreign trade principles, policies and regulations; 3. Master the basic knowledge of social science and humanities; 4. Being able to apply the knowledge of measurement, statistics, accounting to analyzing real-world problems and conducting research; 5. Have the ability to work in international trade sectors; 6. Being proficient in a foreign language and competent in computer-based foreign activities.

Applicants for a master's degrees should have a bachelor's degree or equivalent and be generally no older than 35 years of age. 3. Language Ability Applicants for English-taught programs shall hold a TOEFL 80+, TOEFL Essential 8+ or IELTS 6.0+ certificate. Applicants whose mother tongue is English or who have previous degrees taught through the medium of English can be exempted from TOEFL, TOEFL Essential and IELTS if approved by Wuhan University. 4. Identity Verification of Ethnic Chinese If one or both of the applicant’s parents are Chinese, or the applicant has emigrated from the Chinese mainland, Hong Kong, Macao or Taiwan and acquired foreign nationality, according to the No. 12 Announcement of the Ministry of Education of the People’s Republic of China (2020), they shall be naturalized for four years or more (before Apr. 30, 2025) and have more than two years of residence in foreign countries during this period (actual residence in a foreign country of more than nine months in a year can be calculated as one year, subject to the entry and exit stamps). Applicants born in a foreign country are required to meet the above criteria and provide a personal birth certificate and the parents' nationality certificates. Applicants who have completed the previous studies as international students in China，are not included in this regulation.

fields.description: Program Description Program Introduction UESTC’s 22,000 undergraduate students benefit from studying in one of China’s foremost universities, where faculty devote their time and energy to imparting knowledge, guiding students and acting as paragons of virtue and learning. Established in 1956, UESTC holds a high reputation in Electronic Engineering field in china. The University is committed to building a diverse campus community to ensure that students explore their interests, discover new academic and extracurricular pursuits, and learn from each other. UESTC is making its education accessible to students from a broad range of culturals, ethnics and social status. Our curriculum encourages students to explore many disciplines and to develop a deep understanding in one area of concentration. English-instucted courses are offered in the undergraduate program in 5 majors. Qualified graduates are awarded graduation diploma and bachelor degree. And the minimum study period is 4 years.

High school graduate with high school diploma or above. 3. Friendly towards China, law-abiding, and no criminal record. Others If both or one of the parents is a Chinese citizen and resides in a foreign country, and the applicant who wants to come to China as a foreign student for undergraduate study has foreign nationality by birth, then the applicant must have a record of actual residence in a foreign country for more than 2 years within the last 4 years (as of April 30, 2025). (Nine (9) months of actual residence in a foreign country can be counted as one year, subject to the entry and exit seal stamps). If a Chinese citizen after emigrating abroad applies to come to China as a foreign student for undergraduate study, then they shall hold a valid foreign passport or certificate of nationality for more than 4 years, and a record of actual residence in a foreign country for more than 2 years within the last 4 years (as of April 30, 2025). (Nine (9) months of actual residence in a foreign country can be counted as one year, subject to the entry and exit seal stamps).

In case another person ’ s account is used, it is required to provide a certificate justifying the relationship between the applicant and the account owner. At the same time, the certificate should be notarized by local authorities and verified by a Chinese embassy or consulate abroad. Tips: For applicants who are in China: If you are an employee, you still need to provide employment separation certificate and your current residence permit. If you are a student, you need to provide transfer certificate, leaving certificate, certificate of attendance rate issued by previous school and your current residence permit.
fields.description: Program Description 1) Training requirements: 1. Adapted to all the four Chinese language abilities used in Chinese teaching environment, including listening, speaking, reading and writing skills 2. Master some basic professional knowledge 3. Gradually adapt to the teaching methods and learning methods of the university 4. Have the ability to learn and think independently. 2) Program categories Chinese Class (long term): The long-term class (more than half a year) enrolls students twice a year, starting in March and September respectively, with different levels: primary, intermediate and advanced courses. The core courses include: reading and writing, listening and speaking, reading, intensive reading, scientific Chinese, and Chinese culture, etc. According to the applicants’ application and class placement interview results, several small classes will be organized for teaching. Each class will have listening, speaking, reading and writing courses to comprehensively develop students' four skills. Classes will run from Monday to Friday. Every week 22-30 class hours will be arranged. In addition, there will be special tutoringcourses for HSK. ※ During the epidemic, online Chinese language classes will be provided. After the outbreak, the registration fee will be waived for online students who continue to study offline. 3) Completion and further education Upon completion: Students who pass the required courses and obtain the required credits will be awarded the Certificate of Completion for Chinese Language Training issued by the Institute of International Education. Further education: Students who have completed all the teaching procedures prescribed in the training program and passed the undergraduate qualification examination can directly enter the undergraduate program of our university. Those who do not meet the eligibility criteria for completion or fail to pass the qualification examination for admission to the undergraduate program may continue to study in the language program until they pass.

fields.description: Program Description Speak Mandarin only 24/7 in old China capital Live and eat with a Chinese homxestay family. Visit the UNESCO World heritage places. 1 on-1 classes only (no foreign class mates) Activities with locals-from football to Chinese chess and hiking clubs (Mandarin-speak only) -Flexibility- weekend or whole week program available ​-Includes return transfers between Beijing and Chengde Cheng de (not Chengdu!) was the Qing Emperors’ summer residence and the place where standard Mandarin Chinese was codified in 1952. The city is located about two hour north-east of Beijing. Here people speak most “standard” Mandarin in all of china, but not a work in English. . The city is a UNESCO World Heritage site, is located in the mountains with plenty of fresh air and has no expat community. Here you will speak Mandarin only all day and be completely immersed into a Chinese language and culture environment. Students study the first half of the program in Beijing and the second in Chengde. This is for students who are looking for the quickest language progress possible. It also offers the great experience of living in a big metropolitan city as well as a smaller more traditional town like Chengde. The total immersion environment in Chengde is especially helpful in helping students’ language skills to progress very quickly. We have 3 different Immersion Program course options for you to choose from LTL Chinese Immersion Programs Chinese Immersion Standard Chinese Immersion Intensive Chinese Immersion & Culture Chinese Immersion Individual Part One: Beijing 20h/wk small group 20h/wk small group & 10h 1-on-1 20h/wk small group & 10h Chinese Culture Classes 20h/wk 1-on-1 Part Two: Chengde 20h/wk 1-on-1 30h/wk 1-on-1 10h/wk 1-on-1 & 10h Chinese Culture Classes 20h/wk 1-on-1 Duration 4, 6, 8, 12 or 16 weeks 4, 6, 8, 12 or 16 weeks 4, 6, 8, 12 or 16 weeks 4, 6, 8, 12or 16 weeks Pricing: Total Prices, CNY Total 4 wks Total 6 wks Total 8 wksL Total 10 wks Total 12 wks Total 14 wks Total 16 wks extra 2 wks Chinese Immersion Standard 14,810 19,837 24,381 28,439 32,337 37,223 42,069 4,846 Chinese Immersion Intensive 22,483 30,862 38,435 45,199 51,761 59,838 67,915 8,077 Chinese Immersion Individual 18,646 25,350 31,408 36,819 42,069 48,531 54,992 6,462

Other supporting documents Applicants who have either one or both parents possess Chinese citizenship but are long-term/permanent residents in China were already in possession of foreign citizenship by the time of birth. This type of applicant should provide the following documents: past ID information of both parents during the applicant’s time of birth in photocopy form current ID information of both parents in photocopy form Documents certifying the applicant forfeited Chinese citizenship for at least 4 (four) years applicant’s birth certificate that proves non-Chinese nationality or acquisition of foreign citizenship 15. Others Applicants who were previously Chinese nationals but have acquired citizenship from another country need to provide: Documents certifying that the applicant has successfully acquired foreign citizenship Documents certifying the applicant forfeited Chinese citizenship for at least 4 (four) years Deactivation of Chinese citizenship that was previously in possession * 16. fields.requirements: Entry Requirements 1. Applicants must be non-Chinese citizens with valid foreign passports. 2. Applicants must abide by the rules and regulations of Chinese laws and schools, be of good character and respect Chinese social customs and habits. 3. Applicants must meet one of the following academic conditions: An official transcript of the applicant’s highest educational degree (original copy and Chinese or English notarized copy) Graduation transcripts of national/district unified high school Scores of an internationally recognized standardized test (Such as the SAT/ACT/A-Level/ AP/IB, etc.) 4. Applicant is physically and mentally healthy, has no serious diseases, infectious diseases or serious physical defects. Applicant must pass the required physical medical examination. 5. Non-native English speaking applicants who apply for programs taught in English are required to provide TOEFL or IELTS scores. 6. All non-Chinese citizens with valid passports between 18-25 years old. i. Applicants under age 18 must submit relevant supporting documents upon arrival on campus by September 2022. ii.Applicants who once held Chinese nationality and then were naturalized as a foreign national or whose parents are both Chinese nationals and have both settled abroad, or one of whose parents is a Chinese national and has settled abroad, and who has acquired foreign nationality at birth shall hold valid foreign passport or certificate of nationality for no less than 4 years and have the record of having lived in a foreign country for more than 2 years in the recent 4 years (as of April 30th of the entry academic year).

fields.requirements: Entry Requirements 1. Applicants should be physically and mentally healthy and aged from 18—50. 2. Applicants should be non-Chinese nationality and have diploma at least higher than high school graduation certificate. According to the regulations issued by the Ministry of Education PRC, immigrated applicants who are originally citizens of China mainland, Hong Kong, Macao and Taiwan should get the foreign nationality before April 30, 2010 and have an actual residence record longer than 2 years after April 30, 2010. (The record will be examined by the entry and exit stamp on passport. Equal or more than 9 months actual residence record can be counted as one year). 3. Applicants should be capable of affording all the study and living cost in China.
fields.materials: Application Materials " * " means necessary documents that you must provide in your application. If you want to book our translation service , please pay and book it at least 2 weeks before the application deadline for submission of all documents; If you want to book our guardian service , you need to pay and book it 2 months before the application deadline, just in case your application fails because of failed to submit application documents in time. * 1. The Certified Copy of High School Diploma * 2. The Officially Certified Certificates of the Highest Diploma Academic transcript in languages other than Chinese or English should be translated into Chinese or English and be certified by notarization. * 3. Non-criminal Record Certificate -Please note that this document is generally valid for only 6 months. For instance, if you submit your application in March, your non-criminal record must have been issued no earlier than September of the previous year. -Obtain this certificate from the local police station of your current residence, confirming that you have had no criminal record during the 6 months prior to the date of issuance. -If you are currently in China, the certificate must be issued by the local Chinese police. -If the document is not in Chinese or English, it must be translated and notarized by an authorized agency or relevant authority. Self-translations are not accepted. * 4. Physical Examination Form -Download the form template, print it, and bring it to a hospital for the required medical tests. The hospital will complete the form with your results. -The medical examination must cover all items listed on the form. -Ensure your photo is attached and the form is stamped and signed by the hospital after the examination. -The medical results are valid for 6 months only. -Forms that are incomplete, lack a final physician’s suggestion, missing the attending physician’s signature, official hospital stamp, or applicant’s sealed photo or contain abnormal examination results will be considered invalid. -The document must be in English or Chinese. You can download a template or sample from here . * 5. Proof of deposit amounting to no less than 40,000 RMB or the equivalent in your local currency -Bank deposit certificate, with a minimum balance of RMB 40,000 or the equivalent amount in the applicant’s local currency. If it is a deposit certificate of the parents, a notarized certificate of kinship or a birth certificate must be provided. * 6. Passport photo A recent passport-sized photo of the applicant * 7. Passport (Pages with photo and visa) Tips: For applicants who are in China: If you are an employee, you still need to provide employment separation certificate and your current residence permit. If you are a student, you need to provide transfer certificate, leaving certificate, certificate of attendance rate issued by previous school and your current residence permit.
fields.description: Program Description Brief Introduction There are two time periods for language program application, respectively spring semester and autumn semester. The study time duration is both 18 weeks every semester. Students will be placed into 6 classes of three levels: beginner level, medium level and advanced level. Students who want to pursue degree program can apply to transfer from language program to the bachelor degree program of Chinese Language and Literature after taking relevant exams. Curricular outline Compulsory Courses 1.Comprehensive Chinese Courses at different levels; 2.Chinese Oral Courses at different levels; 3.Chinese Listening Courses at different levels; 4.Chinese Speaking and Listening Courses at intermediate and advanced levels; 5.Chinese Speaking and Listening Courses at advanced levels; 6.Chinese Fast Reading Course, Newspaper and Magazine Reading Course at intermediate and advanced levels; Select Courses in Various Forms 1.Cultural Courses: Chinese National Knowledge, Chinese Culture, Chinese History, Chinese Geography, Chinese Films; 2.Cultural Skills Courses: Chinese Painting, Chinese Calligraphy, Taijiquan (Shadowboxing), Chinese Folk Music, Erhu (Urheen), etc. 3.Economic and Trade Courses: Economic and Trade Oral Course, Economic and Trade Writing Course; 4.Literary Courses: Selected Reading of Literary Classics, Chinese Ancient Poetry, Chinese Literary History; 5.Chinese Language Practice Courses Through Experiencing Shaanxi Culture and Customs: Students will visit places of historical interests and scenic beauty, enjoy local dishes at farmers' homes and appreciate the farmers' paintings, etc.

fields.materials: Application Materials " * " means necessary documents that you must provide in your application. If you want to book our translation service , please pay and book it at least 2 weeks before the application deadline for submission of all documents; If you want to book our guardian service , you need to pay and book it 2 months before the application deadline, just in case your application fails because of failed to submit application documents in time. * 1. Passport photo Personal color photos (full face without hat), head account for 2/3 of photo size; no uniform or white coat; glasses required normally worn; white background, frame-less; clear portrait, rich gradation, and natural expression, without obvious distortion. * 2. Passport photocopy A clear copy of your valid passport with name, photo, birth date, place of birth, date of issue, and date of expiry clearly visible. Visa page is required for applicants who are currently living outside their country of residence. 3. Applicants under 16 years old are required to provide a Guardian’s Commitment Letter. * 4. Certificate/diploma of highest education Certificate in languages other than Chinese or English should be translated into Chinese or English and be certified by notarization. Both original and official English translated version are required. * 5. Academic transcript of highest education Academic Transcripts in languages other than Chinese or English should be translated into Chinese or English and be certified by notarization. Both original and official English translated version are required. * 6. Physical Examination Form Upload a valid "Foreigners' Physical Examination Record" (the standard form can be downloaded through the application system) issued within 6 months, which must include a detailed blood test report. Thedocument must be signed by a doctor, stamped with the hospital's official seal, and have the applicant's photo affixed (with a cross-seal). Incomplete information or non-compliance with requirements will be deemed invalid. You can download a template or sample from here . 7. A Self-introduction Video -Please speak in English or Chinese. -The video should be at least 2 minutes long, in MP4 format, and less than 7 MB. -Include a brief self-introduction, your study plan after enrollment, reasons for applying to this program and university in China, and your plans after graduation. -You may also highlight your language ability, interests, confidence, and motivation. * 8. Certificate of No Criminal Record A certificate issued within 6 months by the local police station or relevant authoritative institution in the applicant's country of residence. Non-Chinese or English versions must be accompanied by an official translation (in Chinese or English), which must be stamped with the translation agency's official seal or notarized. * 9. Financial Guarantee Letter An official guarantee letter or bank deposit certificate issued by a bank, clearly showing that the applicant has sufficient financial capacity to cover personal expenses, transportation and other costs during the program(the recommended amount is not less than 5,000 US dollars or equivalent currency).The validity period of the guarantee letter must cover the entire program duration, and it must include the bank's official seal and the signature of the handling staff. You can download a template or sample from here . Tips: For applicants who are in China: If you are an employee, you still need to provide employment separation certificate and your current residence permit. If you are a student, you need to provide transfer certificate, leaving certificate, certificate of attendance rate issued by previous school and your current residence permit.

Passport photo Personal color photos (full face without hat), head account for 2/3 of photo size; no uniform or white coat; glasses required normally worn; white background, frame-less; clear portrait, rich gradation, and natural expression, without obvious distortion. * 2. Passport photocopy A clear copy of your valid passport with name, photo, birth date, place of birth, date of issue, and date of expiry clearly visible. Visa page is required for applicants who are currently living outside their country of residence. 3. Applicants under 16 years old are required to provide a Guardian’s Commitment Letter. * 4. Academic transcript of highest education Academic Transcripts in languages other than Chinese or English should be translated into Chinese or English and be certified by notarization. Both original and official English translated version are required. * 6. Physical Examination Form Upload a valid "Foreigners' Physical Examination Record" (the standard form can be downloaded through the application system) issued within 6 months, which must include a detailed blood test report. Certificate of No Criminal Record A certificate issued within 6 months by the local police station or relevant authoritative institution in the applicant's country of residence. Non-Chinese or English versions must be accompanied by an official translation (in Chinese or English), which must be stamped with the translation agency's official seal or notarized. * 9. Financial Guarantee Letter An official guarantee letter or bank deposit certificate issued by a bank, clearly showing that the applicant has sufficient financial capacity to cover personal expenses, transportation and other costs during the program(the recommended amount is not less than 5,000 US dollars or equivalent currency).The validity period of the guarantee letter must cover the entire program duration, and it must include the bank's official seal and the signature of the handling staff. If you are a student, you need to provide transfer certificate, leaving certificate, certificate of attendance rate issued by previous school and your current residence permit.

fields.requirements: Entry Requirements (1) Non-Chinese citizen in good health, hold personal passport. (2) Age and education background: For bachelor program, applicant should obtain a high school degree or above and be no more than 25 years old; Applicants whose Chinese language ability does not meet the relevant requirements can apply for Chinese language program of no more than 2 academic years before starting academic study, and should meet the corresponding program age requirements when starting academic study. (3) Outstanding in academic performance. (4) Students outside China should be able to have online communication facilities, such as laptop, stableinternet connection, etc. to carry out the interview and necessary communication for application. (5) Abide by local laws, university rules and regulations. (6) Agree to study according to graduation (HSK and research paper) requirements. (7) Bachelor program requirements: HSK 4 with a score above 180. (8) CSCA subjects requirements download here .
fields.materials: Application Materials " * " means necessary documents that you must provide in your application. If you want to book our translation service , please pay and book it at least 2 weeks before the application deadline for submission of all documents; If you want to book our guardian service , you need to pay and book it 2 months before the application deadline, just in case your application fails because of failed to submit application documents on time. * 1. 1-inch Electronic Personal Photo(JPG format) * 2. Passport photocopy A clearly visible copy of your valid passport with name, photo, birth date, place of birth, date of issue, and date of expiry. Visa page is required for applicants who are currently living outside their own country of residence. The passport validity period must be after March 1st, 2027. The passport can not be changed after the submission of the application until enrollment. * 3. Non-Criminal Record Notarized Chinese or English translation is required for non-Chinese and English versions. * 4. Chinese proficiency test certificate * 5. High school graduate certificate Please provide High School graduation certificate. Copies of the original certificate with the school’s official stamp and/or the signature of the principal. If the originals are not in Chinese or English, they must be translated and notarized. * 6. High school academic transcript Please provide High School transcripts of all grades. Copies of the original transcript with the school’s official stamp and/or the signature of the principal. If the originals are not in Chinese or English, they must be translated and notarized. * 7. Personal Statement An essay statement written in English or Chinese on one page of A4 size paper. Introduce why you are applying for, describe your interest and enthusiasm for the chosen major or research field, and how your previous studies or experiences relate to it. Describe what makes you suitable, such as relevant skills,experience, or achievements gained from previous education, work, and other activities. * 8. TWO Recommendation Letters -Must be written in Chinese or English by professors or associate professors (for master’s and Ph.D. applicants) or teachers from your last university or high school (for bachelor’s applicants). -Letters must include the recommender’s name, contact information (email and phone), and handwritten signature (no typed signatures). -Please make the letters as official as possible. -If you plan to apply to multiple universities, do not mention the name of a specific Chinese university in the letter, to avoid rewriting for each application. * 9. Statement of Financial Support -Download the template attached -The statement should be completed by the applicant and his/her sponsor, then be signed, scanned and uploaded online as one of the application documents. You can download a template or sample from here . * 10. Foreigner Physical Examination certificate (Valid in 6 months) Applicants should strictly follow the requirements of the Physical Examination Record For Foreigner and provide a detailed report of blood examination. Incomplete records, those without the signature of the doctor, the official stamp of the hospital or a sealed photograph of the applicants are invalid. You can download a template or sample from here . 11. A Self-introduction Video -Please speak in English or Chinese. -The video should be at least 2 minutes long, in MP4 format, and less than 7 MB. -Include a brief self-introduction, your study plan after enrollment, reasons for applying to this program and university in China, and your plans after graduation. -You may also highlight your language ability, interests, confidence, and motivation. * 12. CSCA Test Transcript(s) -You need to take the official CSCA test organized by the Chinese government and submit the corresponding subject result transcript(s) when applying. Learn more about the CSCA test >> -The test covers Chinese (Humanities and STEM Chinese), Mathematics, Physics, and Chemistry. Mathematics is required for all programs, while other subjects depend on the university’s specific requirements. -We are updating detailed information for each university, including the required subjects you have to take for each program and their score requirements. Once the updates are ready, you can check the attachment and information here for this university for the latest information. If no attachment is available yet, it usually means the university has not announced further details. You can download a template or sample from here . Tips: For applicants who are in China: If you are an employee, you still need to provide employment separation certificate and your current residence permit. If you are a student, you need to provide transfer certificate, leaving certificate, certificate of attendance rate issued by previous school and your current residence permit.

Both original and official English translated version are required. * 5. Academic transcript of highest education Academic Transcripts in languages other than Chinese or English should be translated into Chinese or English and be certified by notarization. Both original and official English translated version are required. * 6. Physical Examination Form Upload a valid "Foreigners' Physical Examination Record" (the standard form can be downloaded through the application system) issued within 6 months, which must include a detailed blood test report. fields.description: Program Description Program Descriptions: Aim: As a key specializationof national level, TransportManagement of SMU features an emphasis on students’ practical skillsand innovation capabilities, which allows them to work on public management, organization and management of multi-modal transport, international shipping management, and others. Upon completing the program, students should be familiar with the basic knowledge of international shipping and policies, public management, international transportation laws and regulations, shipping management theories and methods, international transportation business and practices. Students should also demonstrate innovative and entrepreneurship abilities that allow them perform proper roles in international shipping companies, government agencies, and scientific research institutes and maintain sustainable personal development in the constantly changing maritime field, . Requirements In addition to systematical mastering of management principles, economics, maritime cargo transportation management, cargo safety management and international trade, the students will comprehensively study shipping public ethics, shipping public policy, international shipping management, liner / charter transportation theory and practice, container terminal business and management,multi-modal transport organization and management, international shipping trade, shipping derivatives and risk management.. Successful graduates are expected to attain the abilities senior international shipping management talents should possess to solve practical management problems . Essential Courses to be taken by students: 1. Maritime Cargo Transportation Management 2. Maritime Geography 3. Shipping Public Ethics 4. Principles and Practice of Liner Transportation 5. Shipping Public Management 6. Shipping Trade 7. International Finance 8. Supply Chain Management 9. Principles and Practice of Chartering Transportation 10. Shipping Economics 11. International Shipping Management 12. Shipping Public Policy 13. Statistics and Forecast 14. Maritime Insurance Law

If you want to book our translation service , please pay and book it at least 2 weeks before the application deadline for submission of all documents; If you want to book our guardian service , you need to pay and book it 2 months before the application deadline, just in case your application fails because of failed to submit application documents in time. * 1. 2-inch photo * 2. Scanned copy of the first page of passport With name, passport number & expiration date, and photo included(Photocopy of valid passport identification page. Passport must be an ordinary passport and be valid for at least six months. Applicants currently residing in China must include a copy of the page containing a valid visa or residence permit.) * 3. Certificate of Non-criminal Record It must be issued by your local police station with official stamp. If not in English or Chinese, it should be translated into English or Chinese. * 4. Certificate/diploma of highest education Graduation certificates should be notarized; If not in English, graduation certificates should be translated into English. * 5. Academic transcript of highest education Transcripts should be notarized; If not in English, transcripts should be translated into English. 6. Bank statement Bank statement of 20,000 RMB is required for applicants who apply for one academic year and above * 7. Resume 1. The Education Background must start from Senior High School until now. 2. If you have worked or once worked, please fill out the Work Experience, and provide the Job Letter (certificate of employment). 3. If you have not worked after graduating from school, fill in the duration and "no working" Note: If not in English or Chinese, it should be translated into English or Chinese. If you can not find a translation organization, please contact CUCAS. You can download a template or sample from here . * 8. Physical examination record for foreigner(only valid for 6 months) Please take it to hospital to have a checkup with all items, including personal information, photo, checking date, doctors' suggestion and signature. 9. Work certificate (for those with work experience) 10. Supporting Documents: Certificate of Good Conduct Provided by your current/previous school/company in Chinese/English to improve your success rate. You can download a template or sample from here . Tips: For applicants who are in China: If you are an employee, you still need to provide employment separation certificate and your current residence permit. If you are a student, you need to provide transfer certificate, leaving certificate, certificate of attendance rate issued by previous school and your current residence permit.
fields.description: Program Description 1. Introduction to Chinese Language Program Editor Notes: The course is taught in Chinese and provides different levels of study. The program is divided into Elementary Level (A, B), Intermediate Level (C, D), and Advanced Level (E). In total, there are 18-week courses a term. Study Place: OUC Fushan Campus, No.23 Eastern HongKong Road. 2. Main Courses Editor Notes: This program offers 8 main courses for international students. Intensive Reading Spoken Chinese Reading Listening Comprehension Chinese Culture Chinese Writing Reading of Chinese Newspaper Reading of Chinese Periodicals Contents for Chinese culture Week Topic Week Topic 1 Introduction: Dos and Don’ts 7 Great Thinkers and Philosophers 2 Chinese Cuisine 8 Chinese Education 3 Chinese Languages 9 Chinese Religion 4 New China and Influencing Figures 10 Chinese Literature and Art 5 Chinese Customs 11 Chinese Festivals 6 Chinese Dynasties and Historical Events 12 Chinese Medicine and Massage, Qigong 3. Sample Curriculum Editor Notes: This curriculum is for reference only. Class Time Monday Tuesday Wednesday Thursday Friday Class A 08:00 - 9:50 Spoken Chinese Chinese Character Spoken Chinese Intensive Reading Spoken Chinese 10:10 -12:00 Intensive Reading Listening Intensive Reading Listening Intensive Reading Class B 08:00 - 9:50 Spoken Chinese Intensive Reading Listening Spoken Chinese Intensive Reading 10:10 - 12:00 Listening Spoken Chinese Intensive Reading Intensive Reading Listening Class C 08:00 - 9:50 Intensive Reading Listening and Speaking Intensive Reading Intensive Reading Intensive Reading 10:10 - 12:00 Reading Writing Reading Listening and Speaking Listening and Speaking Class D 08:00 - 9:50 Listening and Speaking Listening and Speaking Writing Listening and Speaking Intensive Reading 10:10 -12:00 Intensive Reading Reading Reading Intensive Reading Writing Class E 08:00 - 9:50 Audio-Visual Chinese Business Chinese Chinese News Reading Business Chinese Chinese News Reading 10:10 - 12:00 Intensive Reading Intensive Reading Audio-Visual Chinese Audio-Visual Chinese Intensive Reading 4. Time and Duration Editor Notes: Here is the time arrangement and application time. 4.1 Time of Entrance Spring Semester: First Monday of March Fall Semester: First Monday of September 4.2 Duration of Study 1/2-2 years 4.3 Time of Application Spring Semester: The End of February Fall Semester: The End of August 5. School Introduction Editor Notes: Ocean University of China is a comprehensive university under the direct jurisdiction of the State Ministry of Education. There are over 20,000 registered students at Ocean University of China , including 4,500 Master's and Doctoral students and over 500 international students. Among the 2,300 faculty members there are many nationally and internationally recognized experts and scholars, 8 academicians of the Chinese Academy of Sciences and 5 academicians of Chinese Academy of Engineering. Ocean University of China (hereinafter referred to as OUC) is located in Qingdao, a renowned summer resort and an attractive historic tourist city of scenic beauty and temperate climate. Learn More about Ocean University of China. 6. International Education Center Editor Notes: OUC is now offering a large range of programs to international students, including some tailor-made programs. Each year more than 1300 international students from over 50 countries pursue their Certificate/Diploma/Bachelor's degree/Master's degree/Ph.D in our university. Our programs, especially known for their high standards of teaching and considerate services have been attractive to students from all over the world. Various cooperation has been set up with world-famous universities from different countries, such as Germany, USA, U.K. Russia, Japan, Malaysia, Thailand, Indonesia etc. 7. Campus Life Editor Notes: Various activities will be organized usually and students lead a rich and colorful life. (Tai Chi Show) ​ (Chinese Contest)

fields.materials: Application Materials " * " means necessary documents that you must provide in your application. If you want to book our translation service , please pay and book it at least 2 weeks before the application deadline for submission of all documents; If you want to book our guardian service , you need to pay and book it 2 months before the application deadline, just in case your application fails because of failed to submit application documents on time. * 1. A 2-Inch Photo * 2. Scanned Copy of the first page of Passport With name, passport number & expiration date, and photo included(Photocopy of valid passport identification page. Passport must be an ordinary passport and be valid for at least six months. Applicants currently residing in China must include a copy of the page containing a valid visa or residence permit.) * 3. Resume 1. The Education Background must start from Senior High School until now. 2. If you have worked or once worked, please fill out the Work Experience, and provide the Job Letter (certificate of employment). 3. If you have not worked after graduating from school, fill in the duration and "no working" Note: If not in English or Chinese, it should be translated into English or Chinese. If you can not find a translation organization, please contact CUCAS. You can download a template or sample from here . * 4. English proficiency test certificate * 5. High school graduate certificate Graduation certificates should be notarized; If not in Chinese or English, graduation certificates should be translated into Chinese or English. If the applicant is a registered student, he/she should also submit his/her study certificate or transfer certificate issued by his/her school. * 6. High school academic transcript Transcripts in languages other than Chinese and English must be accompanied by notarized Chinese or English translations. * 7. Non-criminal Record Certificate (Generally, it is valid for 3 or 6 months) It must be issued by your local police station with official stamp. If not in English or Chinese, it should be translated into English or Chinese. * 8. Bank statement Degree students must provide a bank statement of no less than 40,000 RMB. * 9. Physical Examination Form(only valid for 6 months) Please take it to hospital to have a checkup with all items, including personal information, photo, checking date, doctors' suggestion and signature. You can download a template or sample from here . 10. Supporting Documents: Certificate of Good Conduct Provided by your current/previous school/company in Chinese/English to improve your success rate. You can download a template or sample from here . * 11. CSCA Test Transcript(s) -You need to take the official CSCA test organized by the Chinese government and submit the corresponding subject result transcript(s) when applying. Learn more about the CSCA test >> -The test covers Chinese (Humanities and STEM Chinese), Mathematics, Physics, and Chemistry. Mathematics is required for all programs, while other subjects depend on the university’s specific requirements. -We are updating detailed information for each university, including the required subjects you have to take for each program and their score requirements. Once the updates are ready, you can check the attachment and information here for this university for the latest information. If no attachment is available yet, it usually means the university has not announced further details. You can download a template or sample from here . Tips: For applicants who are in China: If you are an employee, you still need to provide employment separation certificate and your current residence permit. If you are a student, you need to provide transfer certificate, leaving certificate, certificate of attendance rate issued by previous school and your current residence permit.

fields.requirements: Entry Requirements 1. Applicants should be healthy and well-behaved, and have a foreign citizenship.According to the NO.12 (2020) Announcement of the Ministry of Education of People's Republic of China, applicants who have foreign nationality at birth but both or one of their parents are Chinese citizens who settled in a foreign country, as well as residents of Mainland China, Hong Kong, Macau, and Taiwan who have obtained foreign nationality after immigrating should hold a valid foreign passport or nationality certificate for more than 4 years (inclusive), and have a record of actual residence in a foreign country for more than 2 years within the most recent 4 years (by April 30 of the enrollment year) (The actual residence in a foreign country for 9 months in a year can be calculated as one year, subject to entry and exit signatures). 2. Applicants should have good academic records and an educational background equivalent to that of the Chinese high school diploma. 3. Applicants should be between the ages of 18 and 25. For the applicants under 18 by Sep. 1st 2025 , a Guardian Statement is required. 4. Language Requirements English language proficiency certificate is required for programs taught in English and applicants who are not nativeEnglish speakers, which include score report of English Proficiency test likeTOEFL 80+/ IELTS 6.0+/ TOEFL My Best/ TOEFL iBT Home Edition/ TOEFL Essentials, and etc. For applicants who cannot offer the above-mentioned standardized English test results, they will be required to participate in an additional oral or written English test organized by Wuhan University of Technology.

fields.requirements: Entry Requirements 1. Nationality Should be a non-Chinese citizen who can study and live in the school in good health and with a sound mind. If both or one of the applicant’s parents is a Chinese citizen and resides in a foreign country, the applicant has foreign nationality at birth. In that case, they do not have Chinese nationality and must have a record of actually living abroad for more than 2 years within the last 4 years. (Nine (9) months living abroad are equivalent to one year, subject to entry and exit visas).Chinese emigrants who apply to come to China for undergraduate study as international students must hold a valid foreign passport or nationality certificate for more than 4 years. Within the 4 years, they must have a record of living abroad for more than 2 years (9 months abroad in a year can be calculated as one year, subject to entry and exit visas). 2. Education Background Must be at the high school level or above, with a high school diploma. 3. Language Requirements English-taught Programs: Must be an English native speaker or come from countries with English as the official language; otherwise, should provide a valid English proficiency certificate such as IELTS≥6.0, TOEFL≥75, or TOEFL Essentials≥8 (DI Code: 806). 4. Applicants should be friendly to China, law-abiding, without any criminal records.

Learn more about the CSCA test >> -The test covers Chinese (Humanities and STEM Chinese), Mathematics, Physics, and Chemistry. Mathematics is required for all programs, while other subjects depend on the university’s specific requirements. -We are updating detailed information for each university, including the required subjects you have to take for each program and their score requirements. Once the updates are ready, you can check the attachment and information here for this university for the latest information. If no attachment is available yet, it usually means the university has not announced further details. You can download a template or sample from here . * 5. Photocopy of your Passport home page With name, passport number & expiration date, and photo included * 6. Passport photo Soft copy of your passport photo with blue background, photo size 480*720, JPG format(uploaded as application material) * 7. Official transcripts of your grades in high school and translated copies in Chinese or English version The average score is more than 70% and GPA 3.0/5.0 above. * 8. High School Diploma and translated copy in Chinese or English version. If you have not graduated yet, please get in touch with your current school to provide a ‘certificate’ of expected graduation. Graduation certificate in languages other than Chinese or English should be translated into Chinese or English and be certified by notarization. fields.description: Program Description 1. Program Introduction Editor Notes: After 4-years' study, students will be elites in the petroleum field. Become a petroleum professional with extensive basic theoretical knowledge, solid practical application capabilities, who can engage in engineering design, reservoir engineering design, production and construction, site management, international cooperation, and scientific research in the field of petroleum engineering. 2. Main Courses Editor Notes: The courses list below are mainly like by students. Oil and Gas Development Geology Reservoir Engineering Drilling Engineering Log Interpretation and Production Logging 3. Research areas Editor Notes: Two research areas are provided for students. Oil and Natural Gas Drilling, Developing, and Ocean Engineering 4. School Introduction Editor Notes: CUPB is in a leading position in the petroleum and petrochemical disciplines in China. China University of Petroleum, Beijing Campus (CUPB) , is located in a scenic region of tourist interest in Changping County, Beijing, about 5 miles to the Ming Tombs and 15 miles to the Great Wall. CUPB offers not only engineering programs in oil and gas science including chemical engineering, petroleum engineering, geoscience and mechanical and electronic engineering, but also, in computer science, business management and Chinese Language Study programs of a full range from diploma, bachelor's and master's to doctoral programs. Learn More>> 5. Colourful Life Editor Notes: There are a variety kind of activities international students can choose to take part in. Opening Ceremony Visited the 7th Beijing Agricultural Carnival

Admitted students will attend Tianjin International Chinese College for one year.Upon completing the coursework and passing HSK level 5, students will have guaranteed transfer to Tijian Polytechnic University. fields.requirements: Entry Requirements 1. Nationality Should be a non-Chinese citizen who can study and live in the school in good health and with a sound mind. If both or one of the applicant’s parents is a Chinese citizen and resides in a foreign country, the applicant has foreign nationality at birth. In that case, they do not have Chinese nationality and must have a record of actually living abroad for more than 2 years within the last 4 years. (Nine (9) months living abroad are equivalent to one year, subject to entry and exit visas).Chinese emigrants who apply to come to China for undergraduate study as international students must hold a valid foreign passport or nationality certificate for more than 4 years. Within the 4 years, they must have a record of living abroad for more than 2 years (9 months abroad in a year can be calculated as one year, subject to entry and exit visas). 2. Education Background Must be at the high school level or above, with a high school diploma. 3. Language Requirements English-taught Programs: Must be an English native speaker or come from countries with English as the official language; otherwise, should provide a valid English proficiency certificate such as IELTS≥6.0, TOEFL≥75, or TOEFL Essentials≥8 (DI Code: 806). 4. Applicants should be friendly to China, law-abiding, without any criminal records.

If both or one of the applicant’s parents is a Chinese citizen and resides in a foreign country, the applicant has foreign nationality at birth. Applicants should be friendly to China, law-abiding, without any criminal records.

fields.description: Program Description Introduction Chinese Language Studies Program is open to international students who love Chinese Language and Chinese culture. Students learn Chinese at the PKU School of Chinese as a Second Language as full-time general visiting students. Instruction is divided into elementary, intermediate, and advanced levels. Students are arranged into suitable classes according to the results of the Chinese placement test at the beginning of the semester. Class size is approximately fifteen students per class. Normally class hours are from Monday to Friday, four academic hours per day, twenty hours per week. Besides Chinese language studies in the classroom, Peking University also offers program students a series of activities to experience Chinese culture and get a deeper understanding of China. Upon completion of the program students will receive a program certificate and an official transcript. The program is normally one semester long, but students could applyfor extending their study period to at most four semesters in accumulation. When to Apply Fall Semester Admission: Online application starts on March 1st every year. Spring Semester Admission: Online application starts on November 1st every year. Note:Applications are on a “rolling” (first come, first served) basis – until full capacity. Only when the office receives the hardcopies of all the required documents will the application be processed. Admission Admission will be determined according to your educational background and the academic achievement. Upon acceptance, the University will send you the ‘Admission Notification’ as well as the ‘Visa Application for Study in China (Form JW202)’ at the end of the semester. Registration Period Fall Semester: In early September (specified in the Admission Notification); Spring Semester: In February (specified in the Admission Notification). PKU Academic Year Fall Semester: normally from September to January; Spring Semester: normally from February to June. Tuition Fee (per person) 18,000RMB/semester (one cost-free weekend tour included during the study period). Teaching Materials Fee 150-300RMB/semester Medical Insurance The Ministry of Education of China requires that all international students be medically insured throughout their entire planned period of study. Peking University international studentsare required to purchase the Comprehensive Insurance Plan of Foreign Students on the day of registration. Students who do not have valid medical insurance will not be allowed to register. For more information about the insurance, please visit the insurance company’s website (www.lxbx.net). Extracurricular Activities Peking University offers program students a series of extracurricular activities in both autumn and spring semesters to experience Chinese culture and get a deeper understanding of China. The following activities, which are subject to the exact notice of the semester, are for your reference. Semester Type Activity Time Autumn Semester In-City Tours Mutianyu Great Wall Visit September Beautiful Beijing Village Visit September PKU International Culture Festival October Temple of Heaven Visit and Acrobatics Performance November PKU International Students’ New Year Party (Buffet) December Weekend Tour Visit Mountain Tai and Confucius’s Hometown October Field Trip Visit Other Provinces and Cities Late June

A 2-Inch Photo * 2. Scanned Copy of the first page of Passport With name, passport number & expiration date, and photo included(Photocopy of valid passport identification page. High school graduate certificate Graduation certificates should be notarized; If not in Chinese or English, graduation certificates should be translated into Chinese or English. If the applicant is a registered student, he/she should also submit his/her study certificate or transfer certificate issued by his/her school. * 6. High school academic transcript Transcripts in languages other than Chinese and English must be accompanied by notarized Chinese or English translations. * 7. Non-criminal Record Certificate (Generally, it is valid for 3 or 6 months) It must be issued by your local police station with official stamp. If not in English or Chinese, it should be translated into English or Chinese. * 8. Bank statement Degree students must provide a bank statement of no less than 40,000 RMB. * 9. Physical Examination Form(only valid for 6 months) Please take it to hospital to have a checkup with all items, including personal information, photo, checking date, doctors' suggestion and signature. Supporting Documents: Certificate of Good Conduct Provided by your current/previous school/company in Chinese/English to improve your success rate. fields.description: Program Description Introduction of TEFL program What is TEFL? TEFL stands for Teaching English as a Foreign Language. TEFL courses will equip you with the skills and confidence that you need to teach English as a foreign Language. Who is Eligible? Anybody is able to take our 120 hour online TEFL course. This program provides learners with elevated experiences and the tools required to engage and inspire future learners in English classrooms around the world. Internationally recognized, the program is certification authenticated in collaboration with a licensed from USA IAO . The online TEFL training is designed to assist teachers with the first step towards an exciting International teaching position. Where Can TEFL be Appl ied for ? TEFL is predominately taught in countries where English isn’t the native language. Opportunities commonly exist in schools and language institutes, but you will also find opportunities for private tutoring, corporate businesses, volunteering and online learning. Curriculum Unit 1: Language Acquisition Unit 2: Skills Unit 3: Teaching Grammar and Vocabulary Unit 4: Classroom Management Unit 5: Assessing Student Levels Unit 6: Modern Methods Unit 7: Demo Lesson It has been written by a Aussie Born TEFL expert and is designed for those first time teachers to equip you with what you need to get the knowledge and confidence to teach for the first time. It is one of the most up to date TEFL courses out there. Study Duration 120 hours training you have 180 days to complete. Completely online, so you can do it around other commitments. Once you have registered you can start learning immediately. Real life tutor support, our tutors are available throughout the week. Receive your certificate automatically after completion.

fields.description: Program Description Program Introduction Offer a wide range of courses such as listening, speaking, reading, news reading, comprehensive Chinese, business Chinese, video Chinese and Chinese culture. Enhance students' Chinese language proficiency in an all around way. Students can take live online classes, and teachers provide targeted one-on-one tutoring to students after classes via the teaching app. The mode is small class size teaching, and a class can be set up as long as there are three students or a bit more. The learning time can be arranged flexibly according to students' specific conditions, and the class lasts 8 weeks. This way, every student can have the chance to start learning the language as soon as possible, making it the best choice for those who want to learn Chinese but cannot come to China. School Time Duration(off line): Mar 6, 2023～ Jun 23, 2023 Class time: 9:00am～12:10pm (From Monday to Friday) 20 class hours per week Class Level Class level: Beginning-Advanced 5 level in total Target Student Learn Chinese in an all-around way Option Course(s) In order to help students improve their Chinese level and further their understanding of Chinese culture, we offer a wide range of optional courses in accordance with students' Chinese language proficiency. Students Life we organize a variety of cultural activities every semester. You can learn how to play Tai Chi, cook Chinese food, visit the Great Wall in the spring, enjoy the scene of leaves falling in the fall, go to acrobatics shows, exhibitions, and eat delicious food. We also have Chinese culture festivals, calligraphy contests, and photography contests organized by students.
