fields.description: Program Description 1. Program Features Editor Notes: This program can guarantees consistency and quality in our teaching methods and be accredited by EAQUALS. Study at the center of Shanghai: Study at West Yan' An Road Campus, Donghua University, enjoying decent public transportation and well-equipped facilities. Focus on language applications: We adopt the self-compiled textbook 'Chinese in Real Life', which is more suitable for international students' life in China. We also consider the application of Chinese language in daily life and the preparation for HSK tests. Integration of language learning and cultural understanding: We offer the introduction to Chinese culture as well as cultural lectures and practical activities to deepen students' understanding of Mandarin Chinese. Rich online learning materials: We offer various Chinese learning materials, including keywords, language points, recorded videos, dialogue videos, audios, course summaries, and etc. All Learning materials, as well as the assignments, will be uploaded to the learning management platform; and students both in online and offline courses can review the courses at any time. Various Course Levels: We can provide different course levels to meet different Chinese proficiencies from beginners to HSK6 learners. Assistant Support: We assign Chinese teachers or DHU Chinese students to each class as assistants to provide additional support for international students. Quality Accreditation: We are the only language program in China accredited by EAQUALS, which guarantees consistency and quality in our teaching methods. 2. Program Details Editor Notes: There are 8 levels including beginner, elementary, intermediate, and advanced courses. Class time: 9:00 AM - 12:15 PM Beijing Time, Monday to Friday (Except for holidays and special circumstances) Small class: Less than 25 people per class Levels: Beginner, Elementary, Intermediate, and Advanced with a maximum of 8 levels. Students have to take a placement test to evaluate their Chinese proficiency, and they will be divided into different levels based on the test result. 3. Sample Timetable Editor Notes: The arrangement listed in the table may change according to adjustment. 4. Class arrangement Editor Notes: Students will be divided into different levels according to entrance placement test. Students have to take a placement test to evaluate their Chinese proficiency, and they will be divided into different levels based on the test result. In the 1st week, students are allowed to change the course level within a specific timeframe. 5. School Introduction Editor Notes: Donghua University offers the best Chinese language program and business program in Shanghai. Located in Shanghai, Donghua University is composed of the Yan’an Road Campus at the downtown area and the Songjiang Campus at the historical cradle of the city. The history of Donghua University can be traced back to the establishment of Nantong College in 1912 by Zhang Jian, a famous industrialist in Qing dynasty. In 1951, East China Institute of Textile Science & Technology was founded; in 1985, the name was changed to China Textile University; in 1999, it was changed again to Donghua University , Learn More>> 6. International Cooperation Editor Notes: Donghua University has always paid great attention to international exchange and cooperation. The School has cooperated with more than 100 institutions for higher education as well as well-known enterprises around the world. The joint programs such as Donghua-Carleton IMBA, Sino-German Education for Bachelor Degree of Light Chemical Engineering, and Sino-Japan Education for Bachelor Degree of Fashion Design & Engineering have always beening developed. Major international conferences as International Fashion Forum of Shanghai International Fashion Culture Festival and the 83rd World Conference of Textile Institute have been hosted by DHU successfully. 7. Campus Life Editor Notes: Every year, DHU will hold various kinds of activities on campus and off campus for international students. International Students Participate in Fraud Prevention Immersive Experience​ ​ The 9th International Cultural Festival​

fields.requirements: Entry Requirements 1. Applicants should be non-Chinese citizens in good health both mentally and physically with a high school graduation certificate or equivalent. 2. Applicants for the Chinese-taught majors of Science, Engineering, Agriculture, Medicine, Economics, Management and Art should submit the certificate of HSK level 4 with the score of 180 points or above; Those in the Chinese-taught majors of Literature or Law should submit the certificate of HSK level 5 with the score of 180 points or above. 3. China Scholastic Competency Assessment Transcript This assessment is organized by the China Scholarship Counicl on behalf of the Ministry of Education of People’s Republic of China. All applicants must take the assessment in advance and get the score report. The assessment contents includes professional Chinese, mathematics, physics and chemistry. Professional Chinese Professional Chinese offers two types of tests: liberal arts Chinese and science Chinese. Applicants who apply for undergraduate studies taught in Chinese should take the corresponding professional Chinese test based on your applied major. fields.description: Program Description Program Period July 6 - July 24 Course Arrangement Class Time: 9:00 AM – 12:00 PM (GMT+8), Monday to Friday (Weekends and free afternoons are for self-arranged activities.) Tentative Schedule *Remarks: Above schedule is subject to change. Final schedule will be given during the enrollment. Chinese Classes: Say goodbye to the worries of daily communication! Our core course is designed for practical use, helping you confidently handle a wide range of real-life situations—from ordering meals and shopping to making new friends. Multiple levels are offered, starting from beginner. Each class opens with a minimum of 8 students. Through a simple, user-friendly online placement test, we’ll help you find the class that best matches your ability, ensuring you progress efficiently alongside peers of similar levels. Cultural Lectures/Activities: Culture goes beyond textbooks! We’ve prepared a variety of engaging interactive lectures and workshops that let you experience firsthand the charm of Chinese culture. Discover the wisdom behind Chinese characters, appreciate the beauty of the language, try writing Chinese calligraphy with a brush, or paint a traditional round fan, paper umbrella, or opera mask—perfect as a gift for friends. You can also learn a set of health exercises rooted in traditional Chinese medicine and wellness philosophy, so you can share the practice with your loved ones back home. Through fun, hands-on activities, you’ll personally feel how traditional culture nourishes both body and mind, enriching everyday life. Language Practice: Learning Chinese is meant to be used in the real world! Under the guidance of instructors, you’ll step out of the classroom and into Shanghai’s authentic neighborhoods, shopping districts, and cultural landmarks to complete exciting “mission challenges.” Find unique local products in a supermarket, or strike up a brief conversation with a stranger in a café—every time you speak, you’ll be taking a real step forward in your language journey.

fields.description: Program Description Qualification awarded: Chinese Learning Certificate Duration of study: one semester Teaching language: Chinese Teaching Objectives: After they conclude one semester's study and acquire the required credit points, students are supposed to have a vocabulary above 5000 words and finish learning the grammar and vocabulary of the intermediate phase. General Curriculum A. Mandarin course : 1. Mandatory courses: Intensive Reading, Spoken Chinese, Pronunciation, and Listening Comprehension & Video Course. 2. Elective courses: Students can electives from a variety of topics such as Chinese Folklore, Rhetoric, Writing, Newspaper Reading, and others. All courses aim to improve the student’s the ability to use Mandarin in real-life circumstances. B. Chinese Cultural Activities 1. Tai Chi (Taijiquan) , Chinese painting, Chinese calligraphy, visits to traditional Beijing residential area ( hutong ), etc. 2. Weekend trips to Terrocotta Warrior in Shaanxi Province, Chengde in Hebei Province, Mount Tai and Qufu in Shandong Province, and other historical and cultural sites. Note: Students who would like to withdraw from the program should submit their request before the registration at the beginning of the semester. Upon approval, the tuition fee can be refunded according to the school regulation. 10% of the tuition fee will not be refunded to cover the administrative fees (RMB only). For requests to withdraw after registration, the tuition fee for the current semester will not be refunded.

fields.description: Program Description 1. Program Introduction Editor Notes: This program includes three parts, which are Chinese culture and natural science courses, other 6 courses, and internship. The basic courses in 5-level are prone to strengthening the students’ abilities of listening, speaking, reading, writing. As students' Chinese levels are different, translation will be offered accordingly. There are some relevant culture courses like calligraphy, Chinese painting, Taiji Boxing (the Chinese shadow boxing), Chinese gardens, etc. This program includes 6 levels and every level is for one semester. Students who pass final exam will study the high grade of Chinese Course in the next semester. 2. Program Structure Editor Notes: This progam can be divided into 6 levels. 2.1 Level A 1）Teaching Objectives Suits the beginners of Chinese language, which focuses on training the students to use the simple Chinese in daily communication. If you want to book our translation service , please pay and book it at least 2 weeks before the application deadline for submission of all documents; If you want to book our guardian service , you need to pay and book it 2 months before the application deadline, just in case your application fails because of failed to submit application documents on time. * 1. Passport -A clear, full-color scan of your passport information page, showing your name, passport number, expiration date, and photo. -Some universities may also require blank visa pages, so you are advised to upload a few blank pages as well. * 2. Photo -A recent passport-sized ID photo (2 x 2 inches) with a plain white background. -Full face visible, no headwear (except for religious reasons). -Taken within the last 6 months. * 3. GXIBVC Application Form -Download the application form, fill it out on your computer, and submit it in Word format (.docx). -Complete all fields as fully and accurately as possible. Do not leave any blanks — write “None” if a section does not apply. -The form must be filled in English or Chinese. You can download a template or sample from here . * 4. Highest Degree Graduation Certificate -A formal graduation certificate of your highest completed education level (e.g., Senior High School, Bachelor’s, or Master’s degree). -If the document is not in Chinese or English, it must be translated into Chinese or English and notarized by an authorized translation agency or relevant authority. Self-translations are not accepted. * 5. Highest Degree Academic Transcripts -Formal academic transcripts of your highest completed education level (e.g., Senior High School, Bachelor’s, or Master’s degree), covering ALL academic years, NOT just the final year. -If the document is not in Chinese or English, it must be translated into Chinese or English and notarized by an authorized translation agency or relevant authority. Self-translations are not accepted. * 6. Non-criminal Record Certificate -Obtain a police clearance certificate from the local police station where you currently reside, confirming no criminal record in the past 6 months at the time of application. -Some universities may require a certificate covering only the past 3 months, in which case the certificate is valid for 3 months only. -If you are currently in China, the certificate must be issued by the local Chinese police. -If the document is not in Chinese or English, it must be translated and notarized by an authorized agency or relevant authority. Self-translations are not accepted. * 7. Physical Examination Form -Download the form template, print it, and bring it to a hospital for the required medical tests. The hospital will complete the form with your results. -The medical examination must cover all items listed on the form. -Ensure your photo is attached and the form is stamped and signed by the hospital after the examination. -The medical results are valid for 6 months only. -Forms that are incomplete, lack a final physician’s suggestion, missing the attending physician’s signature, official hospital stamp, or applicant’s sealed photo will be considered invalid. -The document must be in English or Chinese. You can download a template or sample from here . * 8. Recommendation Letter -Letters must include the recommender’s name, contact information (email and phone), and handwritten signature (no typed signatures). -Please make the letters as official as possible. -If you plan to apply to multiple universities, do not mention the name of a specific Chinese university in the letter, to avoid rewriting for each application. 9. Notarized Guardian's Letter of Commitment -Students under 18 must find a Chinese guardian who resides in the same city as the university, and complete the notarization process as guided in our tutorial video: https://shorturl.at/XTol0 -Upload a scanned copy of the notarized Guardian’s Letter of Commitment. This document must be certified in your home country and notarized in China. -Please note that a Notarization of Declaration (声明公证) issued in China is eventually required. -A scanned copy is acceptable at the initial stage. If the university later requires the original document or additional materials, we will inform you. -For some universities, guardian services are available. Learn more here: https://shorturl.at/aYyBV * 10. GXIBVC Resume -Download the application form, fill it out on your computer, and submit it in Word format (.docx). -Complete all fields as fully and accurately as possible. Do not leave any blanks — write “None” if a section does not apply. -The form must be filled in English or Chinese. You can download a template or sample from here . Tips: For applicants who are in China: If you are an employee, you still need to provide employment separation certificate and your current residence permit. If you are a student, you need to provide transfer certificate, leaving certificate, certificate of attendance rate issued by previous school and your current residence permit.

fields.requirements: Entry Requirements 1. Non-Chinese citizens, aged 18 or above (by June 15, 2022) and in good physical and mental conditions to perform successfully in an academic program in a foreign country. 2. Compliance with Chinese laws and university regulations; Record of academic excellence. 3. The applicant must be: A high school graduate and no more than 25 when applying for the undergraduate programs. 4. English proficiency certificate. (Required for English taught programs). Applicants whose native language is not English, shall provide a IELTS score of 6.0 or a TOEFL score of 85 or higher.
fields.materials: Application Materials " * " means necessary documents that you must provide in your application. If you want to book our translation service , please pay and book it at least 2 weeks before the application deadline for submission of all documents; If you want to book our guardian service , you need to pay and book it 2 months before the application deadline, just in case your application fails because of failed to submit application documents on time. * 1. No Criminal Conviction Certificate The applicant shall submit a valid certificate of No Criminal Conviction issued by the local public security authority. Personal information such as name, date of birth and nationality written on the certificate should be consistent with the name and birth date on your passport. Passport Name written on the form should not be abbreviated or omitted. * 2. English proficiency test certificate For example, IELTS or TOEFL, only for applicant whose native language is not English. * 3. Financial support statement Required for the self-supported applicants. The supporter’s work or income verification and passport information as proof of sufficient funding that could cover the costs of living and study in China. * 4. Specific study or research plan in a Chinese university * 5. The passport information page (Ordinary passport) * 6. Passport photo A recent passport-sized photo of the applicant * 7. High school academic transcript Academic transcript in languages other than Chinese or English should be translated into Chinese or English and be certified by notarization. 8. High school graduate certificate Graduation certificate in languages other than Chinese or English should be translated into Chinese or English and be certified by notarization. * 9. Foreigner physical examination form (photocopy) and copies of blood test reports. The physical examinations must cover all of the items listed in the Foreigner Physical Examination Form. Personal information such as name, date of birth and nationality written on the form should be consistent with that on your passport. Passport Name written on the form should not be abbreviated or omitted. Please carefully plan your physical examination schedule as the result is valid for only 6 months. You can download a template or sample from here . * 10. CSCA Test Transcript(s) -You need to take the official CSCA test organized by the Chinese government and submit the corresponding subject result transcript(s) when applying. Learn more about the CSCA test >> -The test covers Chinese (Humanities and STEM Chinese), Mathematics, Physics, and Chemistry. Mathematics is required for all programs, while other subjects depend on the university’s specific requirements. -We are updating detailed information for each university, including the required subjects you have to take for each program and their score requirements. Once the updates are ready, you can check the attachment and information here for this university for the latest information. If no attachment is available yet, it usually means the university has not announced further details. You can download a template or sample from here . Tips: For applicants who are in China: If you are an employee, you still need to provide employment separation certificate and your current residence permit. If you are a student, you need to provide transfer certificate, leaving certificate, certificate of attendance rate issued by previous school and your current residence permit.

fields.requirements: Entry Requirements (1) Applicants should be non-Chinese citizens with valid passport, with good moral conduct, in good health, in friendly relation with China and observe Chinese laws, regulations and university's rules and regulations. Applicants who have already resided in China should apply 40 days before the expiration of residence permit. (2) If both parents or one of the parents of the applicant are Chinese citizens and reside in a foreign country, the applicant shall have foreign nationality at birth and shall hold a valid foreign passport or nationality certificate for at least 4 years. In addition, applicants must provide a record of at least 2 years of actual residence in a foreign country during the last 4 years (April 30, 2018 to April 30, 2022). The actual residence of more than 9 months in a year can be counted as one year, subject to the entry and exit signatures. For residences of mainland China, Hong Kong, Macao and Taiwan who immigrated to foreign countries and are applying as international students, please refer to the requirements above. (3) Applicants should reach the admission requirements, such as grades, academic level and language proficiency. (4) Language proficiency requirements: English-spoken Programs: IELTS 5 (at least) or TOEFL 60 (at least) (5) Applicants for Bachelor: Academic credentials equivalent to Chinese senior high school.

fields.requirements: Entry Requirements Basic Requirements Applicants must be non-Chinese citizens aged 18 and above. Should be in good physical and mental health,be friendly towards China, have no history of drug abuse or criminal records, be willing to abide by China'slaws and the university's rules and regulations, and respect China's social and cultural customs. High school graduate. Language Proficiency Requirement Degree Program in English: English Language Proficiency evaluation mainly depends on interview; Requirements for the China Scholastic Competency Assessment (CSCA) download here .
fields.materials: Application Materials " * " means necessary documents that you must provide in your application. If you want to book our translation service , please pay and book it at least 2 weeks before the application deadline for submission of all documents; If you want to book our guardian service , you need to pay and book it 2 months before the application deadline, just in case your application fails because of failed to submit application documents on time. * 1. A Copy of Senior High School Graduation Certificate Certificate in languages other than Chinese or English should be translated into Chinese or English and be certified by notarization. Both original and official English translated version are required. * 2. Transcript of Senior High School Academic Transcripts in languages other than Chinese or English should be translated into Chinese or English and be certified by notarization. Both original and official English translated version are required. * 3. Non-criminal Certificate * 4. English proficiency test certificate For example, IELTS or TOEFL, only for applicant whose native language is not English. * 5. A copy of passport With name, passport number & expiration date, and photo included(Photocopy of valid passport identification page. Passport must be an ordinary passport and be valid for at least six months. Applicants currently residing in China must include a copy of the page containing a valid visa or residence permit.) * 6. Scanned file of 2-inch photo * 7. Physical Examination Form -Download the form template, print it, and bring it to a hospital for the required medical tests. The hospital will complete the form with your results. -The medical examination must cover all items listed on the form. The physical examination form must include test results for HIV, Syphilis, Hepatitis B, and Hepatitis C. If possible, please also provide separate test reports for the following items: 1. Blood test report (must include HIV, Syphilis, Hepatitis B, and Hepatitis C) 2. X-ray report -Ensure your photo is attached and the form is stamped and signed by the hospital after the examination. -The medical results are valid for 6 months only. -Forms that are incomplete, lack a final physician’s suggestion, missing the attending physician’s signature, official hospital stamp, or applicant’s sealed photo or contain abnormal examination results will be considered invalid. -The document must be in English or Chinese. You can download a template or sample from here . * 8. Statement of Financial Support -Download the specific template required by the university from CUCAS. -Your financial guarantor must fill it on computer, print it, sign, and provide a scanned copy of the signed document. -The financial guarantor is usually one of your parents; you cannot be your own guarantor. -The document must be in English or Chinese. You can download a template or sample from here . * 9. Drug Test Requirement &Anti-Drug Commitment Letter * 10. Self-introduction Video in Chinese or English in MP4 format Shorter than 2 min, less than 50 MB * 11. Study plan Should be written in Chinese or English. No less than 500 words Includes but not limited to a brief self-introduction, should mainly focusing on what you want to STUDY or RESEARCH after enrolled. You can also briefly introduce your reason to apply for this program in this university in China, and your plan after graduation. It is different from personal statement or motivation letter * 12. CSCA Test Transcript(s) -You need to take the official CSCA test organized by the Chinese government and submit the corresponding subject result transcript(s) when applying. Learn more about the CSCA test >> -The test covers Chinese (Humanities and STEM Chinese), Mathematics, Physics, and Chemistry. Mathematics is required for all programs, while other subjects depend on the university’s specific requirements. -We are updating detailed information for each university, including the required subjects you have to take for each program and their score requirements. Once the updates are ready, you can check the attachment and information here for this university for the latest information. If no attachment is available yet, it usually means the university has not announced further details. You can download a template or sample from here . Tips: For applicants who are in China: If you are an employee, you still need to provide employment separation certificate and your current residence permit. If you are a student, you need to provide transfer certificate, leaving certificate, certificate of attendance rate issued by previous school and your current residence permit.
fields.description: Program Description I. Training Objectives The program develops students’ international vision [Goal 1] and Internet thinking [Goal 2], to have a solid command of international business theory, competencies of English-Chinese bilingual application, eCommerce practice and applications [Goal 3], and ability of innovation and entrepreneurship [Goal 4], to adapt to the trend of economic globalization and cross-border eCommerce development and the needs of regional economic development [Goal 5], and to be able to engage in not only foreign economic and trade management in government departments but also in international trade, international investment or cross-border eCommerce related work in enterprises, as well as to be international applied talents with high-quality in the field of digital economy [Goal 6]. II. Graduation Requirements By learning the basic theories and knowledge of Management, Economics, International Trade, Cross-border eCommerce and etc., and receiving systematic Internet thinking and international business training, students will have the preliminary ability to engage in international trade, international finance, international logistics, cross-border eCommerce and other businesses. Graduates should acquire the following knowledge, abilities and qualities through academic study: 1. Specialized Knowledge. Students should master the elementary theories of Economic Management, and have solid elementary knowledge of International Trade, International Finance, International Logistics and Cross-border eCommerce; students should grasp the frontier of international business theory and practice development; students should be familiar with international economic and trade systems and practices; students should master Chinese, English and computer application knowledge; students should have the basic knowledge and accomplishment in humanities, social sciences and natural sciences. 2. Practice and Application Ability. Students should be equipped with market sensitivity while possessing the capability of practice and application in international trade, international finance, cross-border eCommerce and international enterprise management. 3. Internationalization and Modernization. Students should develop diversified global communication skills, computer application and business data analysis ability, and be capable of intercultural communication and modernization work. 4. Problem Analysis. Students should understand the relevant theories of different branches of international business, pay attention to the development of the discipline, and can use innovative methods to acquire knowledge, analyze and solve business problems, and draw effective conclusions. 5. Humanities Quality: Students should have the qualities of international vision, entrepreneurial spirit, social responsibility, humanistic care, and citizen awareness. fields.requirements: Entry Requirements 1. Applicant whose parents or one of his/her parents are Chinese, he/she must hold a valid non-Chinese passport or Certificate of Nationality for no less than 4 years. Additionally, applicant shall submit records of living out of China for more than 2 years in the last 4 years (up to April 30 of the year of enrolment). *9 months of living abroad within a year can be counted as 1 year, subject to the entry and exit stamps. 2. Applicant must be between 18 to 30 years old (on the date of enrolment). 3. Applicant must meet the health requirements issued by the Chinese Ministry of Education and the Chinese Ministry of Health. 4. For some country's applicants who need to serve the army, we suggest you complete your duty before applying. 5. If applicants have a history of expulsion, we will refuse the application. 6. Applicant who has criminal or prison records will not be accepted. 7. The minimum score of TOEFL is 85, the minimum score of IELTS is 6.5.

fields.description: Program Description Ranked as top film school in China, Beijing Film Academy's film production international program is a 4-year English-teaching program, offering all kinds of professional courses including Directing, Cinematography, Post-production, and etc. We're committed to cultivate talents to master the whole workflow of filmmaking. In addition to gain professional knowledges, you will also have opportunity to learn valuable skills from masters in the industry. You will meet interesting people, develop yourself, and create connections which will bring you endless opportunities in the future. With rapid growth of China film industry, we believe it will be a perfect platform for you to start off your career in film industry. We provide industry standard facilities to all students in the department, including professional editing studios, sound studios, color correction studios, screening rooms, as well as a range of cinematic cameras, lighting products etc. -- Everything you may need to make your script into film. Most students and teachers in the department speak English and willing to offer help, so you don't need to worry about the language barrier. We also offer Chinese classes during the study period. So, what are you waiting for? Join us to start your new chapter in film!

fields.requirements: Entry Requirements 1. Applicant shall be in good physical and mental health； 2. Applicants shall have good moral character and no criminal record; be willing to abide by Chinese laws and regulation, as well as the rules of the XACM. 3. Applicants shall be between the age of 18 and 35 (as of March 30 2023). 4. Applicants shall be non-Chinese citizens with a valid foreign passport. For the applicants who used to be Chinese citizens but later immigrated to other countries, these applicants must hold passport or citizenship certificate of their current countries for at least 4 years in addition to the 2-year “proof of residence” in recent 4 years (as of March 30, 2023. actual residence in a foreign country for more than 9 months in a year can be counted as one year, subject to the entry and exit stamps). Applicants whose one or both parents are Chinese citizens must provide one of the following supporting documents: 1) The certificate proving that the applicants obtained the foreign nationality at birth; 2) For applicants who used to be Chinese citizens but later immigrated to other countries, these applicants shall provide the certificates of cancellation of Chinese nationality. 5. Applicants shall hold at least a high school diploma or graduation certificate. 6. Applicants shall have Chinese language proficiency equivalent to or above HSK Level 4.

fields.requirements: Entry Requirements 1. Non-Chinese citizens who hold a foreign passport and comply with the relevant regulations set by the “Document No. 12 (2020) of Ministry of Education of the PRC ”; 2. Ages from 18 to 30 (based on the time point of September 1 of the year of enrollment), and have obtained high school diploma or above; 3. Are physically and mentally healthy; meet the physical examination requirements for Chinese Visa and Residence Permit in China as well as the physical examination requirements for BSU programs so as to ensure their study and life in China; 4. Have no record of discipline violation, public security punishment or criminal conduct; show respect towards China and behave well; comply with Chinese laws and university regulations, and respect Chinese customs; 5. Have passed HSK Level 4 or above.
fields.materials: Application Materials " * " means necessary documents that you must provide in your application. If you want to book our translation service , please pay and book it at least 2 weeks before the application deadline for submission of all documents; If you want to book our guardian service , you need to pay and book it 2 months before the application deadline, just in case your application fails because of failed to submit application documents on time. 1. Applications who are originally Chinese citizens and obtained foreign nationalities afterward should provide the following materials (1)Valid passport and a certificate before April 30, 2019, for the cancellation of their original registered residence in China and the renunciation of the Chinese nationality should be provided. (2)The entry and exit seal page of visiting China on the applicant's passport from April 30, 2019, to the time of application. (3)The proof of residence abroad of at least 2 years by April 30, 2019 (9 months of residence abroad per year may be considered as one year, subject to entry and exit signatures). 2. Applicants should provide the following materials if one of or both of the parents of the applicant are Chinese citizens (1)Certificate of the applicant obtaining foreign nationality at birth or afterward. (2)The nationality or household registration certificate of both of the applicant's parents (passport or ID card). (3)For applicants who obtained foreign nationality at birth, if one of or both of the parents are Chinese citizens and have the permanent residence abroad, a certificate of the corresponding permanent residence needs to be provided. If one of or both of the parents are Chinese citizens but have not obtained the permanent residence abroad, certificate of the withdrawal from Chinese nationality of the applicant needs to be provided. * 3. Original certificate of no criminal record (1) Applicants currently in China must provide a certificate of no criminal record in China issued by the local exit and entry administration department or public security organ; (2) Applicants who are not currently in China must provide a certificate of no criminal record issued by the local public security administration. * 4. Certificate of HSK * 5. Passport information page (valid after September 30, 2023) * 6. Recent electronic photo (cap-free, 2-inch size, plain white background) * 7. The transcripts of all senior high school courses in original or as certified copy in Chinese or English * 8. The senior high school diploma Studying certificate issued by senior high school for applicants graduating from senior high school in the current year) in original or as certified copy in Chinese or English. 9. Applicants under 18 years old (until June 1, 2023) should provide a notarized guardianship letter valid in China is required The guardian of the student has to be living in Beijing at present and must have a source of income regardless their nationality is Chinese or not. * 10. CSCA Test Transcript(s) -You need to take the official CSCA test organized by the Chinese government and submit the corresponding subject result transcript(s) when applying. Learn more about the CSCA test >> -The test covers Chinese (Humanities and STEM Chinese), Mathematics, Physics, and Chemistry. Mathematics is required for all programs, while other subjects depend on the university’s specific requirements. -We are updating detailed information for each university, including the required subjects you have to take for each program and their score requirements. Once the updates are ready, you can check the attachment and information here for this university for the latest information. If no attachment is available yet, it usually means the university has not announced further details. You can download a template or sample from here . Tips: For applicants who are in China: If you are an employee, you still need to provide employment separation certificate and your current residence permit. If you are a student, you need to provide transfer certificate, leaving certificate, certificate of attendance rate issued by previous school and your current residence permit.

Photocopy of valid passport With name, passport number & expiration date, and photo included. * 2. Passport photo A recent passport-sized photo of the applicant. * 3. High school graduate certificate Graduation certificate in languages other than Chinese or English should be translated into Chinese or English and be certified by notarization. * 4. High school academic transcript Academic transcript in languages other than Chinese or English should be translated into Chinese or English and be certified by notarization. * 5. A copy of English Test Transcript For example, IELTS or TOEFL, only for applicant whose native language is not English. * 6. CSCA Test Transcript(s) -You need to take the official CSCA test organized by the Chinese government and submit the corresponding subject result transcript(s) when applying. Learn more about the CSCA test >> -The test covers Chinese (Humanities and STEM Chinese), Mathematics, Physics, and Chemistry. Mathematics is required for all programs, while other subjects depend on the university’s specific requirements. -We are updating detailed information for each university, including the required subjects you have to take for each program and their score requirements. Once the updates are ready, you can check the attachment and information here for this university for the latest information. If no attachment is available yet, it usually means the university has not announced further details. You can download a template or sample from here . Tips: For applicants who are in China: If you are an employee, you still need to provide employment separation certificate and your current residence permit. If you are a student, you need to provide transfer certificate, leaving certificate, certificate of attendance rate issued by previous school and your current residence permit.

fields.requirements: Entry Requirements Senior high school diploma,non-Chinese.Students with no basic knowledge of Chinese language can apply to the Chinese major.Students with basic knowledge of Chinese language can enroll as transfer students.Students with HSK 4 can apply for the second year.Students with HSK 4(180 or morel) and HSKK intermediate can apply for the first year of Chinese International Education. Students who want to study in other departments(besides SCS)should have HSK 5 195 or more. Applicants under the age of 18 shall submit relevat ducuments of entrusted legal guardians in China. After obtaining the X1 visa,it is necessary to obtain the certification documents of birth certificate at the Chinese Embassy abroad.If there is no parental information on the birth certificate,the family relationship certificate certified by the Chinese Embassy shall be prvided, and the students can only enter the school after submitting them at the time of enrollment. Note: The cost of one academic year (undergraduate course) is 21800 yuan. The fee includes registration fee, tuition fee and miscellaneous fee, which shall be paid at one time upon enrollment.

fields.materials: Application Materials " * " means necessary documents that you must provide in your application. If you want to book our translation service , please pay and book it at least 2 weeks before the application deadline for submission of all documents; If you want to book our guardian service , you need to pay and book it 2 months before the application deadline, just in case your application fails because of failed to submit application documents on time. * 1. A 2-Inch Photo * 2. Scanned Copy of the first page of Passport With name, passport number & expiration date, and photo included(Photocopy of valid passport identification page. Passport must be an ordinary passport and be valid for at least six months. Applicants currently residing in China must include a copy of the page containing a valid visa or residence permit.) * 3. Resume 1. The Education Background must start from Senior High School until now. 2. If you have worked or once worked, please fill out the Work Experience, and provide the Job Letter (certificate of employment). 3. If you have not worked after graduating from school, fill in the duration and "no working" Note: If not in English or Chinese, it should be translated into English or Chinese. If you can not find a translation organization, please contact CUCAS. You can download a template or sample from here . 4. HSK Certificate Non-essential documents.If you are have, you can provide HSK grade 4 certificate for Bachelor Degree Program. * 5. High school graduate certificate Graduation certificates should be notarized; If not in Chinese or English, graduation certificates should be translated into Chinese or English. If the applicant is a registered student, he/she should also submit his/her study certificate or transfer certificate issued by his/her school. * 6. High school academic transcript Transcripts in languages other than Chinese and English must be accompanied by notarized Chinese or English translations. * 7. Non-criminal Record Certificate (Generally, it is valid for 3 or 6 months) It must be issued by your local police station with official stamp. If not in English or Chinese, it should be translated into English or Chinese. * 8. Physical Examination Form(only valid for 6 months) Please take it to hospital to have a checkup with all items, including personal information, photo, checking date, doctors' suggestion and signature. You can download a template or sample from here . * 9. Bank statement Degree students must provide a bank statement of no less than 40,000 RMB. 10. Supporting Documents: Certificate of Good Conduct Provided by your current/previous school/company in Chinese/English to improve your success rate. You can download a template or sample from here . * 11. CSCA Test Transcript(s) -You need to take the official CSCA test organized by the Chinese government and submit the corresponding subject result transcript(s) when applying. Learn more about the CSCA test >> -The test covers Chinese (Humanities and STEM Chinese), Mathematics, Physics, and Chemistry. Mathematics is required for all programs, while other subjects depend on the university’s specific requirements. -We are updating detailed information for each university, including the required subjects you have to take for each program and their score requirements. fields.requirements: Entry Requirements 1. Applicants should be healthy and well-behaved without criminal record, and be willing to abide by the laws of the Chinese government and the rules and regulations of the college, and respect the Chinese customs and habits. 2. Applicants should be non-Chinese citizens with valid foreign passports, and comply with the Notice on Regulating the Acceptance of International Students by Chinese Higher Education Institutions (Jiaowai Han [2020] No. 12) and other relevant regulations of the Ministry of Education. 3. Applicants should be aged 18-35, with a high school diploma or above. The applicants will be selected based on their highest academic achievements.
fields.materials: Application Materials " * " means necessary documents that you must provide in your application. If you want to book our translation service , please pay and book it at least 2 weeks before the application deadline for submission of all documents; If you want to book our guardian service , you need to pay and book it 2 months before the application deadline, just in case your application fails because of failed to submit application documents on time. * 1. Passport -A clear, full-color scan of your passport information page, showing your name, passport number, expiration date, and photo. -Some universities may also require blank visa pages, so you are advised to upload a few blank pages as well. -Valid for more than 2 years. * 2. Photo -A recent passport-sized ID photo (2 x 2 inches) with a plain white background. -Full face visible, no headwear (except for religious reasons). -Taken within the last 6 months. -In JPG format. * 3. Highest Degree Graduation Certificate -A formal graduation certificate of your highest completed education level (e.g., Senior High School, Bachelor’s, or Master’s degree). -If the document is not in Chinese or English, it must be translated into Chinese or English and notarized by an authorized translation agency or relevant authority. Self-translations are not accepted. * 4. Highest Degree Academic Transcripts -Formal academic transcripts of your highest completed education level (e.g., Senior High School, Bachelor’s, or Master’s degree), covering ALL academic years, NOT just the final year. -If not current high school graduates, all courses’ transcripts of universities already studied and resume of study or work experience after graduation are required). -If the document is not in Chinese or English, it must be translated into Chinese or English and notarized by an authorized translation agency or relevant authority. Self-translations are not accepted. * 5. Non-criminal Record Certificate -Please note that this document is generally valid for only 6 months. For instance, if you submit your application in March, your non-criminal record must have been issued no earlier than September of the previous year. -Obtain this certificate from the local police station of your current residence, confirming that you have had no criminal record during the 6 months prior to the date of issuance. -If you are currently in China, the certificate must be issued by the local Chinese police. -If the document is not in Chinese or English, it must be translated and notarized by an authorized agency or relevant authority. Self-translations are not accepted. * 6. Physical Examination Form -Download the form template, print it, and bring it to a hospital for the required medical tests. The hospital will complete the form with your results. -The medical examination must cover all items listed on the form. -Ensure your photo is attached and the form is stamped and signed by the hospital after the examination. -The medical results are valid for 6 months only. -Forms that are incomplete, lack a final physician’s suggestion, missing the attending physician’s signature, official hospital stamp, or applicant’s sealed photo will be considered invalid. -The document must be in English or Chinese. You can download a template or sample from here . * 7. Study Plan * 8. Financial Guarantee for international students and scanned copies of its guarantee materials. Financial guarantee materials include: (1)Download the specific template required by the university from here. Your financial guarantor must print, complete, sign, and provide a scanned copy of the signed document.(The document must be in English or Chinese.) (2)Certificate of deposit that can cover reasonable expenses for study, living and international travel during their study in China; (3) Scanned copy of valid passport or identity certificate of their sponsor (limited to the applicant himself or his immediate family). You can download a template or sample from here . * 9. CV -Submit a resume or CV to help the university better understand your background. -Please include your study plan in China also. -Written in Chinese or in English. Your resume must include a complete and continuous list of your education and work experience, covering all periods up to the time you apply to university, without missing a single year or month. -Some universities may require you to use their designated CV templates, which must be downloaded and completed accordingly. Tips: For applicants who are in China: If you are an employee, you still need to provide employment separation certificate and your current residence permit. If you are a student, you need to provide transfer certificate, leaving certificate, certificate of attendance rate issued by previous school and your current residence permit.

fields.requirements: Entry Requirements 1. Applicants holding valid foreign passports and in good health, with a high school degree or above. 2. Be aged over 16, those who are under 18 before August 31 of the application year, please visit Downloadto download and submit GUARANTEE STATEMENT. 3. Comply with the regulations （JW〔2020〕No. 12） issued by Ministry of Education of People’s Republic of China. 4. Applicants should meet the following language requirements English-taught Programs: minimum requirements of TOEFL 80 or IELTS 6.0 or Duolingo 105. Those who can provide English-taught proof for previous degrees or native English speakers do not need to submit the English Proficiency Certificate. 5. CSCA scores are preferred for priority admission, CSCA Test Subjects download here . Note: Tuition of the 3rd year: ECUST Tuition +Estimated International Tuition of £ 32,350
fields.materials: Application Materials " * " means necessary documents that you must provide in your application. If you want to book our translation service , please pay and book it at least 2 weeks before the application deadline for submission of all documents; If you want to book our guardian service , you need to pay and book it 2 months before the application deadline, just in case your application fails because of failed to submit application documents on time. * 1. Non-criminal Record Certificate If applicant is unable to get one at home country, please sign Non-criminal Record Affirmation. International students studying in China can submit a certificate of no bad performance issued by school. You can download a template or sample from here . * 2. Letters of recommendation * 3. Statement of Financial Support You can download a template or sample from here . * 4. Study Plan(minimum of 800 words with introduction of yourself and your family, reasons for choosing ECUST and the major) 5. Foreigner Physical Examination Form with validity of less than 6 months when submission(applicants for scholarship must submit). You can download a template or sample from here . 6. Additional documents when necessary Applicants in design program should provide at least 1 art work. * 7. Handwriting Signature * 8. Self-introduction (recorded in video) No longer than 3 minutes. * 9. Copy of passport photo page(Valid until Sept. 1st, 2027 and beyond) * 10. A white background ID photo * 11. Transcripts of all high school courses or results of international standardization test (A-LEVEL/IB/ICGSE/AP/SAT/ACT/BC/UEC/STPM etc.) Academic Transcripts in languages other than Chinese or English should be translated into Chinese or English and be certified by notarization. Both original and official English translated version are required. * 12. Copy of high school diploma or equivalent certificate Certificate in languages other than Chinese or English should be translated into Chinese or English and be certified by notarization. Both original and official English translated version are required. Prospective diploma recipients must submit an official document issued by the current school to prove the current study status and expected graduation date. If applicants are admitted, a scan copy of the graduation and degree certificate shall be sent before registration. * 13. English proficiency test certificate For example, IELTS or TOEFL, only for applicant whose native language is not English. * 14. CSCA Test Transcript(s) -You need to take the official CSCA test organized by the Chinese government and submit the corresponding subject result transcript(s) when applying. Learn more about the CSCA test >> -The test covers Chinese (Humanities and STEM Chinese), Mathematics, Physics, and Chemistry. Mathematics is required for all programs, while other subjects depend on the university’s specific requirements. -We are updating detailed information for each university, including the required subjects you have to take for each program and their score requirements. Once the updates are ready, you can check the attachment and information here for this university for the latest information. If no attachment is available yet, it usually means the university has not announced further details. -Note: Bachelor degree JMD programs don't require CSCA. You can download a template or sample from here . Tips: For applicants who are in China: If you are an employee, you still need to provide employment separation certificate and your current residence permit. If you are a student, you need to provide transfer certificate, leaving certificate, certificate of attendance rate issued by previous school and your current residence permit.

fields.requirements: Entry Requirements 1) Requirements on Citizenship Non-Chinese citizens who meet the requirements of the Ministry of Education's Document [2020] No. 12, which requires those who emigrated to other countries from the Mainland China, Hong Kong, Macao, or Taiwan applying to study in ZUST as international students, should meet the following additional requirements: the applicants must hold valid passport or other relevant internationally recognized documents for at least 4 years; meanwhile, in the latest 4 years (by each April 30th of the year of University registration), the applicants must have lived overseas for 2 years (Living overseas for 9 months can be converted to 1 year, which is subject to the exit-entry stamp on visa). 2) General Requirements Age ≤45; Bachelor's Degree or above; Good health; No criminal record; No history of drug use. 3) English language proficiency certificate required.
fields.materials: Application Materials " * " means necessary documents that you must provide in your application. If you want to book our translation service , please pay and book it at least 2 weeks before the application deadline for submission of all documents; If you want to book our guardian service , you need to pay and book it 2 months before the application deadline, just in case your application fails because of failed to submit application documents on time. * 1. Certificate of no criminal record You can download a template or sample from here . * 2. English proficiency certificate English proficiency certificate for the applicants whose native language is not English (English-taught programs) * 3. Statement of Financial Support (Bank statement to prove that the Applicants has sufficient fund to afford his or her tuition, accommodation and living expenses in China). You can download a template or sample from here . * 4. Study Plan or Research Plan(written in Chinese or English) * 5. Foreigner physical examination form. You can download a template or sample from here . * 6. Confirmation signature To show you promise that all the information in your application form and all your application materials are true. You agree to upload your signature to confirm. You can sign your complete FULL NAME on a white paper and upload. Note: the signature must be from the applicant himself or herself. * 7. A statement of no drug addiction history. You can download a template or sample from here . * 8. A scanned copy of the Passport Cover & the Passport Information Page, scanned copies of all visa pages in China. * 9. Passport photo A recent passport-sized photo of the applicant * 10. Diploma and certificate of Senior high school graduation certificate (notarized photocopy in Chinese or English). If the original certificate is not in English or Chinese, a notarized translation version is also required. Fresh high school graduates shall be issued a pre-graduation certificate by their school, and the original high school graduation certificate must be submitted when students register. * 11. Academic transcripts in high school. Transcripts in languages other than Chinese or English shall be attached with notarized translations in Chinese or English; If the original transcript is not in English or Chinese, a notarized translation version is also required. * 12. Two letters of recommendation (with a signature of a professor and the contact information of the professor). Tips: For applicants who are in China: If you are an employee, you still need to provide employment separation certificate and your current residence permit. If you are a student, you need to provide transfer certificate, leaving certificate, certificate of attendance rate issued by previous school and your current residence permit.

fields.requirements: Entry Requirements (1) Non-Chinese citizen in good health, hold personal passport. (2) Age and education background: For bachelor program, applicant should obtain a high school degree or above and be no more than 25 years old; Applicants whose Chinese language ability does not meet the relevant requirements can apply for Chinese language program of no more than 2 academic years before starting academic study, and should meet the corresponding program age requirements when starting academic study. (3) Outstanding in academic performance. (4) Students outside China should be able to have online communication facilities, such as laptop, stableinternet connection, etc. to carry out the interview and necessary communication for application. (5) Abide by local laws, university rules and regulations. (6) Agree to study according to graduation (HSK and research paper) requirements. (7) Bachelor program requirements: HSK 4 with a score above 180. (8) CSCA subjects requirements download here .
fields.materials: Application Materials " * " means necessary documents that you must provide in your application. If you want to book our translation service , please pay and book it at least 2 weeks before the application deadline for submission of all documents; If you want to book our guardian service , you need to pay and book it 2 months before the application deadline, just in case your application fails because of failed to submit application documents on time. * 1. 1-inch Electronic Personal Photo(JPG format) * 2. Passport photocopy A clearly visible copy of your valid passport with name, photo, birth date, place of birth, date of issue, and date of expiry. Visa page is required for applicants who are currently living outside their own country of residence. The passport validity period must be after March 1st, 2027. The passport can not be changed after the submission of the application until enrollment. * 3. Non-Criminal Record Notarized Chinese or English translation is required for non-Chinese and English versions. * 4. Chinese proficiency test certificate * 5. High school graduate certificate Please provide High School graduation certificate. Copies of the original certificate with the school’s official stamp and/or the signature of the principal. If the originals are not in Chinese or English, they must be translated and notarized. * 6. High school academic transcript Please provide High School transcripts of all grades. Copies of the original transcript with the school’s official stamp and/or the signature of the principal. If the originals are not in Chinese or English, they must be translated and notarized. * 7. Personal Statement An essay statement written in English or Chinese on one page of A4 size paper. Introduce why you are applying for, describe your interest and enthusiasm for the chosen major or research field, and how your previous studies or experiences relate to it. Describe what makes you suitable, such as relevant skills,experience, or achievements gained from previous education, work, and other activities. * 8. TWO Recommendation Letters -Must be written in Chinese or English by professors or associate professors (for master’s and Ph.D. applicants) or teachers from your last university or high school (for bachelor’s applicants). -Letters must include the recommender’s name, contact information (email and phone), and handwritten signature (no typed signatures). -Please make the letters as official as possible. -If you plan to apply to multiple universities, do not mention the name of a specific Chinese university in the letter, to avoid rewriting for each application. * 9. Statement of Financial Support -Download the template attached -The statement should be completed by the applicant and his/her sponsor, then be signed, scanned and uploaded online as one of the application documents. You can download a template or sample from here . * 10. Foreigner Physical Examination certificate (Valid in 6 months) Applicants should strictly follow the requirements of the Physical Examination Record For Foreigner and provide a detailed report of blood examination. Incomplete records, those without the signature of the doctor, the official stamp of the hospital or a sealed photograph of the applicants are invalid. You can download a template or sample from here . 11. A Self-introduction Video -Please speak in English or Chinese. -The video should be at least 2 minutes long, in MP4 format, and less than 7 MB. -Include a brief self-introduction, your study plan after enrollment, reasons for applying to this program and university in China, and your plans after graduation. -You may also highlight your language ability, interests, confidence, and motivation. * 12. CSCA Test Transcript(s) -You need to take the official CSCA test organized by the Chinese government and submit the corresponding subject result transcript(s) when applying. Learn more about the CSCA test >> -The test covers Chinese (Humanities and STEM Chinese), Mathematics, Physics, and Chemistry. Mathematics is required for all programs, while other subjects depend on the university’s specific requirements. -We are updating detailed information for each university, including the required subjects you have to take for each program and their score requirements. Once the updates are ready, you can check the attachment and information here for this university for the latest information. If no attachment is available yet, it usually means the university has not announced further details. You can download a template or sample from here . Tips: For applicants who are in China: If you are an employee, you still need to provide employment separation certificate and your current residence permit. If you are a student, you need to provide transfer certificate, leaving certificate, certificate of attendance rate issued by previous school and your current residence permit.

fields.requirements: Entry Requirements 1. Applicants must be non-Chinese citizens with a valid passport. For applicants who used to be Chinese citizens but later immigrated to other countries, the conditions set by the Document No. 12 (2020) of Ministry of Education of the People’s Republic of China should be met. 2. Applicant must have a high school diploma and be under the age of 25. Applicants who are still under the age of 18 as of September 1st, 2026 must submit the original guardian certificate issued by the Tianjin District Notary Office, and the Guardian must be a permanent resident of Tianjin. Applicants should be in good health and of good character, be well-behaved and be willing to abide by China's laws and regulations, as well as the university rules. 3. Language Proficiency Requirements: For English-instructed program applicants: Students are required to submit English Proficiency Certificates. IELTS 6.0 or TOEFL 80 is mandatory. Native English speakers are exempted from providing relevant certificates. For applicants who completed their high school study in English, a Certificate of High School Study in English should be submitted as alternative language certificate instead of IELTS or TOEFL. 4. CSCA subjects requirements download here .

fields.materials: Application Materials " * " means necessary documents that you must provide in your application. If you want to book our translation service , please pay and book it at least 2 weeks before the application deadline for submission of all documents; If you want to book our guardian service , you need to pay and book it 2 months before the application deadline, just in case your application fails because of failed to submit application documents on time. * 1. Non-criminal record report Applicants shall submit a valid certificate of Non-Criminal Record issued by the local public security authority, usually issued within 6 months prior to the submission date of the application. * 2. Financial statement or bank statement The available balance should be no less than 30,000 RMB (The minimum amount of financial proof for full scholarship applicants may be appropriately lowered). * 3. A Personal Statement No less than 800 words, stating your basic personal information, hobbies and expertise, motivation, study plan, etc. * 4. Foreigner Physical Examination Form The form shall be filled by the physician in Chinese or English. The physical examinations must cover all the items listed in the form with a suggestion filled by the doctor. Incomplete records or those without the signature of the attending physician, the official stamp of the hospital or a sealed photograph of the applicants are invalid. Attachments of examination results (Laboratory exam report, Electrocardiograph and Chest X-ray report) shall also be uploaded. Please carefully plan your physical examination schedule as the result is valid for only 6 months. Applicants in China can take the physical examination at the international travel health care center. You can download a template or sample from here . 5. Other Attachments For Arts programs, applicants must have related academic background and are required to submit the portfolio (such as paintings, story scripts, short movies, etc.). 6. Study or Work certificate For applicants who are currently studying or working in an institution, a Certificate of Enrollment or Employment issued by the institution is required. * 7. Certificate of HSK * 8. Information Page of Ordinary Passport. The passport must remain valid until after September 2025. For applicants who are already in China, a photocopy of Visa or Residence Permit with entry customs stamps should be provided as well. * 9. Passport photo A recent passport-sized photo of the applicant * 10. High school official transcripts Academic transcript in languages other than Chinese or English should be translated into Chinese or English and be certified by notarization. * 11. Notarized high school diploma Applicants who have already graduated from high school shall submit graduation certificate of high school. Prospective diploma recipients shall submit a pre-graduation certificate issued by the high school, and bring the official degree diploma for registration if admitted, otherwise the admission qualification will be cancelled. If the original copy is in a different language, a notarized translated version in Chinese or English must be submitted together * 12. fields.description: Program Description Tuition: 14500 Yuan/RMB/the fall semester 19350 Yuan/RMB/the spring semester Introduction: Tongji University is one of the first universities to undertake the Pre-University education of Chinese government scholarship undergraduate students in China, and at the same time recruit self funded preparatory students. Located in Siping Road Campus of Tongji University, the Pre-University department for foreign students of Tongji University, Ministry of education, has a teaching building with Chinese traditional architectural characteristics, modern teaching facilities such as multimedia classroom, special classroom, lecture hall, electronic reading room, Chinese culture classroom, and a team of full-time teachers of Chinese, physics, mathematics and chemistry. All the teachers have graduate degree or above, and the teachers are strong enough to fully meet the needs of Pre-University education. At present, the Pre-University Department has nearly 80 countries of Chinese government scholarship undergraduate preparatory students and some self funded students in school. They will systematically study general Chinese, professional Chinese, mathematics, physics, chemistry and other basic courses, and participate in various forms of school activities, such as language and culture activities around teaching, Experience of China activities, etc. As one of the most famous universities in China, Tongji University’s international student Pre-University “bridge course” is connected with China's famous universities. According to the characteristics of international students, the preparatory course “bridge course” helps students quickly master the learning methods of China’s famous universities, adapt to the undergraduate learning life in advance, shorten the adaptation period of studying abroad, and finally smoothly enter the dream university suitable for themselves to study undergraduate major. fields.description: Program Description 1. Program Introduction Editor Notes: The aim of this major is to cultivate students with the basic application of Chinese Language. In the regular Chinese program, winter semester usually starts at the beginning of September and ends at the beginning of January, while summer semester usually from early March to late June. 2. Courses Structure Editor Notes: There are 16 teaching weeks in each semester, with 20+ class hours (Chinese classes plus selective courses) each week. Students will have Chinese classes in the morning from Monday to Friday, and the selective courses in the afternoon. Selective courses usually include China economy lectures and various cultural classes according to students' needs. 3. Textbooks New Practical Chinese Reader , Chinese Tutorial and Developing Chinese (published by Beijing Language and Culture University) are mainly used as textbooks, together with supportive textbooks like General Information of China and Elementary Business Chinese Dialogue as well as the University's own teaching materials. 4. Fees Application Fee: RMB 400 Textbooks and Materials (in RMB): About 150 to 300 per semester 5. School Introduction Editor Notes: It is one of the top 100 universities in the nation's 211 Project, a national initiative to build 100 first-class universities in the 21st century. The University , boasts a strong faculty of scholarly excellence and professional dedication. Added to this is the classic campus setting, situated in Chengdu, a beautiful city of fine culture and long history plus being in the vicinity of Du Fu Thatched Cottage, residence of a prominent poet in Tang Dynasty , Learn More>> 6. The College of International Education Editor Notes: The College of International Education of SWUFE was established in 2004. ​ It is the combination of the former Foreign Students Education Center and the SWUFE Training Center for Personnel Working/Studying Abroad. There are above 20 full and part time professors and teachers, many of whom have experience teaching in foreign countries in Asia, Europe, America and Africa. The highly-qualified faculty is among the top in western China. 7. Campus Life Editor Notes: International students enjoy the wonderful life in the campus. Recreational Activities Internship

fields.requirements: Entry Requirements 1. Non-Chinese citizens, physically and mentally healthy, able to meet the normal study and life at school. 2. High school graduate with high school diploma or above. 3. Friendly towards China, law-abiding, and no criminal record. Others If both or one of the parents is a Chinese citizen and resides in a foreign country, and the applicant who wants to come to China as a foreign student for undergraduate study has foreign nationality by birth, then the applicant must have a record of actual residence in a foreign country for more than 2 years within the last 4 years (as of April 30, 2025). (Nine (9) months of actual residence in a foreign country can be counted as one year, subject to the entry and exit seal stamps). If a Chinese citizen after emigrating abroad applies to come to China as a foreign student for undergraduate study, then they shall hold a valid foreign passport or certificate of nationality for more than 4 years, and a record of actual residence in a foreign country for more than 2 years within the last 4 years (as of April 30, 2025). (Nine (9) months of actual residence in a foreign country can be counted as one year, subject to the entry and exit seal stamps).

fields.description: Program Description 1) Training requirements: 1. Adapted to all the four Chinese language abilities used in Chinese teaching environment, including listening, speaking, reading and writing skills 2. Master some basic professional knowledge 3. Gradually adapt to the teaching methods and learning methods of the university 4. Have the ability to learn and think independently. 2) Program categories Chinese Class (long term): The long-term class (more than half a year) enrolls students twice a year, starting in March and September respectively, with different levels: primary, intermediate and advanced courses. The core courses include: reading and writing, listening and speaking, reading, intensive reading, scientific Chinese, and Chinese culture, etc. According to the applicants’ application and class placement interview results, several small classes will be organized for teaching. Each class will have listening, speaking, reading and writing courses to comprehensively develop students' four skills. Classes will run from Monday to Friday. Every week 22-30 class hours will be arranged. In addition, there will be special tutoringcourses for HSK. ※ During the epidemic, online Chinese language classes will be provided. After the outbreak, the registration fee will be waived for online students who continue to study offline. 3) Completion and further education Upon completion: Students who pass the required courses and obtain the required credits will be awarded the Certificate of Completion for Chinese Language Training issued by the Institute of International Education. Further education: Students who have completed all the teaching procedures prescribed in the training program and passed the undergraduate qualification examination can directly enter the undergraduate program of our university. Those who do not meet the eligibility criteria for completion or fail to pass the qualification examination for admission to the undergraduate program may continue to study in the language program until they pass.

description.text: Program Description 1) Training requirements: 1. Adapted to all the four Chinese language abilities used in Chinese teaching environment, including listening, speaking, reading and writing skills 2. Master some basic professional knowledge 3. Gradually adapt to the teaching methods and learning methods of the university 4. Have the ability to learn and think independently. 2) Program categories Chinese Class (long term): The long-term class (more than half a year) enrolls students twice a year, starting in March and September respectively, with different levels: primary, intermediate and advanced courses. The core courses include: reading and writing, listening and speaking, reading, intensive reading, scientific Chinese, and Chinese culture, etc. According to the applicants’ application and class placement interview results, several small classes will be organized for teaching. Each class will have listening, speaking, reading and writing courses to comprehensively develop students' four skills. Classes will run from Monday to Friday. Every week 22-30 class hours will be arranged. In addition, there will be special tutoringcourses for HSK. ※ During the epidemic, online Chinese language classes will be provided. After the outbreak, the registration fee will be waived for online students who continue to study offline. 3) Completion and further education Upon completion: Students who pass the required courses and obtain the required credits will be awarded the Certificate of Completion for Chinese Language Training issued by the Institute of International Education. Further education: Students who have completed all the teaching procedures prescribed in the training program and passed the undergraduate qualification examination can directly enter the undergraduate program of our university. Those who do not meet the eligibility criteria for completion or fail to pass the qualification examination for admission to the undergraduate program may continue to study in the language program until they pass.

fields.description: Program Description The Chinese Language Course Summer Program of the School of International Culture, South China Normal University, has been successfully held for twenty years. It is dedicated to providing a diverse platform for overseas students and friends to learn Chinese and experience China. With its long history of running the program, rich experience in organizing classes, high-quality teaching system, and extensive and in-depth cultural exchanges between China and foreign countries, it has attracted more and more international friends. Every year, over 300 participants from more than 30 countries take part in it, and it has trained thousands of enthusiasts of Chinese culture. To meet the learning needs of Chinese culture enthusiasts at home and abroad, the school will hold a four-week Chinese Language Course Summer Program in Guangzhou, China from July 14th to August 8th, 2025. We sincerely welcome overseas students and friends to join this immersive Chinese language learning journey! Study Period July 6-July 31 (4 weeks) Levels offered Beginner, Elementary, Intermediate, Advanced Course Scheme Schedule：(This is for reference only. Detailed arrangement will be notified upon the commencement of the camp.) Morning classes：9：00-11：20 Afternoon classes：13：30-15：00 Chinese Language Courses: Focus on enhancing students' daily communication skills. Levels offered: ‌Beginner, Elementary, Intermediate, Advanced‌. Students must take a ‌Chinese proficiency test‌ to determine class placement (Minimum class size: 10 students). Cultural Courses: Help students explore traditional Chinese culture through diverse and engaging formats, such as: Chinese intangible cultural heritage (e.g., Paper-cutting, Rubbing), Chinese calligraphy and painting, Chinese cuisine. Field Trips: The school organizes ‌one group city tour‌ in Guangzhou. Students will experience Guangzhou’s millennia-old cultural heritage under teacher guidance and discover the vibrant charm of Lingnan Culture.
