fields.description: Program Description 1. Program Introduction Editor Notes: The length of the program is 1 semester up to 3 years. There are two semesters in each year. It is about 4 months for each semester. The class hours are 20 for one week (one class hour equals 45 minutes). 2. Course Arrangement Editor Notes: There are basic Chinese language courses and elective course in this program. Comprehensive Chinese language courses (including grammar, vocabulary, reading comprehension and oral training). The level of difficulty ranges from beginner level, elementary level, intermediate level and advanced level. Level Textbook Present level of Chinese Learning objectives Language competency Vocabulary Contents of courses Objectives One Easy Learning Chinese basic course book one、two and three None Zero Can recognize Pinyin and write simple Chinese character; can greet with simple words and speak Chinese in classroom settings; can talk about food, hobbies, weather. HSK 2-3 Two Easy Learning Chinese basic course book two、three and four Have Learned Chinese for more than 80 hours, can recognize Pinyin and simple Chinese characters; can make easy conversations. Around 300 Can grasp the knowledge about notification, congratulations, apologize and demand; can make comparative sentences; can cope with simple life and school communication scenarios. HSK 3 Three Easy Learning Chinese basic course book three and four; intermediate course book one Have Learned Chinese for more than 160 hours, can recognize textbook without Pinyin, and can express their own idea. Around 500 On the basis of knowing language, discuss the hot topics related to Chinese culture such as health care, pets, leftover single men and women, environmental protection, the ability to communicate and solve practical problems in Chinese. HSK 3-4 Four Easy Learning Chinese basic course book four, intermediate course book one and two Have learned Chinese for more than 260 hours, can understand daily life expressions and express own ideas or thoughts in paragraphs. Around 1000 Grasp the meaning and usage of idioms, related words, colloquial words and usage in the text, understand the cultural differences of various countries, Chinese regional cultural differences, travel, food, love, fashion and Dressing(clothes matching), family, medical treatment, the concept of friendship and Internet education.。 HSK 4 Five Easy Learning Chinese intermediate course book one, two and three Have learned Chinese for more than 320 hours, Can communicate fluently in Chinese, and read general essays and express your views and ideas systematically. Around 1600 Use the learned vocabulary and language points to express sentences, retell texts, make keynote speeches or debates, etc. learn to read news or articles; learn to express your opinions in writing, learn cultural knowledge and phenomena that appear in the text, such as Qingming Festival, the way of health preservation, table manners, bow headed clan(people)", Long-distance love, Globalization, etc. HSK 4-5 six Easy Learning Chinese intermediate course book two, three and four Learn Chinese for more than 400hours, you will be able to talk about a wide range of topics in Chinese, be able to to read common Chinese newspapers and magazines and also be able to enjoy simple Chinese movies and TV programs. Around 2500 Learn and understand Chinese cultural knowledge and current hot topics related to the content of the textbooks, for example; The Chinese dream, World citizens, China's double 11, Shanghai Disneyland, etc. and express your views through situational dialogues, speeches, debates, etc. HSK 5 Seven TALKING ABOUT CHINESE CULTURE Book I AND II Have learned Chinese for more than 560 hours, can use vocabulary freely, can read basic newspapers and magazines Around 3200 Introduce and analyze Chinese culture, discuss cross-cultural topics with students through debates and speeches, for example: Gift-giving culture, The concept of Marriage, Family, Hierarchy, borrowing money, etc. HSK 5-6 3. Tuition and Fees (in RMB) Editor Notes: The fees is subject to the school standard when the applicants arrive at the school. Length of Program Tuition Application Fee Insurance One semester 10,000 500 300 One year 20,000 500 600 One month 4,500 500 Two months 7,000 500 Three months 8,500 500 5. School Introduction Editor Notes: SISU has successfully developed a diverse and distinctive mix of disciplines with language and literature as its pillar. The University ,Shanghai International Studies University, abbreviated as SISU, as one of the key universities of the national project "211", is jointly administered by China's Ministry of Education and Shanghai Municipal Government. Founded in 1949, SISU was one of the first key universities engaged in both foreign language teaching and cultural exchanges with foreign countries since the establishment of the PRC , Learn More>> 6. Cooperation & Exchange Editor Notes: SISU has established inter-university cooperation and exchange with 119 universities from 32 countries and regions ​ The University has built partnerships with above 300 universities and institutions from 55 countries and regions. The University has connected with international organizations, including the United Nations and the European Union closely. The University has compiled and published a series of Mandarin Chinese textbooks to be used by non-Chinese speakers. The faculty and students actively participates in international conferences, sports games and other multilingual events. The University has set up a powerful digital audio-visual database containing multimedia resources in foreign studies. There are 11 highly regarded and rigorously peer-reviewed academic journals being edited and published currently by the University. ​ 7. Campus Life Editor Notes: International students enjoy the wonderful life in the campus. Autumn Outing Spring Outing

According to the regulations of the Ministry of Education of China, those who immigrated to other countries from the Mainland China, Hong Kong, Macao or Taiwan and are applying to study at UPC as international students, should meet the following additional requirements. He / She should be in good health conditions and of good conduct. He / She should also abide by the Chinese laws, regulations and the rules of the university. Applicants should graduate from high school or above （Applicants who are still in the last year of high school can provide expected graduation certificate for submitting application while the official graduation certificate must be provided before enrollment）. TOEFL no less than 80 or IELTS no less than 5.5 or pass interview organized by ZISU. No more than 40 year old.

If you want to book our translation service , please pay and book it at least 2 weeks before the application deadline for submission of all documents; If you want to book our guardian service , you need to pay and book it 2 months before the application deadline, just in case your application fails because of failed to submit application documents on time. * 1. Passport -A clear, full-color scan of your passport information page, showing your name, passport number, expiration date, and photo. -Some universities may also require blank visa pages, so you are advised to upload a few blank pages as well. * 2. Photo -A recent passport-sized ID photo (2 x 2 inches) with a plain white background. -Full face visible, no headwear (except for religious reasons). -Taken within the last 6 months. * 3. Highest Degree Graduation Certificate -A formal graduation certificate of your highest completed education level (e.g., Senior High School, Bachelor’s, or Master’s degree). -If the document is not in Chinese or English, it must be translated into Chinese or English and notarized by an authorized translation agency or relevant authority. Self-translations are not accepted. * 4. Highest Degree Academic Transcripts -Formal academic transcripts of your highest completed education level (e.g., Senior High School, Bachelor’s, or Master’s degree), covering ALL academic years, NOT just the final year. -If the document is not in Chinese or English, it must be translated into Chinese or English and notarized by an authorized translation agency or relevant authority. Self-translations are not accepted. * 5. English Language Proficiency Certificate -IELTS (6.0 or above) or TOEFL iBT (90 or above) is generally preferred. -If you are unable to provide these test results, you may submit alternative proof, such as a Duolingo English Test score or an official English proficiency certificate issued by your previous school/university, stating that the medium of instruction was English. -Higher scores are preferred. * 6. Non-criminal Record Certificate -Obtain a police clearance certificate from the local police station where you currently reside, confirming no criminal record in the past 6 months at the time of application. -Some universities may require a certificate covering only the past 3 months, in which case the certificate is valid for 3 months only. -If you are currently in China, the certificate must be issued by the local Chinese police. -If the document is not in Chinese or English, it must be translated and notarized by an authorized agency or relevant authority. Self-translations are not accepted. * 7. Health Examination Report within 6 months -Download the form template, print it, and bring it to a hospital for the required medical tests. The hospital will complete the form with your results. -The medical examination must cover all items listed on the form. -Ensure your photo is attached and the form is stamped and signed by the hospital after the examination. -The medical results are valid for 6 months only. -Forms that are incomplete, lack a final physician’s recommendation, missing the attending physician’s signature, official hospital stamp, or applicant’s sealed photo will be considered invalid. -The document must be in English or Chinese. You can download a template or sample from here . * 8. Bank Certificate of Deposit -An official bank statement, issued and stamped by the bank, showing your financial guarantor’s account balance and ability to support your studies in China. -The account holder must be your financial guarantor, such as a parent. -The balance should cover at least one year’s tuition, accommodation, and living expenses. -Submit a scanned copy or a clear photo (a printed version with bank stamp is preferred). -Please also provide a copy of the financial guarantor’s passport or national ID card. -The document must be in English or Chinese. Tips: For applicants who are in China: If you are an employee, you still need to provide employment separation certificate and your current residence permit. If you are a student, you need to provide transfer certificate, leaving certificate, certificate of attendance rate issued by previous school and your current residence permit.

Self-introduction: Name, nationality and passport number, educational background, application level and Chinese proficiency(The level of one's Chinese proficiency is not taken into account as an admission criterion.). 2. Understanding of China and the university 3. Why study in China. 4. Willingness to abide by school discipline ?. Tips: For applicants who are in China: If you are an employee, you still need to provide employment separation certificate and your current residence permit. If you are a student, you need to provide transfer certificate, leaving certificate, certificate of attendance rate issued by previous school and your current residence permit.

fields.materials: Application Materials " * " means necessary documents that you must provide in your application. If you want to book our translation service , please pay and book it at least 2 weeks before the application deadline for submission of all documents; If you want to book our guardian service , you need to pay and book it 2 months before the application deadline, just in case your application fails because of failed to submit application documents on time. * 1. The first page and one blank page of the passport -A clear, full-color scan of your passport information page, showing your name, passport number, expiration date, and photo. -Some universities may also require blank visa pages, so you are advised to upload a few blank pages as well. * 2. 2-inch color photos -A recent passport-sized ID photo (2 x 2 inches) with a plain white background. -Full face visible, no headwear (except for religious reasons). -Taken within the last 6 months. * 3. Highest Degree Graduation Certificate -A formal graduation certificate of your highest completed education level (e.g., Senior High School, Bachelor’s, or Master’s degree). -If the document is not in Chinese or English, it must be translated into Chinese or English and notarized by an authorized translation agency or relevant authority. Self-translations are not accepted. * 4. Highest Degree Academic Transcripts -Formal academic transcripts of your highest completed education level (e.g., Senior High School, Bachelor’s, or Master’s degree), covering ALL academic years, NOT just the final year. -If the document is not in Chinese or English, it must be translated into Chinese or English and notarized by an authorized translation agency or relevant authority. Self-translations are not accepted. * 5. English Language Proficiency Certificate * 6. Physical Examination Form -Download the form template, print it, and bring it to a hospital for the required medical tests. The hospital will complete the form with your results. -The medical examination must cover all items listed on the form. -Ensure your photo is attached and the form is stamped and signed by the hospital after the examination. -The medical results are valid for 6 months only. -Forms that are incomplete, lack a final physician’s suggestion, missing the attending physician’s signature, official hospital stamp, or applicant’s sealed photo or contain abnormal examination results will be considered invalid. -The document must be in English or Chinese. You can download a template or sample from here . * 7. Handwritten Signature of Applicant -Please sign your name on a white sheet of paper and send us a scanned copy. -This will be used solely for digitally signing relevant application documents on your behalf. * 8. Handwritten Signature of Emergency Contact -Please also ask your Emergency Contact to sign his/her name on a white sheet of paper and send us a scanned copy. -This will be used solely for digitally signing relevant application documents on your behalf. 9. Financial Proof or other warranty to ensure the students can cover all the expenses during their study in China Tips: For applicants who are in China: If you are an employee, you still need to provide employment separation certificate and your current residence permit. If you are a student, you need to provide transfer certificate, leaving certificate, certificate of attendance rate issued by previous school and your current residence permit.

fields.description: Program Description Program Overview With a history of over 30 years, the Chinese Language Program of Sichuan University has enrolled thousands of students from over 80 countries across the globe, earning itself a good reputation and fruitful achievements. In addition to the main courses - integrated Chinese language courses (6-12 class hours per week), the Program provides highly targeted and practical courses for specific language skills (about 10 class hours per week), including Chinese speaking, listening, reading, and writing. Besides, there are specialized Chinese language courses for students at intermediate and advanced levels, including Chinese grammar, vocabulary, phonetics, rhetoric, and ancient Chinese. The Program is committed to helping students grasp the right methods to learn Chinese and enhancing their systemic understanding of the Chinese language. Meanwhile, learning Chinese is not only about the language itself but requires students to have an in-depth understanding of China's national conditions, history, Chinese language culture, Sichuan local culture, etc. Therefore, as students' language competence continues to improve, the Program will also offer a wide range of over 30 general education courses and elective courses, such as Overview of China, Chinese Culture, Business Chinese, Ancient, Modern, and Contemporary Chinese Literature, Chinese Economy, Chinese History, Ancient Chinese Philosophy, Chinese Minority Art, Chinese Idioms and Proverbs, Chinese Character Knowledge and Culture, Bashu Culture, Sichuan Dialect, Chinese Painting and Calligraphy, Tai Chi, and Martial Arts, which are available for students based on their interests. Through rich courses and intensive training, the students will be able to rapidly improve their Chinese proficiency within a short period and further deepen their insight into the knowledge of the Chinese language as well as the culture and national conditions of China. The Program is divided into eight stages in three levels (elementary, intermediate, and advanced), fully meeting the learning needs of students at different levels. Chinese-level exams will be arranged at the beginning of each semester. Students' personal desire, learning purpose, and learning requirements will be given due consideration. Course Overview This Program consists of main and elective courses. The main courses are mainly delivered in the mornings, with about 20 class hours per week. The elective courses are mainly arranged in the afternoons. Students can choose elective courses independently based on their levels and interests. Class classification and course arrangements are explained as follows: 1. Elementary class (Elementary 1 / Elementary 2) Main courses: 9 courses, such as Elementary Integrated Chinese, Reading and Writing of Chinese Characters, and Chinese Listening and Speaking; General education courses: 2 courses: Tai Chi and Martial Arts. After a systematic study of such program courses, elementary students will be fluent in basic daily communication in Chinese and be able to read and write some Chinese. After completing such program courses, students attending Elementary 2 can generally pass the examination of HSK Level 3. 2. Intermediate class (Intermediate 1 / Intermediate 2) Main courses: 8 courses, such as Intermediate Integrated Chinese, Chinese Listening and Speaking, Basic Chinese Writing, and Chinese Reading; General education courses: 5 courses, such as Computer and Network Applications in Chinese, Chinese Culture, and Overview of China; Elective courses: 10 courses, such as Chinese Idioms and Proverbs, Chinese Character Knowledge and Culture, Chinese Minority Art, Bashu Culture, Sichuan Dialect, Cross-cultural Psychological Adaptation, News Listening and Reading, Chinese Painting and Calligraphy, and HSK Level 5 Lectures. After a systematic study of such program courses, intermediate students will be fluent in communication in Chinese and proficient in reading and writing Chinese. Students will have a deeper understanding of China's national conditions, culture, etc. and develop a more enriched knowledge structure, with the level of Chinese being improved significantly. After completing such program courses, students can generally pass the examination of HSK Level 4 or 5. 3. Advanced class (Advanced 1 / Advanced 2 / Advanced 3 / Advanced 4) Main courses: 12 courses, such as Advanced Integrated Chinese, Advanced Spoken Chinese, Modern Chinese Vocabulary, and Modern Chinese Pronunciation; General education courses: 2 courses: Understanding Contemporary China - Advanced Chinese Listening and Speaking, and Understanding Contemporary China - Advanced Chinese Reading and Writing; Elective courses: 20 courses, such as Advanced Reading, Advanced Audio-visual, Ancient Chinese Literature, Contemporary Chinese Literature, Modern Chinese Literature and Society, Ancient Chinese History, Modern and Contemporary Chinese History, Business Chinese, Contemporary Chinese Economy, and Topics in Contemporary China. After a systematic study of such program courses, advanced students will be able to communicate fluently in Chinese on all kinds of topics, with professional reading and writing skills. Meanwhile, such students will have a deeper understanding of China's national conditions, culture, etc. and develop a more enriched knowledge structure, with the level of Chinese being improved significantly. After completing such program courses, students can generally pass the examination of HSK Level 5 or 6. To make students better communicate with native Chinese people in Chinese, understand the real, lively, and diverse Chinese society at present, and fit well into local life, a series of language practice courses have been introduced for intermediate and advanced students, and teachers may lead students to visit communities, educational institutions and cultural venues, to have a face-to-face exchange with different Chinese residents so that students can introduce their countries to Chinese people while learning about Chinese society and culture. Evaluation, Credit, Grade, and Certificate Evaluation of the Program: final examination grade (50%) and whole-process assessment (50%). Students of the Program must meet the attendance requirements. Those absent for over one-third of the courses will be ineligible for the course assessment examinations. Those passing the course assessment examinations will get credits for corresponding courses and be granted by Sichuan University the course transcript and study certificate.

Chinese-level exams will be arranged at the beginning of each semester. Students' personal desire, learning purpose, and learning requirements will be given due consideration. Course Overview This Program consists of main and elective courses. The main courses are mainly delivered in the mornings, with about 20 class hours per week. The elective courses are mainly arranged in the afternoons. Students can choose elective courses independently based on their levels and interests. Class classification and course arrangements are explained as follows: 1. Elementary class (Elementary 1 / Elementary 2) Main courses: 9 courses, such as Elementary Integrated Chinese, Reading and Writing of Chinese Characters, and Chinese Listening and Speaking; General education courses: 2 courses: Tai Chi and Martial Arts. After a systematic study of such program courses, elementary students will be fluent in basic daily communication in Chinese and be able to read and write some Chinese. After completing such program courses, students attending Elementary 2 can generally pass the examination of HSK Level 3. 2. Intermediate class (Intermediate 1 / Intermediate 2) Main courses: 8 courses, such as Intermediate Integrated Chinese, Chinese Listening and Speaking, Basic Chinese Writing, and Chinese Reading; General education courses: 5 courses, such as Computer and Network Applications in Chinese, Chinese Culture, and Overview of China; Elective courses: 10 courses, such as Chinese Idioms and Proverbs, Chinese Character Knowledge and Culture, Chinese Minority Art, Bashu Culture, Sichuan Dialect, Cross-cultural Psychological Adaptation, News Listening and Reading, Chinese Painting and Calligraphy, and HSK Level 5 Lectures. After a systematic study of such program courses, intermediate students will be fluent in communication in Chinese and proficient in reading and writing Chinese. Students will have a deeper understanding of China's national conditions, culture, etc. and develop a more enriched knowledge structure, with the level of Chinese being improved significantly. After completing such program courses, students can generally pass the examination of HSK Level 4 or 5. 3. Advanced class (Advanced 1 / Advanced 2 / Advanced 3 / Advanced 4) Main courses: 12 courses, such as Advanced Integrated Chinese, Advanced Spoken Chinese, Modern Chinese Vocabulary, and Modern Chinese Pronunciation; General education courses: 2 courses: Understanding Contemporary China - Advanced Chinese Listening and Speaking, and Understanding Contemporary China - Advanced Chinese Reading and Writing; Elective courses: 20 courses, such as Advanced Reading, Advanced Audio-visual, Ancient Chinese Literature, Contemporary Chinese Literature, Modern Chinese Literature and Society, Ancient Chinese History, Modern and Contemporary Chinese History, Business Chinese, Contemporary Chinese Economy, and Topics in Contemporary China. After a systematic study of such program courses, advanced students will be able to communicate fluently in Chinese on all kinds of topics, with professional reading and writing skills. Meanwhile, such students will have a deeper understanding of China's national conditions, culture, etc. and develop a more enriched knowledge structure, with the level of Chinese being improved significantly. After completing such program courses, students can generally pass the examination of HSK Level 5 or 6. To make students better communicate with native Chinese people in Chinese, understand the real, lively, and diverse Chinese society at present, and fit well into local life, a series of language practice courses have been introduced for intermediate and advanced students, and teachers may lead students to visit communities, educational institutions and cultural venues, to have a face-to-face exchange with different Chinese residents so that students can introduce their countries to Chinese people while learning about Chinese society and culture. Evaluation, Credit, Grade, and Certificate Evaluation of the Program: final examination grade (50%) and whole-process assessment (50%). Students of the Program must meet the attendance requirements. Those absent for over one-third of the courses will be ineligible for the course assessment examinations. Those passing the course assessment examinations will get credits for corresponding courses and be granted by Sichuan University the course transcript and study certificate.

fields.materials: Application Materials " * " means necessary documents that you must provide in your application. If you want to book our translation service , please pay and book it at least 2 weeks before the application deadline for submission of all documents; If you want to book our guardian service , you need to pay and book it 2 months before the application deadline, just in case your application fails because of failed to submit application documents in time. * 1. University Application Form -Download the application form, fill it out on your computer, and submit it in Word format (.doc). -Complete all fields as fully and accurately as possible. Do not leave any blanks — write “None” if a section does not apply. -The form must be filled in English or Chinese. -The form must be handwritten or digitally signed. You can download a template or sample from here . * 2. Passport-sized photo A 2 inches photo taken recently of the applicant. 3. Photocopy of valid passport With name, passport number & expiration date, and photo included * 4. Highest Degree Graduation Certificate -A formal graduation certificate of your highest completed education level (e.g., Senior High School, Bachelor’s, or Master’s degree). -If the document is not in Chinese or English, it must be translated into Chinese or English and notarized by an authorized translation agency or relevant authority. Self-translations are not accepted. * 5. Highest Degree Academic Transcripts -Formal academic transcripts of your highest completed education level (e.g., Senior High School, Bachelor’s, or Master’s degree), covering ALL academic years, NOT just the final year. -If the document is not in Chinese or English, it must be translated into Chinese or English and notarized by an authorized translation agency or relevant authority. Self-translations are not accepted. * 6. Non-criminal record (Valid within six months) -Please note that this document is generally valid for only 6 months. For instance, if you submit your application in March, your non-criminal record must have been issued no earlier than September of the previous year. -Obtain this certificate from the local police station of your current residence, confirming that you have had no criminal record during the 6 months prior to the date of issuance. -If you are currently in China, the certificate must be issued by the local Chinese police. -If the document is not in Chinese or English, it must be translated and notarized by an authorized agency or relevant authority. Self-translations are not accepted. * 7. Physical examination letter(Valid within six months) -Download the form template, print it, and bring it to a hospital for the required medical tests. The hospital will complete the form with your results. -The medical examination must cover all items listed on the form. -Ensure your photo is attached and the form is stamped and signed by the hospital after the examination. -The medical results are valid for 6 months only. -Forms that are incomplete, lack a final physician’s recommendation, missing the attending physician’s signature, official hospital stamp, or applicant’s sealed photo will be considered invalid. -The document must be in English or Chinese. You can download a template or sample from here . * 8. Bank Statement -An official bank statement, issued and stamped by the bank, showing your parents' or your account balance and ability to support your studies in China. -The account holder must be your financial guarantor, such as a parent. -The balance should cover at least one year’s tuition, accommodation, and living expenses. -Submit a scanned copy or a clear photo (a printed version with bank stamp is preferred). -Please also provide a copy of the financial guarantor’s passport or national ID card. -The document must be in English or Chinese. * 9. Digital Signature -Please sign your name on a white sheet of paper and send us a scanned copy. -This will be used solely for digitally signing relevant application documents on your behalf. * 10. Declaration of No Drugs -Download the specific template required by the university from CUCAS. -Print it, sign it and upload signed and scanned digital copy. -The document must be in English or Chinese. You can download a template or sample from here . Tips: For applicants who are in China: If you are an employee, you still need to provide employment separation certificate and your current residence permit. If you are a student, you need to provide transfer certificate, leaving certificate, certificate of attendance rate issued by previous school and your current residence permit.

fields.requirements: Entry Requirements Basic Requirements (1) Non-Chinese citizens with a valid foreign passport, in good physical and mental health. (2) Academic and Age Requirements: Undergraduate applicants: Should hold a high school diploma or equivalent, and be under the age of 25. (3) Language Proficiency Requirements: For English-taught programs (for non-native speakers): Must provide one of the following: ① IELTS (≥6.0), TOEFL iBT (≥80), or equivalent score report. ② Official documentation from a previous university certifying that the prior degree program was taught entirely in English. ③ Other valid proof of English proficiency. (4) Meet SWJTU's specific academic ability and other relevant admission requirements for the chosen program. (5) Nationality Requirements: Applicants must meet the relevant regulations of the Nationality Law of the People's Republic of China and the Chinese Ministry of Education Document [2020] No. 12. (6) For Undergraduate Applicants: A passing score on the China Scholastic Competency Assessment (CSCA test), organized by the China Scholarship Council (CSC), is required. Please provide the original CSCA score report.

fields.requirements: Entry Requirements 1.Comprehensive Requirements In principle, applicants for undergraduate programs should be under 25 years old. The applicants should be non-Chinese citizens, who is physically and mentally healthy and has good conduct. With a valid foreign passport, they should have completed the study of the previous stage (those who have not graduated while applying must provide the pre-graduation certificate and obtain relevant diplomas before the registration). 2.Nationality Requirements Foreign students should meet the nationality requirements stipulated in the document No.12 [2020] of the Ministry of Education.Since 2021, any applicant who applies to study in undergraduate or college diploma programs in China's higher education institutions as an international student shall, in addition to meeting other eligibility criteria of the institutions, have held a valid foreign passport or nationality certificate for at least four years (inclusive) and have a record of actual residence abroad for two years or more in the past four years (by April 30 of the admission year). Nine consecutive months of residence abroad in a year may be considered as one year, and the calculation is based on entry and exit stamps. 3.Language Requirements English-taught Degree Programs: Applicants (except for English native speakers) must provide proof of English language proficiency such as TOEFL/IELTS/DUOLINGUO Proof or proof of previous study conducted in English. Undergraduate applicants should have a language proficiency score of no less than IELTS 5.5/TOEFL 80/DUOLINGUO 90.Applicants for master’s and doctoral programs should have a language proficiency score of no less than IELTS 6.0/TOEFL 80/DUOLINGUO 100. 4.Academic Proficiency Test for International Undergraduate Programs in China (CSCA) In accordance with the requirements of the higher authorities, starting from the 2026/2027 academic year, all international students applying for undergraduate programs must provide valid CSCA transcripts, download here . For the examination subjects and test paper languages corresponding to each major, please refer to the directory of admitted majors. As a mandatory part of the application, no minimum score has been set at this time.

The applicants should be non-Chinese citizens, who is physically and mentally healthy and has good conduct. With a valid foreign passport, they should have completed the study of the previous stage (those who have not graduated while applying must provide the pre-graduation certificate and obtain relevant diplomas before the registration). 2.Nationality Requirements Foreign students should meet the nationality requirements stipulated in the document No.12 [2020] of the Ministry of Education.Since 2021, any applicant who applies to study in undergraduate or college diploma programs in China's higher education institutions as an international student shall, in addition to meeting other eligibility criteria of the institutions, have held a valid foreign passport or nationality certificate for at least four years (inclusive) and have a record of actual residence abroad for two years or more in the past four years (by April 30 of the admission year). Nine consecutive months of residence abroad in a year may be considered as one year, and the calculation is based on entry and exit stamps. 3.Language Requirements English-taught Degree Programs: Applicants (except for English native speakers) must provide proof of English language proficiency such as TOEFL/IELTS/DUOLINGUO Proof or proof of previous study conducted in English. Undergraduate applicants should have a language proficiency score of no less than IELTS 5.5/TOEFL 80/DUOLINGUO 90.Applicants for master’s and doctoral programs should have a language proficiency score of no less than IELTS 6.0/TOEFL 80/DUOLINGUO 100. 4.Academic Proficiency Test for International Undergraduate Programs in China (CSCA) In accordance with the requirements of the higher authorities, starting from the 2026/2027 academic year, all international students applying for undergraduate programs must provide valid CSCA transcripts, download here . For the examination subjects and test paper languages corresponding to each major, please refer to the directory of admitted majors. As a mandatory part of the application, no minimum score has been set at this time.

materials.text: Application Materials " * " means necessary documents that you must provide in your application. If you want to book our translation service , please pay and book it at least 2 weeks before the application deadline for submission of all documents; If you want to book our guardian service , you need to pay and book it 2 months before the application deadline, just in case your application fails because of failed to submit application documents on time. * 1. Passport With name, passport number & expiration date, and photo included(Photocopy of valid passport identification page. Passport must be an ordinary passport and be valid for at least six months. Applicants currently residing in China must include a copy of the page containing a valid visa or residence permit.) * 2. 2-inch photo Photo format: color 2-inch bareheaded photo, white background without border, head takes up 2/3 of the photo size, photo size is not less than 320*240 pixels, aspect ratio is 4:3, size is 100-500kb, JPG format. * 3. English Language test result TOEFL or IELTS or other English Learning Certificates; * 4. Notarized highest education certificate(this year's graduates provide proof of pregraduation). Your recent diploma.Graduation certificate in languages other than Chinese or English should be translated into Chinese or English and be certified by notarization. * 5. Physical Examination Form(only valid for 6 months) Incomplete records or those without the signature of the attending physician, the official stamp of the hospital or a sealed photograph of the applicants are invalid. Please carefully plan your physical examination schedule as the result is valid for only six months (your results should be valid when you submit your application). *Please be advised that all the health information provided in the Foreigner Physical Examination Form is true and accurate. Please note that any intentional concealment or misrepresentation of health conditions will be considered a serious issue of integrity, which may lead to the rejection of the application or the revocation of any obtained admission eligibility. You can download a template or sample from here . * 6. Notarized highest education academic transcript Documents in languages other than Chinese or English must be attached with translated English or Chinese version. Applicants must present the original cope of the aforementioned documents when registering at ZJSU. * 7. Police Certificate * 8. Confirmation signature I promise that all the information in my application form and all my application materials are true. If there is any falsehood, I will voluntarily bear the corresponding consequences and be disqualified from admission or expelled from academic status. I agree to upload my signature to confirm. Note: the signature must be from the applicant himself or herself. * 9. CV -Submit a resume or CV to help the university better understand your background. -Written in Chinese or in English. Your resume must include a complete and continuous list of your education and work experience, covering all periods up to the time you apply to university, without missing a single year or month. -Some universities may require you to use their designated CV templates, which must be downloaded and completed accordingly. * 10. Study Plan or Personal Statement in Chinese or English. * 11. Enrollment Test Please do the test on: https://www.wjx.cn/vj/hWcm2QG.aspx Please send us the screenshot after you finished it. * 12. Psychological Health Test Please do the test on: https://www.wjx.cn/vm/YOsHCxP.aspx Please send us the screenshot after you finished it. * 13. Self-introduction (recorded in video) Videos in mp4, wmv avi, flv, rmvb format are accepted. * 14. CSCA Test Transcript(s) -You need to take the official CSCA test organized by the Chinese government and submit the corresponding subject result transcript(s) when applying. Learn more about the CSCA test >> -The test covers Chinese (Humanities and STEM Chinese), Mathematics, Physics, and Chemistry. Mathematics is required for all programs, while other subjects depend on the university’s specific requirements. -We are updating detailed information for each university, including the required subjects you have to take for each program and their score requirements. Once the updates are ready, you can check the attachment and information here for this university for the latest information. If no attachment is available yet, it usually means the university has not announced further details. You can download a template or sample from here . Tips: For applicants who are in China: If you are an employee, you still need to provide employment separation certificate and your current residence permit. If you are a student, you need to provide transfer certificate, leaving certificate, certificate of attendance rate issued by previous school and your current residence permit.

fields.materials: Application Materials " * " means necessary documents that you must provide in your application. If you want to book our translation service , please pay and book it at least 2 weeks before the application deadline for submission of all documents; If you want to book our guardian service , you need to pay and book it 2 months before the application deadline, just in case your application fails because of failed to submit application documents on time. * 1. Passport -A clear, full-color scan of your passport information page, showing your name, passport number, expiration date, and photo. -Some universities may also require blank visa pages, so you are advised to upload a few blank pages as well. * 2. Photo -A recent passport-sized ID photo (2 x 2 inches) with a plain white background. -Full face visible, no headwear (except for religious reasons). -Taken within the last 6 months. * 3. High School Graduation Certificate If the document is not in Chinese or English, it must be translated into Chinese or English and notarized by an authorized translation agency or relevant authority. Self-translations are not accepted. * 4. High School Academic Transcripts If the document is not in Chinese or English, it must be translated into Chinese or English and notarized by an authorized translation agency or relevant authority. Self-translations are not accepted. * 5. Non-criminal Record Certificate -Please note that this document is generally valid for only 6 months. For instance, if you submit your application in March, your non-criminal record must have been issued no earlier than September of the previous year. -Obtain this certificate from the local police station of your current residence, confirming that you have had no criminal record during the 6 months prior to the date of issuance. -If you are currently in China, the certificate must be issued by the local Chinese police. -If the document is not in Chinese or English, it must be translated and notarized by an authorized agency or relevant authority. Self-translations are not accepted. * 6. Physical Examination Form -Download the form template, print it, and bring it to a hospital for the required medical tests. The hospital will complete the form with your results. -The medical examination must cover all items listed on the form. -Ensure your photo is attached and the form is stamped and signed by the hospital after the examination. -The medical results are valid for 6 months only. -Forms that are incomplete, lack a final physician’s suggestion, missing the attending physician’s signature, official hospital stamp, or applicant’s sealed photo or contain abnormal examination results will be considered invalid. -The document must be in English or Chinese. You can download a template or sample from here . Tips: For applicants who are in China: If you are an employee, you still need to provide employment separation certificate and your current residence permit. If you are a student, you need to provide transfer certificate, leaving certificate, certificate of attendance rate issued by previous school and your current residence permit.

fields.description: Program Description The Chinese Language Program offered by the International Department aims to provide international students with a systematic and comprehensive Chinese learning experience, dedicated to cultivating international talents who understand and are friendly towards China. Based on solidifying listening, speaking, reading, and writing skills in Chinese, the curriculum organically integrates rich content on China's national conditions and culture. Our experienced teaching team will guide you in deeply exploring contemporary Chinese society, its developmental vitality, and historical context through language learning. By combining classroom teaching with social practice, you will gain the ability to use Chinese in real-life environments, understand China, enhance your language skills, and form a more comprehensive and profound understanding of the country.

fields.requirements: Entry Requirements 1 Applicants must be non-Chinese citizens and valid foreign passport holders. 2 Under the age of 25, applicants must have graduated from high school (those who provide pre-graduation certificate or student status certificate at application MUST provide the graduation certificate no later than registration). 3 With proper moral conduct, in good health with no infectious disease or any physical or mental diseases that may affect the normal study. 4 Requirements of the regulations set in the Document No. 12 (2020) of Ministry of Education of the PRC should be met. If the applicant has acquired foreign citizenship automatically at the time of birth in a foreign country, whose parents were both Chinese citizens, or one of the parents was a Chinese citizen, parent’s (with Chinese citizenship) permanent resident in foreign country should be obtained prior to the birth of the applicant. Applicants must have lived abroad more than 2 years from April 30, 2022 to April 30, 2026 (more than 9 months of residence abroad per year can be considered as one year, taking entry and exit stamps as evidence). Applicants who have given up their original Chinese citizenship (including residents in Hong Kong, Macao and Taiwan) and become foreign citizens, must acquire foreign citizenship before April 30, 2022, and must have lived abroad more than 2 years from April 30, 2022 to April 30, 2026 (more than 9 months of residence abroad per year can be considered as one year, taking entry and exit stamps as evidence). Note: If the applicant is concluded to have Chinese Citizenship by the Chinese public security department after application, admission or enrollment, the applicant will be disqualified from application, admission or enrollment or withdrawal from school will be required. 5 Language Proficiency Applicants for Chinese-taught programs must have HSK certificate. Applicants whose compulsory courses were taught in Chinese during secondary education (junior and senior high school) can be exempt from submitting HSK certificate. No Chinese proficiency is required for the applicants to English-taught programs. If applicants’ native language is not English, they should provide score report of English language test (e.g. TOEFL/IELTS/OTHER). If applicants’ native language is not English, they should provide score report of English language test (e.g. TOEFL/IELTS/OTHER). 6 Requirements on China Scholastic Competency Assessment (CSCA) Please refer to the program catalog.

If you want to book our translation service , please pay and book it at least 2 weeks before the application deadline for submission of all documents; If you want to book our guardian service , you need to pay and book it 2 months before the application deadline, just in case your application fails because of failed to submit application documents on time. * 1. English proficiency test certificate For example, IELTS or TOEFL, only for applicant whose native language is not English. * 2. Non-criminal Record Certificate -Please note that this document is generally valid for only 6 months. For instance, if you submit your application in March, your non-criminal record must have been issued no earlier than September of the previous year. -Obtain this certificate from the local police station of your current residence, confirming that you have had no criminal record during the 6 months prior to the date of issuance. -If you are currently in China, the certificate must be issued by the local Chinese police. -If the document is not in Chinese or English, it must be translated and notarized by an authorized agency or relevant authority. Self-translations are not accepted. * 3. Physical Examination Form -Download the form template, print it, and bring it to a hospital for the required medical tests. The hospital will complete the form with your results. -The medical examination must cover all items listed on the form. -Ensure your photo is attached and the form is stamped and signed by the hospital after the examination. -The medical results are valid for 6 months only. -Forms that are incomplete, lack a final physician’s suggestion, missing the attending physician’s signature, official hospital stamp, or applicant’s sealed photo or contain abnormal examination results will be considered invalid. -The document must be in English or Chinese. You can download a template or sample from here . * 4. A Photocopy of valid passport With name, passport number & expiration date, and photo included(Photocopy of valid passport identification page. Passport must be an ordinary passport and be valid for at least six months. Applicants currently residing in China must include a copy of the page containing a valid visa or residence permit.) * 5. 2-inch ID photo * 6. Academic Transcripts of High school Academic Transcripts in languages other than Chinese or English should be translated into Chinese or English and be certified by notarization. Both original and official English translated version are required. * 7. Certificate of High school Certificate in languages other than Chinese or English should be translated into Chinese or English and be certified by notarization. Both original and official English translated version are required. * 8. CSCA Test Transcript(s) -You need to take the official CSCA test organized by the Chinese government and submit the corresponding subject result transcript(s) when applying. Learn more about the CSCA test >> -The test covers Chinese (Humanities and STEM Chinese), Mathematics, Physics, and Chemistry. Mathematics is required for all programs, while other subjects depend on the university’s specific requirements. -We are updating detailed information for each university, including the required subjects you have to take for each program and their score requirements. Once the updates are ready, you can check the attachment and information here for this university for the latest information. If no attachment is available yet, it usually means the university has not announced further details. You can download a template or sample from here . Tips: For applicants who are in China: If you are an employee, you still need to provide employment separation certificate and your current residence permit. If you are a student, you need to provide transfer certificate, leaving certificate, certificate of attendance rate issued by previous school and your current residence permit.

Note: If the applicant is concluded to have Chinese Citizenship by the Chinese public security department after application, admission or enrollment, the applicant will be disqualified from application, admission or enrollment or withdrawal from school will be required. 5 Language Proficiency Applicants for Chinese-taught programs must have HSK certificate. Applicants whose compulsory courses were taught in Chinese during secondary education (junior and senior high school) can be exempt from submitting HSK certificate. No Chinese proficiency is required for the applicants to English-taught programs. If applicants’ native language is not English, they should provide score report of English language test (e.g. TOEFL/IELTS/OTHER). These foreigners guarantee to observe Chinese disciplines and laws and obey the university rules and regulations. Do respect Chinese culture and customs during your study at HDU. The applicants' Chinese proficiency is not required for an English-taught program. Still, either New TOEFL (above 80), IELTS (above 5.5), or the related Certificate, will be accepted after providing is confirmed or met the application requirement.
fields.materials: Application Materials " * " means necessary documents that you must provide in your application. If you want to book our translation service , please pay and book it at least 2 weeks before the application deadline for submission of all documents; If you want to book our guardian service , you need to pay and book it 2 months before the application deadline, just in case your application fails because of failed to submit application documents on time. * 1. Passport -A clear, full-color scan of your passport information page, showing your name, passport number, expiration date, and photo. -Some universities may also require blank visa pages, so you are advised to upload a few blank pages as well. * 2. Photo -A recent passport-sized ID photo (2 x 2 inches) with a plain white background. -Full face visible, no headwear (except for religious reasons). -Taken within the last 6 months. * 3. Highest Degree Graduation Certificate -A formal graduation certificate of your highest completed education level (e.g., Senior High School, Bachelor’s, or Master’s degree). -If the document is not in Chinese or English, it must be translated into Chinese or English and notarized by an authorized translation agency or relevant authority. Self-translations are not accepted. -Both original copy and translation copy are required. * 4. Highest Degree Academic Transcripts -Formal academic transcripts of your highest completed education level (e.g., Senior High School, Bachelor’s, or Master’s degree), covering ALL academic years, NOT just the final year. -If the document is not in Chinese or English, it must be translated into Chinese or English and notarized by an authorized translation agency or relevant authority. Self-translations are not accepted. --Both original copy and translation copy are required. * 5. English Language Proficiency Certificate -IELTS, TOEFL, Duolingo, or EF SET. -IELTS (6.0 or above) or TOEFL iBT (90 or above) is generally preferred. -If you are unable to provide these test results, you may submit alternative proof, such as a Duolingo English Test score or an official English proficiency certificate issued by your previous school/university, stating that the medium of instruction was English. -Higher scores are preferred. * 6. Non-criminal Record Certificate -Please note that this document is generally valid for only 6 months. For instance, if you submit your application in March, your non-criminal record must have been issued no earlier than September of the previous year. -Obtain this certificate from the local police station of your current residence, confirming that you have had no criminal record during the 6 months prior to the date of issuance. -If you are currently in China, the certificate must be issued by the local Chinese police. -If the document is not in Chinese or English, it must be translated and notarized by an authorized agency or relevant authority. Self-translations are not accepted. * 7. Physical Examination Form -Download the form template, print it, and bring it to a hospital for the required medical tests. The hospital will complete the form with your results. -The medical examination must cover all items listed on the form. -Ensure your photo is attached and the form is stamped and signed by the hospital after the examination. -The medical results are valid for 6 months only. -Forms that are incomplete, lack a final physician’s suggestion, missing the attending physician’s signature, official hospital stamp, or applicant’s sealed photo or contain abnormal examination results will be considered invalid. -The document must be in English or Chinese. You can download a template or sample from here . * 8. Bank Statement Financial support statement issued by the local bank from the applicants’ host country. 9. Guardian's Letters for Students Under 18 -Students under 18 must find a Chinese guardian who resides in Hangzhou -Need Chinese guardian living in Hangzhou to sign two guardian documents (download from attachments) one is consent letter signed by parents, another is commitment letter from guardian and provide scan copies of them. -Aso the university will call the guardian to verify. You can download a template or sample from here . * 10. International Student Health Report Download from attachment, fill in information, print it, sign it and send us scan copy of it. You can download a template or sample from here . 11. Documents for Students Who Ever Study in China If you ever study in China you also need to provide the following 5 documents issued by your previous school: 1: A statement of Daily performance 2: Original official transcript 3: Attendance rate certificate 4: Enrollment certificate 5: Completion certificate Tips: For applicants who are in China: If you are an employee, you still need to provide employment separation certificate and your current residence permit. If you are a student, you need to provide transfer certificate, leaving certificate, certificate of attendance rate issued by previous school and your current residence permit.

fields.description: Program Description I. Academic Highlights This interdisciplinary dual-degree program brings together ECUST's internationally recognized strengths in Artificial Intelligence and Finance. Students learn from a distinguished faculty of AI and finance scholars, many of whom lead cutting-edge research in machine learning, financial data science, algorithmic systems, and smart decision-making. The School of Information Science and Technology and the School of Business jointly offer a research-rich environment, supported by state-of-the-art labs—including a National Engineering Laboratory for Big Data and dedicated Research Centers in Financial Data Science, Business Intelligence, and Smart Energy. Designed for the intelligent economy, the program equips students with dual literacy in AI technologies and financial markets. Graduates are prepared to tackle complex, real-world problems at their intersection — from automated trading and risk analytics to AI-driven investment platforms. Leveraging Shanghai's position as a global financial and tech hub, the program emphasizes hands-on, industry-connected learning and a global outlook. All core instruction is delivered in English, with opportunities for international exchange and collaboration. This is not merely a fusion of two disciplines, but a launchpad for future leaders in AI finance, quantitative innovation, and fintech worldwide. II. Educational Objectives This interdisciplinary program aims to cultivate versatile graduates who bridge artificial intelligence and finance. Students will develop strong quantitative and analytical foundations, enabling them to design AI-driven financial solutions, analyze complex market behaviors, and innovate at the intersection of technology and finance. Within five years of graduation, students are expected to: Solve real-world problems at the AI-finance nexus—such as algorithmic trading, risk modeling, fraud detection, and smart investment systems—using state-of-the-art machine learning and financial engineering methods. Work across disciplines collaboratively, leading or contributing to projects that require both computational thinking and financial logic, in multinational corporations, fintech firms, investment banks, or regulatory bodies. Communicate effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders, bridging the gap between AI developers and financial decision-makers in a global context. Act with ethical and professional responsibility, understanding the societal, legal, and economic implications of AI in financial markets, including fairness, transparency, and data privacy. Adapt to rapid change through lifelong learning, staying current with advances in AI, blockchain, quantitative finance, and digital assets, and seizing leadership opportunities in an evolving industry landscape. Graduates are well-prepared for global careers in quantitative analysis, fintech product development, AI-driven trading, financial data science, and technology management, or for pursuing advanced degrees in finance, AI, or related fields. III.Core Courses Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning Algorithm, Discrete Mathematics, Algorithm and Data Structures, Database Principles, Software Engineering, Operating Systems, Computer Networks, Micro-Economics, Macroeconomics, Financial Market, International Finance, Corporate Finance. IV.Graduation Criterion and Degree 1. Graduation Credit Required: 135. General Courses 17 credits, Disciplinary Courses 23 credits, Specialty Courses 77 credits, Practical Activities and Training Courses 16 credits, Innovation and Entrepreneurship Course 2 credits. 2. Duration: 3 years. 3. Degree Conferred: Bachelor of Engineering, Bachelor of Economics. V. Course Arrangement by Semester Official Curriculum Statement The curriculum outlined herein is the official version revised and published by ECUST in May 2026. ECUST reserves the right to revise programme content annually to maintain academic relevance and rigour. For the most current information, please refer to the latest version available on our official website.

fields.requirements: Entry Requirements In order to be considered for admission, you must: -be a non-Chinese citizen, 18-45 years old, in good health, -have completed senior high school education or will receive a high school diploma by the summer before matriculation at SUFE in September 2026, AND -be a native English speaker or meet the English language requirement through one of the following English skill test scores: IELTS: 6.0 or above TOEFL iBT: 80 or above Duolingo English Test: 100 or above.
fields.materials: Application Materials " * " means necessary documents that you must provide in your application. If you want to book our translation service , please pay and book it at least 2 weeks before the application deadline for submission of all documents; If you want to book our guardian service , you need to pay and book it 2 months before the application deadline, just in case your application fails because of failed to submit application documents on time. 1. Chinese visa/residence permit For those living in the Chinese mainland at the time of application. * 2. One reference letter The letter should be recent, dated, in English/Chinese, and with referee's contact details (employer, position, email, phone number). * 3. English Language Proficiency Certificate -Please upload the passport ID page if you are a native English speaker. Applicants who are not native English speakers should present TOEFL iBT 80 / IELTS (academic) 6.0 (overall) / Duolingo English Test 100 or certification of high school curriculum are taught in English. -If you are unable to provide these test results, you may submit alternative proof, such as a Duolingo English Test score or an official English proficiency certificate issued by your previous school/university, stating that the medium of instruction was English. -Higher scores are preferred. * 4. Foreigner's Physical Examination Report The physical examinations must cover all the items listed in the “Foreigner Physical Examination Form”Foreigner Physical Examination Form.pdf The form you submit must: Include with the signature of the attending physicians Include with the official stamp of the hospital Include with a sealed photograph of the applicant Be written in English, and Be dated within the last 6 months. Please keep the original reports with you for later use when you register at the University. You can download a template or sample from here . * 5. Police Clearance Certificate Please go to your local police authority where you reside, request that the police conduct a local or state criminal records search and provide you with a document reflecting that there is no history of a criminal record. The Police Clearance Certificate should be dated within the last 6 months. If you are unable to maintain such a document due to unforeseen circumstances, please contact Admission Office as early as possible for alternative documentation. 6. Certificates recognizing awards & merits if any * 7. Others Documents Required If you have studied or are currently studying at an institution in China, please upload your transcripts, completion certificates, or proof of enrollment, etc.; If you have never studied in China yet, please upload your personal resume. * 8. Passport identification page Your passport should be valid beyond January 31, 2027. * 9. Photo Please use the ID photo taken within the last 6 months. The head in the photograph must be facing the camera straight on, and the face may not be obscured. The photo itself must be in color, but the background needs to be white or blue. Head coverings are prohibited. * 10. High school academic transcript You need to apply with academic transcript for all the courses taken from high school grade one. It would be appreciated that the transcript is attached with a clarification on the grading system and how your GPA is calculated. Certified English/Chinese translations are required if the original documents are neither in English nor in Chinese. * 11. High school diploma If you are in the final year, please upload a certificate indicating the entry and the expected completion date. Certified English/Chinese translations are required if the original documents are neither in English nor in Chinese. * 12. Personal statement It should be written in Chinese, 800-1000 words including the applicant's education (and working experience, if applicable), study plan, etc. and enclosed with the applicant's signature. * 13. Guarantee of Financial Support Your program application will not be processed without a funding documentation. Your personal sponsor should be able to provide full financial support for your educational and living expenses for the entire length of study at SUFE. Ask your personal sponsor to complete the appropriate sections of the form Guarantee of Financial Support.pdf and provide a scanned copy of his/her passport, or ID card of the sponsor is of Chinese nationality. The form you submit must: Provide correct and complete information Include with the signature of the sponsor, and Be written in English or Chinese You can download a template or sample from here . * 14. CSCA Test Transcript(s) -You need to take the official CSCA test organized by the Chinese government and submit the corresponding subject result transcript(s) when applying. Learn more about the CSCA test >> -The test covers Chinese (Humanities and STEM Chinese), Mathematics, Physics, and Chemistry. Mathematics is required for all programs, while other subjects depend on the university’s specific requirements. -We are updating detailed information for each university, including the required subjects you have to take for each program and their score requirements. Once the updates are ready, you can check the attachment and information here for this university for the latest information. If no attachment is available yet, it usually means the university has not announced further details. You can download a template or sample from here . Tips: For applicants who are in China: If you are an employee, you still need to provide employment separation certificate and your current residence permit. If you are a student, you need to provide transfer certificate, leaving certificate, certificate of attendance rate issued by previous school and your current residence permit.

Study plan written in English or Chinese with no less than 600 characters or words. * 2. Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. * 3. Non-criminal record It must be issued by your local police station with official stamp. * 4. A recommendation letter written by high school headmaster or teachers (Signature, email and phone number of the referee should be included.) * 5. Physical Examination Record for Foreigner Completed in Chinese or English. The applicant must strictly take all the examination as required by the Form. Leaving a blank or absence of suggestion and signature of the doctor or seal of the hospital will make the form invalid. You can download a template or sample from here . * 6. English language proficiency test results For English taught programs. * 7. Scanned copy of valid foreign ordinary passport With name, passport number & expiration date, and photo included(Photocopy of valid passport identification page. Passport must be an ordinary passport and be valid for at least six months. Applicants currently residing in China must include a copy of the page containing a valid visa or residence permit.) * 8. Transcripts a) Notarized original or translated copies of high school academic transcripts, including courses taken, scores achieved, and clarification of the scoring system; b) The transcript of the unified standardized examination in the student’s home country or the internationally prevailing standardized examinations (such as A-Level, IBDP, etc.); c) Academic Transcripts in languages other than Chinese or English should be translated into Chinese or English and be certified by notarization. Both original and official English translated version are required. * 9. Notarized copies of senior high school graduation diploma, either in Chinese or English Certificate in languages other than Chinese or English should be translated into Chinese or English and be certified by notarization. Both original and official English translated version are required. * 10. CSCA Test Transcript(s) -You need to take the official CSCA test organized by the Chinese government and submit the corresponding subject result transcript(s) when applying. Learn more about the CSCA test >> -The test covers Chinese (Humanities and STEM Chinese), Mathematics, Physics, and Chemistry. Mathematics is required for all programs, while other subjects depend on the university’s specific requirements. -We are updating detailed information for each university, including the required subjects you have to take for each program and their score requirements. Once the updates are ready, you can check the attachment and information here for this university for the latest information. If no attachment is available yet, it usually means the university has not announced further details. You can download a template or sample from here . Tips: For applicants who are in China: If you are an employee, you still need to provide employment separation certificate and your current residence permit. If you are a student, you need to provide transfer certificate, leaving certificate, certificate of attendance rate issued by previous school and your current residence permit.

fields.materials: Application Materials " * " means necessary documents that you must provide in your application. If you want to book our translation service , please pay and book it at least 2 weeks before the application deadline for submission of all documents; If you want to book our guardian service , you need to pay and book it 2 months before the application deadline, just in case your application fails because of failed to submit application documents on time. * 1. Passport -A clear, full-color scan of your passport information page, showing your name, passport number, expiration date, and photo. -Some universities may also require blank visa pages, so you are advised to upload a few blank pages as well. * 2. Photo -A recent passport-sized ID photo (2 x 2 inches) with a plain white background. -Full face visible, no headwear (except for religious reasons). -Taken within the last 6 months. * 3. Highest Degree Graduation Certificate -A formal graduation certificate(or pre-graduation certificate if you haven’t graduated yet) of your highest completed education level (e.g., Senior High School, Bachelor’s, or Master’s degree). -If the document is not in Chinese or English, it must be translated into Chinese or English and notarized by an authorized translation agency or relevant authority. Self-translations are not accepted. -Both original copy and translation copy are required. * 4. Highest Degree Academic Transcripts -Formal academic transcripts of your highest completed education level (e.g., Senior High School, Bachelor’s, or Master’s degree), covering ALL academic years, NOT just the final year. -If the document is not in Chinese or English, it must be translated into Chinese or English and notarized by an authorized translation agency or relevant authority. Self-translations are not accepted. --Both original copy and translation copy are required. * 5. A Self-introduction Video -Please speak in English or Chinese. -The video should be at least 2 minutes long, in MP4 format, and less than 7 MB. -Include a brief self-introduction, your study plan after enrollment, reasons for applying to this program and university in China, and your plans after graduation. -You may also highlight your language ability, interests, confidence, and motivation. * 6. CV -Submit a resume or CV to help the university better understand your background. -Written in Chinese or in English. Your resume must include a complete and continuous list of your education and work experience, covering all periods up to the time you apply to university, without missing a single year or month. -Some universities may require you to use their designated CV templates, which must be downloaded and completed accordingly. Tips: For applicants who are in China: If you are an employee, you still need to provide employment separation certificate and your current residence permit. If you are a student, you need to provide transfer certificate, leaving certificate, certificate of attendance rate issued by previous school and your current residence permit.

fields.description: Program Description I. Course Overview 1. Levels: Beginner, Intermediate, and Advanced. BIFT divides students into three levels based on their Chinese proficiency: Beginner, Intermediate, and Advanced, with each level of different classes. 2. Objectives: Beginner Class focuses on basic Chinese knowledge training. Intermediate Class improves reading skills and develops writing skills while consolidating basic Chinese knowledge. Advanced Class guides students to understand Chinese culture more comprehensively and accurately and integrate into Chinese society while further consolidating and improving listening, speaking, reading, and writing skills. 3. Duration: One semester/One year 4. Curriculum: A combination of listening and speaking courses and comprehensive courses will be used to teach the Chinese language systematically. At the same time, Chinese culture study tours or extracurricular language practice activities will be arranged on irregular basis. II. Class Duration According to students' number, each semester has 16 to 20 weeks and each week has 12 to 20 class hours. Customized courses regarding study tour and exchange projects are set up according to actual needs.

Application Form -Download the application form, fill it out on your computer, and submit it in Word format (.docx). -Complete all fields as fully and accurately as possible. Do not leave any blanks — write "None" if a section does not apply. -The form must be filled in English or Chinese. * 2. Photo -A recent passport-sized ID photo (2 x 2 inches) with a plain white background. -Full face visible, no headwear (except for religious reasons). -Taken within the last 6 months. * 3. Passport -A clear, full-color scan of your passport information page, showing your name, passport number, expiration date, and photo. -Some universities may also require blank visa pages, so you are advised to upload a few blank pages as well. * 4. Physical Examination Form -Download the form template, print it, and bring it to a hospital for the required medical tests. The hospital will complete the form with your results. -The medical examination must cover all items listed on the form. -Ensure your photo is attached and the form is stamped and signed by the hospital after the examination. -The medical results are valid for 6 months only. -Forms that are incomplete, lack a final physician’s suggestion, missing the attending physician’s signature, official hospital stamp, or applicant’s sealed photo or contain abnormal examination results will be considered invalid. -The document must be in English or Chinese. * 5. Non-criminal Record Certificate -Please note that this document is generally valid for only 6 months. For instance, if you submit your application in March, your non-criminal record must have been issued no earlier than September of the previous year. -Obtain this certificate from the local police station of your current residence, confirming that you have had no criminal record during the 6 months prior to the date of issuance. -If you are currently in China, the certificate must be issued by the local Chinese police. -If the document is not in Chinese or English, it must be translated and notarized by an authorized agency or relevant authority. Self-translations are not accepted. * 6. Highest Degree Academic Transcripts -Formal academic transcripts of your highest completed education level (e.g., Senior High School, Bachelor’s, or Master’s degree), covering ALL academic years, NOT just the final year. -If the document is not in Chinese or English, it must be translated into Chinese or English and notarized by an authorized translation agency or relevant authority. Self-translations are not accepted. -Both original copy and translation copy are required. * 7. Highest Degree Graduation Certificate -A formal graduation certificate(or pre-graduation certificate if you haven’t graduated yet) of your highest completed education level (e.g., Senior High School, Bachelor’s, or Master’s degree). -If the document is not in Chinese or English, it must be translated into Chinese or English and notarized by an authorized translation agency or relevant authority. Self-translations are not accepted. -Both original copy and translation copy are required. * 8. A Self-introduction Video -Please speak in English or Chinese. -Include a brief self-introduction, your study plan after enrollment, reasons for applying to this program and university in China, and your plans after graduation. -You may also highlight your language ability, interests, confidence, and motivation. Tips: For applicants who are in China: If you are an employee, you still need to provide employment separation certificate and your current residence permit. If you are a student, you need to provide transfer certificate, leaving certificate, certificate of attendance rate issued by previous school and your current residence permit.
